title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼的关系

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has distanced his party, One Nation, from Germany's far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party, which recently surged to first place in a state election. Joyce expressed concern, stating the AfD's success "starts to ring alarm bells."
summary.zh: 澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯已将他的政党“一人党”与德国极右翼政党“德国选择党”（AfD）区分开来。该党最近在一次州选举中飙升至首位。乔伊斯表示担忧，称AfD的成功“开始敲响警钟”。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany party (AfD), after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold for advancing its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support to Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists: "Well, I don't see (the UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage) as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The rise of far-right parties, like the AfD in Germany, often signals a deepening societal anxiety and a temptation to respond to perceived threats with division and exclusion. Barnaby Joyce's unease reflects a broader concern about such political currents. The call to "overcome evil with good" (Romans 12:21) challenges us to resist mirroring the harshness...
reflection.zh: 德国选择党（AfD）等极右翼政党的崛起，常常预示着社会焦虑的加剧，以及以分裂和排斥来应对感知威胁的诱惑。巴纳比·乔伊斯的担忧反映了对这种政治潮流的广泛关切。《罗马书》12:21呼吁“以善胜恶”，这挑战我们抵制以牙还牙的冲动，转而寻求建设性、富有同情心的回应，以建立而非摧毁。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水近两周后，又一名澳大利亚人被发现生还

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously uncontactable after the catastrophic flooding in Nepal and Tibet on August 26th, has been confirmed safe. The disaster resulted in at least 1,399 deaths and over 5,400 missing persons, including approximately 800 foreigners. Families of missing Australians are calling for greater...
summary.zh: 在8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生灾难性洪水后，一名此前失联的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。此次灾难已造成至少1,399人死亡，超过5,400人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。失踪澳大利亚人的家属呼吁有关部门和旅行社提高透明度。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed over a thousand lives and left thousands missing, the news of one Australian found safe offers a glimmer of hope. This moment of relief, turning potential grief into thankfulness, echoes the ancient promise that weeping may last for the night, but joy comes with the morning.
reflection.zh: 在造成一千多人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被发现安全的消息带来了一线希望。这种从潜在的悲伤转向感恩的解脱时刻，呼应了古老的应许：黑夜虽长，但清晨必有欢欣。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: UK-US trade could suffer as a result of sanctions for illegal Israeli settlements, American ambassador warns – UK politics live
title.zh: 美驻英大使警告，因非法以色列定居点制裁可能损害英美贸易

summary.en: The UK is set to reassert its support for Palestinian rights and a two-state solution, a move that has drawn criticism from the US and Israel. The UK plans to adopt a tougher stance on Israel by banning trade with illegal settlements. A Labour MP has warned that this proposed ban could increase the risk to British...
summary.zh: 英国将重申对巴勒斯坦权利和两国方案的支持，此举招致了美国和以色列的批评。英国计划采取更强硬的对以立场，禁止与非法定居点进行贸易。一位工党议员警告说，拟议中的贸易禁令可能会增加英国犹太人面临的风险，他担心以色列的反对者可能无法区分以色列政府的政策、犹太复国主义的政治理念和英国犹太人，从而可能导致更多袭击。

body.en: UK to reassert support for Palestinian rights and a two-state solution in move drawing criticism from US and Israel UK to adopt tougher stance on Israel with illegal settlements trade ban A Labour MP has warned that the proposed ban on trade with illegal Israeli settlements on the West Bank could increase the risk to British Jews. In an interview with the Today programme, Peter Prinsley , vice chair of Labour Friends of Israel, said: My fear is that opponents of Israel won’t distinguish between Israeli government policy, Zionistic political philosophy, and British Jews. As far as they’re concerned, the whole thing’s the same, and I think it carries a real risk of increased chances of attacks on the British Jewish community. Which is exactly what I said to Ed Miliband when I was asked to see him two or three nights ago. I think the timing is terrible. I think we need to wait for the result of the Israeli election, and then we need to have another think. We must do whatever we can to preserve the two-state solution, and I think the behaviour of the presently-elected Israeli government is really outrageous in this respect. I have a horrible feeling that what we’re doing will not only embolden the present government of Netanyahu, but has the capacity to influence the election itself, which is on a knife edge. We think it’s performative posturing. It’s very difficult to distinguish goods that come from the West Bank area versus the rest of Israel . So practically, it’s very difficult to implement. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国重申支持巴勒斯坦权利和两国解决方案，此举招致美国和以色列的批评 英国将对以色列采取更强硬立场，禁止非法定居点贸易 一名工党议员警告称，拟议的禁止与约旦河西岸以色列非法定居点进行贸易的提议可能会增加英国犹太人面临的风险。以色列工党之友副主席彼得·普林斯利在接受《今日》节目采访时表示：我担心以色列的反对者不会区分以色列政府政策、犹太复国主义政治哲学和英国犹太人。就他们而言，整个事情都是一样的，我认为这确实存在增加对英国犹太社区的攻击机会的风险。这正是两三晚前我被要求见埃德·米利班德时对他说的。我认为时机太糟糕了。我认为我们需要等待以色列选举的结果，然后我们需要再考虑一下。我们必须尽一切努力维护两国解决方案，我认为目前当选的以色列政府在这方面的行为确实令人愤慨。我有一种可怕的感觉，我们正在做的事情不仅会增强内塔尼亚胡现任政府的气焰，而且有能力影响选举本身，而选举本身正处于危险之中。我们认为这是一种表演姿态。很难区分来自约旦河西岸地区和以色列其他地区的货物。所以实际上，实施起来非常困难。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The proposed trade ban on Israeli settlements raises complex geopolitical issues, but also a deeply human concern: the potential for increased antisemitism. The MP's warning about the risk to British Jews underscores the need to protect vulnerable communities. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all those who...
reflection.zh: 拟议中的以色列定居点贸易禁令引发了复杂的地缘政治问题，但也带来了一个人性化的深切担忧：反犹主义可能加剧。这位议员关于英国犹太人面临风险的警告，凸显了保护弱势群体的必要性。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们“要为贫穷的人和一切孤苦无告的人伸冤，为他们辩屈。”这一原则不仅适用于受定居点影响的巴勒斯坦人，也适用于面临潜在反弹的犹太社区。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: One Nation’s Warren Pickering admits to illegal drug use and says he is ‘no angel’ in extraordinary press conference
title.zh: 一名国家党领袖承认非法吸毒，并在非同寻常的新闻发布会上表示自己“并非天使”

summary.en: The Victorian One Nation leader stated that his actions 'hurt people I loved, and I will live with that forever.' He admitted to past mistakes in his 20s, including drug use and drink driving, while denying more recent allegations. He is considering legal action against a publication that reported these claims.
summary.zh: 维多利亚州一位国家党领袖表示，他的行为“伤害了我所爱的人，我将永远为此承担后果”。他承认了20多岁时犯下的错误，包括吸毒和酒后驾车，但否认了更近期的指控。他正在考虑对一家报道这些指控的报纸采取法律行动。

body.en: Victorian One Nation leader says his actions ‘hurt people I loved, and I will live with that forever’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Victorian One Nation leader, Warren Pickering, has admitted he “made mistakes” in his 20s, including using ecstasy, methamphetamines and marijuana, losing his licence multiple times for drink driving and hurting people he loved. But he has denied claims by his ex-partner, published by The Australian, that he smoked ice – also known as crystal meth – in front of children and said he was considering legal action against the publication at a press conference on Tuesday. Guardian Australia and the ABC were barred from attending the press conference. Continue reading...

reflection.en: Warren Pickering's public confession of past mistakes, including drug use and hurting loved ones, highlights the difficult path of accountability. While denying more recent accusations, his acknowledgment of past harm and the statement 'I will live with that forever' speaks to the enduring weight of our actions. The prophet Micah reminds us that true...
reflection.zh: 沃伦·皮克林公开承认过去的错误，包括吸毒和伤害亲人，这凸显了承担责任的艰难道路。尽管他否认了最近的指控，但他承认过去的伤害并说“我将永远为此承担后果”，这表明了我们行为的持久影响。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义，好怜悯，这在个人认罪中也引起共鸣。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Oil price approaches $100 a barrel after attacks on Saudi oil facilities – business live
title.zh: 也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施，油价逼近每桶100美元

summary.en: Saudi authorities reported that operations at some energy facilities were halted following attacks by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis, which injured over 70 people. This event has caused oil prices to approach $100 a barrel, increasing pressure on European countries to secure energy supplies before winter.
summary.zh: 沙特当局称，也门伊朗支持的胡塞武装袭击了部分能源设施，导致70多人受伤，部分设施的运营已暂停。此次袭击导致油价逼近每桶100美元，给需要在冬季前储备能源的欧洲国家带来了压力。

body.en:
Good morning, and welcome to our rolling coverage of business, the financial markets and the world economy.

The global economy faces the prospect of $100 a barrel oil again, as the conflict in the Middle East continues.

Brent crude has risen back over the $98 a barrel mark already this week, its highest level since 24 July. Oil has been pushed up by reports that Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis attacked energy facilities in Saudi Arabia.

Saudi authorities said operations at some energy facilities had been halted today following attacks ‌by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis that wounded more than 70 people.

The attacks add to the pressure on oil and gas production in the region, which remains badly disrupted by the ongoing Iran war.

Earlier today, Iran threatened to create a new restricted zone in the Gulf if the US pressed on with its ‘economic warfare’ against Tehran.

Such a zone would, presumably, further undermine US efforts to reopen the strait of Hormuz.

Mohsen Rezaei, the secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said Iran had “ fundamentally recalibrated” its posture towards US forces.

In recent days, Washington has received a clear warning from Iran’s new missiles. Economic warfare will be met by a maritime exclusion zone across the Persian Gulf to the blockade perimeter. The operational posture toward U.S. warships and bases has been fundamentally recalibrated.

Shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has already slowed this week – just seven commodity vessels sailing through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, down from eight on Sunday. Before the war began, about 130 ships a day would cross the strait.

This is all a headache for central bankers, as high oil prices create inflationary pressures through the economy. Later today, MPs in London will question Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey, and colleagues, about their recent decision to hold the Bank Rate at 3.75%.

MPs are likely to question witnesses on the potential inflationary impact of the ongoing war in Iran and how the MPC considers recent developments in AI, the committee says.

2.15pm BST: Bank of England policymakers appear before the Treasury select committee
body.zh: 早上好，欢迎收看我们对商业、金融市场和世界经济的滚动报道。 随着中东冲突的持续，全球经济再次面临每桶100美元的油价前景。 布伦特原油本周已回升至每桶 98 美元大关，为 7 月 24 日以来的最高水平。有报道称也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装袭击了沙特阿拉伯的能源设施，从而推高了油价。 沙特当局表示，在也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装发动袭击造成 70 多人受伤后，一些能源设施的运营已于今天停止。 这些袭击增加了该地区石油和天然气生产的压力，该地区仍然受到正在进行的伊朗战争的严重干扰。 今天早些时候，伊朗威胁称，如果美国继续对德黑兰实施“经济战”，伊朗将在海湾地区设立新的禁区。 这样的区域可能会进一步破坏美国重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的努力。 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫森·礼扎伊表示，伊朗已经“从根本上重新调整”了对美军的态度。 近日来，华盛顿收到了伊朗新型导弹的明确警告。经济战将通过波斯湾到封锁周边的海上禁区来应对。针对美国军舰和基地的作战姿态已经从根本上重新调整。 本周通过霍尔木兹海峡的航运交通已经放缓——周一只有七艘商品船通过霍尔木兹海峡，低于周日的八艘。战争开始前，每天约有130艘船只穿越海峡。 这对央行行长来说都是一个令人头疼的问题，因为高油价会给经济带来通胀压力。今天晚些时候，伦敦议员将质询英格兰银行行长安德鲁·贝利 (Andrew Bailey) 及其同事最近将银行利率维持在 3.75% 的决定。 该委员会表示，议员们可能会向证人询问伊朗正在进行的战争对通胀的潜在影响，以及货币政策委员会如何看待人工智能的最新发展。 英国夏令时下午 2.15 点：英格兰银行政策制定者出席财政部特别委员会会议

reflection.en: The news of attacks on Saudi energy facilities and the subsequent rise in oil prices paints a picture of global instability and economic pressure. In times of such conflict and uncertainty, Psalm 46:9 reminds us that Yahweh is the ultimate power who brings an end to warfare and dismantles weapons. It offers a perspective of hope beyond human conflict,...
reflection.zh: 关于也门胡塞武装袭击沙特能源设施以及随后油价上涨的新闻，描绘了一幅全球动荡和经济压力的图景。在这样的冲突和不确定时期，《诗篇》46:9提醒我们，雅伟是终结战争、拆毁武器的终极力量。它提供了一种超越人类冲突的希望视角，指向神圣的干预与和平。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.

title.en: Ukraine’s prosecutor general resigns after corruption allegations as Russia resumes strikes on Kyiv – Europe live

True leadership, as the prophet Micah reminds us, is found in acting justly, loving mercy, and walking...

title.en: A war criminal was given a hero's send-off. It could have broader impacts
title.zh: 战犯获英雄式送别，恐有更广泛影响

summary.en: Thousands paid their respects to the man convicted for the Srebrenica genocide.
summary.zh: 数千人向因斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪被定罪的男子致敬。

body.en:
On Monday in Serbia, thousands of people waited in line to attend the funeral of the former Bosnian Serb military commander and convicted war criminal dubbed the "Butcher of Bosnia", who died last month aged 84 while serving a life sentence at The Hague.

Ratko Mladić's body lay in state at a Serbian Orthodox Church in the capital Belgrade, his coffin given military honours and flanked by soldiers in fatigues — a show of support that defied European Union warnings against allowing public tribute to the man charged with the continent's worst atrocity since World War Two.

In 2017, the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia convicted Mladić on charges of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes committed during his time as a senior military official, including terrorising the civilian population of Sarajevo during a years-long siege of the Bosnian capital, and for his role in the Srebrenica massacre.

A United Nations-declared "safe zone" for Bosnian Muslims during the Bosnian War, Srebrenica was overrun in July 1995 by Serbian forces who made men and boys strip before killing them and bulldozing bodies into mass graves.

More than 8,300 men and boys were killed in the massacre on Mladić's orders.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In addition to the killings, ethnic cleansing was confirmed by the court, with an estimated 20,000 to 30,000 civilians abused and expelled from the area.

Mladić's funeral drew immediate criticism from the EU, further threatening Serbia's years-long bid for admission already contested by the country's democratic decline, crackdown on press freedoms and refusal to sanction Russia for its war on Ukraine.

Christian Wigand, a spokesperson for the EU's diplomatic service, the European External Action Service, said glorification of war criminals had no place in EU candidate countries.

"Any glorification of war criminals, genocide denial and revisionism contradict the most fundamental European values and have no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries," he said in a statement released on Monday.

"We are standing in solidarity with all victims, survivors and their families who suffered from war crimes in countries of former Yugoslavia."

The European enlargement commissioner Marta Kos cancelled a planned trip to Belgrade this week over what she described as the "glorification" of Mladić.

"Ratko Mladić was convicted of genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes. The return of his remains to Belgrade reminds Europe of the darkest pages in our recent history," Kos said in a post on X.

body.zh: 周一在塞尔维亚，数千人排队等候参加前波斯尼亚塞族军事指挥官、被称为“波斯尼亚屠夫”的被定罪战犯的葬礼，他上个月在海牙服无期徒刑期间去世，享年 84 岁。 拉特科·姆拉迪奇的遗体安放在首都贝尔格莱德的塞尔维亚东正教教堂内，他的灵柩被授予军事荣誉，两侧是身着迷彩服的士兵——这一举动无视欧盟关于允许公开悼念这位被控犯有第二次世界大战以来欧洲大陆最严重暴行的男子的警告，以示支持。 2017年，前南斯拉夫问题国际刑事法庭判定姆拉迪奇犯有种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪，罪名是他在担任高级军官期间犯下的罪行，包括在对波斯尼亚首都长达数年的围困期间恐吓萨拉热窝平民，以及他在斯雷布雷尼察大屠杀中所扮演的角色。 斯雷布雷尼察是波斯尼亚战争期间联合国宣布的波斯尼亚穆斯林的“安全区”，1995 年 7 月，塞尔维亚军队占领了斯雷布雷尼察，他们将男子和男孩脱光衣服，然后将其杀害，并将尸体推入乱葬坑。 超过 8,300 名男子和男孩在姆拉迪奇下令的大屠杀中被杀。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 除了杀戮之外，法院还证实了种族清洗，估计有 20,000 至 30,000 名平民受到虐待并被驱逐出该地区。 姆拉迪奇的葬礼立即招致了欧盟的批评，进一步威胁到塞尔维亚多年来的入盟申请，该国的民主衰落、压制新闻自由以及拒绝制裁俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争已经引发了争议。 欧盟外交部门欧洲对外行动署发言人克里斯蒂安·维甘德表示，美化战犯在欧盟候选国中没有立足之地。 他在周一发布的一份声明中表示：“任何美化战犯、否认种族灭绝和修正主义的行为都违背了最基本的欧洲价值观，在欧盟或欧盟候选国中都没有立足之地。” “我们与前南斯拉夫国家遭受战争罪行的所有受害者、幸存者及其家人站在一起。” 欧盟东扩委员玛尔塔·科斯取消了本周前往贝尔格莱德的计划，她称这是对姆拉迪奇的“颂扬”。 科斯在 X 上发帖称：“拉特科·姆拉迪奇被判犯有种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪。他的遗体运回贝尔格莱德让欧洲想起了我们近代历史上最黑暗的一页。” “围绕他的死亡的颂扬与......

title.en: Flights resume in Indonesia despite fresh volcanic eruptions
title.zh: 印尼航班恢复，尽管火山再次喷发

summary.en: Indonesia has reopened its main airport in Jakarta and four others that had been closed due to volcanic ash, although fresh eruptions on Tuesday raised the risk of further disruption. Ash from the Anak Krakatau volcano has blanketed Jakarta and surrounding areas since its eruption late Friday, leading to the closure...
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚已重新开放雅加达的主要机场和因火山灰关闭的另外四个机场，尽管周二的最新喷发增加了进一步中断的风险。自周五晚上的安那克喀拉喀托火山喷发以来，其火山灰已覆盖雅加达及周边地区，导致八个机场关闭，影响了超过34万名旅客。

body.en:
Indonesia has reopened its main airport in Jakarta and four others that had been closed due to volcanic ash, although fresh eruptions on Tuesday raised the risk of further disruption.

Ash from the Anak Krakatau volcano, which sits halfway between Java and Sumatra islands, has blanketed Jakarta and some surrounding areas since its initial eruption late on Friday.

It led to the closure of eight airports for safety reasons, with more than 340,000 travellers impacted.

Soekarno-Hatta Airport, Jakarta's main airport, resumed operations on Tuesday after wind blew the ash away, transport minister Dudy Purwagandhi said in a statement, adding that authorities would check the airworthiness of 178 planes that were grounded there during the closure.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Traveller Alvin Pratama Putra, 31, who had arrived at Soekarno-Hatta on Sunday for a flight to South Korea for work, said his flight had now been rescheduled to Thursday.

"What can you do? It's nature. It's dangerous for the plane if you force it," he said, adding that he had been sleeping on a bench at the airport.

Four other airports, including a smaller one in Jakarta and another in the neighbouring city of Bandung, also reopened on Tuesday. Another airport had already reopened on Monday, while two remain closed.

Bayu Sutanto, secretary general of the Indonesia National Air Carriers Association (INACA), said the delays put strain on airlines' finances, with lost revenue from cancelled flights and higher operating expenses.

Bayu said airlines would have to incur various expenses such as extra fuel costs from route diversions, aircraft parking, or crew-related costs, adding that a delay of one plane at Soekarno-Hatta could affect the next three or four flights using the same aircraft.

Airlines could lose up to $1.5 million a day during such a disruption, Bayu said.

Anak Krakatau erupted again three times on Tuesday morning, the local volcano monitoring agency said.

While smaller than the earlier eruptions, there was still potential for further flight disruption depending on ash height and wind direction.

"So far, the impact is not as big as the previous eruptions, but we'll continue to monitor," said Lana Saria, head of the geological agency.

The volcano is one of about 130 active volcanoes in Indonesia, which straddles the 'Pacific Ring of Fire', a highly seismically active zone where tectonic plates meet to produce numerous earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.

Other volcanoes, including Mount Ibu and Ili Lewotolok, both on islands east of Java, also erupted on Tuesday.

Anak Krakatau, which means child of Krakatau, began emerging a century ago from the area...
body.zh: 印度尼西亚已重新开放雅加达的主要机场和其他四个因火山灰而关闭的机场，不过周二的新火山喷发增加了进一步破坏的风险。 位于爪哇岛和苏门答腊岛中间的阿纳克喀拉喀托火山的火山灰自周五晚些时候首次喷发以来，已经覆盖了雅加达和周边一些地区。 出于安全原因，该事件导致八个机场关闭，超过 34 万名旅客受到影响。 雅加达主要机场苏加诺-哈达机场在被风吹走灰烬后于周二恢复运营，交通部长杜迪·普瓦甘迪 (Dudy Purwagandhi) 在一份声明中表示，并补充说当局将检查关闭期间停飞在那里的 178 架飞机的适航性。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 31 岁的旅行者阿尔文·普拉塔玛·普特拉 (Alvin Pratama Putra) 于周日抵达苏加诺-哈达，搭乘飞往韩国出差的航班，他表示，他的航班现已改期至周四。 “你能做什么？这是自然现象。如果你强迫的话，对飞机来说是危险的，”他说，并补充说他一直睡在机场的长凳上。 其他四个机场也于周二重新开放，其中包括雅加达的一个较小的机场和邻近城市万隆的另一个机场。另一个机场已于周一重新开放，另有两个机场仍处于关闭状态。 印度尼西亚国家航空公司协会（INACA）秘书长巴尤·苏坦托（Bayu Sutanto）表示，航班延误给航空公司的财务带来压力，航班取消导致收入损失，运营费用增加。 Bayu表示，航空公司将不得不承担各种费用，例如航线改道带来的额外燃油费用、飞机停场或机组人员相关费用，并补充说，苏加诺-哈达的一架飞机延误可能会影响接下来使用同一架飞机的三到四趟航班。 Bayu 表示，在此类中断期间，航空公司每天可能损失高达 150 万美元。 当地火山监测机构称，阿纳克喀拉喀托火山周二早上再次喷发了三次。 虽然比之前的喷发规模要小，但根据火山灰高度和风向，仍有可能进一步干扰航班。 地质机构负责人拉娜·萨里亚表示：“到目前为止，影响没有之前的火山喷发那么大，但我们将继续监测。” 该火山是印度尼西亚约 130 座活火山之一，横跨“太平洋火环”，这是一个地震高度活跃的区域，这里的构造板块相遇，会产生多次地震和火山喷发。 其他火山，包括爪哇东部岛屿上的伊布火山和伊利勒沃托洛克火山，也在周二喷发。 Anak Krakatau，意思是喀拉喀托之子，一个世纪前开始从该地区出现......

reflection.en: The ash from Anak Krakatau has disrupted travel for hundreds of thousands, grounding flights and closing airports. In moments of natural upheaval, when the earth itself seems to shift and threaten our plans, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength. Even amidst the chaos of ash clouds and flight cancellations, we can find solace in His...
reflection.zh: 安那克喀拉喀托火山的火山灰已扰乱了数十万人的出行，导致航班停飞和机场关闭。在自然动荡的时刻，当地球本身似乎在移动并威胁我们的计划时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量。即使在火山灰云和航班取消的混乱中，我们也能在他坚定的同在中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Protesters call for Israeli ambassador's expulsion after Zomi Frankcom decision
title.zh: 抗议者要求驱逐以色列大使，此前扎米·弗兰科姆事件做出裁决

summary.en: Activists protested outside the Israeli embassy in Canberra, demanding the expulsion of Israel's ambassador. This action follows the decision not to prosecute Israeli officers involved in the airstrike that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza.
summary.zh: 活动人士在堪培拉的以色列大使馆外举行抗议，要求驱逐以色列大使。此前，以色列方面决定不起诉在加沙地带导致澳大利亚援助工作者扎米·弗兰科姆死亡的空袭事件中的以色列军官。

body.en:
Dozens of activists have demanded Israel's ambassador in Canberra be expelled following the decision not to pursue criminal charges against officers who ordered strikes that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza.

The group converged in front of the Israeli embassy in Canberra on Tuesday displaying dozens of pictures of Palestinians killed by Israel since October 7 across the road from the embassy, with protesters chanting in unison: "Kick out the Israeli ambassador".

Israel's ambassador to Australia Hillel Newman last month declined to apologise to Zomi Frankcom’s family following the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) investigation which determined those responsible for the April 2024 strike that killed Frankcom and six of her colleagues would not be prosecuted.

Newman had said at the time he felt for the family but that the outcomes of Israel's investigation must be respected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A group called the Red Rebels staged a demonstration walking slowly to the embassy and pointing to its highly guarded gates, carrying a symbolic fake baby to represent the children killed by Israeli strikes in Gaza.

Activists blocked the entry to the embassy, leading police to physically move them from the driveway across the road. There was a tense standoff as protesters chanted "free Palestine" in front of a line of police officers.

Zomi's friend Karuna Bajracharya was among the protest group, saying he found remarks by one of the Israeli officers involved in the strike that he did not regret the attack as "disgusting".

Former IDF reserve colonel Nochi Mendel has told the ABC and the Guardian in separate interviews he would do "exactly the same thing" again and that he believed the World Central Kitchen workers killed were "not innocent".

"Like, disgusting the fact that he said, 'I'm not sorry', and the fact that he said he'd do it again.

"The people that we vote for and we put into power and that our taxes pay is supposed to represent us, the Australian people, and we are begging them: send this guy (the ambassador) home, send a clear message, cut the two-way arms trade. But it's obvious that our government is hamstrung."

Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi described the federal government as "cowards" for not declaring how it will proceed with its next steps to seek accountability over Frankcom’s death.

"They have power. They have responsibility, and we will hold them to account. They should have sanctioned Israel a long time ago," Faruqi told protesters.

"When Israel abrogated themselves of this crime, senator Wong told us how angry the Australian government was. Instead, they were considering what action to take...
body.zh: 数十名活动人士要求驱逐以色列驻堪培拉大使，此前以色列决定不对那些下令发动袭击并在加沙杀害澳大利亚援助人员佐米·弗兰克科姆的官员提出刑事指控。 周二，这群人聚集在堪培拉的以色列大使馆前，展示了数十张自 10 月 7 日以来在大使馆对面被以色列杀害的巴勒斯坦人的照片，抗议者齐声高呼：“赶走以色列大使”。 以色列驻澳大利亚大使希勒尔·纽曼 (Hillel Newman) 上个月拒绝向佐米·弗兰克科 (Zomi Frankcom) 的家人道歉，此前以色列国防军 (IDF) 进行了调查，确定对 2024 年 4 月导致弗兰克科 (Frankcom) 及其六名同事死亡的袭击负责的人不会受到起诉。 纽曼当时表示，他对这个家庭感到同情，但以色列的调查结果必须得到尊重。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一个名为“红色叛军”的组织举行示威活动，缓慢走向使馆，指着戒备森严的大门，并举着一个象征性的假婴儿，代表在以色列对加沙的袭击中丧生的儿童。 活动人士封锁了大使馆的入口，导致警察将他们从车道上移到马路对面。抗议者在一排警察面前高呼“自由巴勒斯坦”，双方陷入紧张的对峙。 佐米的朋友卡鲁纳·巴杰拉查里亚（Karuna Bajracharya）是抗议团体之一，他说，他发现参与袭击的一名以色列军官表示他并不后悔这次袭击的言论“令人作呕”。 前以色列国防军后备上校诺奇·门德尔在接受美国广播公司和卫报的单独采访时告诉美国广播公司和卫报，他会再次做“完全相同的事情”，并且他相信被杀害的世界中央厨房工人“不是无辜的”。 “就像，令人恶心的是，他说‘我不抱歉’，而且他说他会再这样做。 “我们投票支持、我们掌权的人，我们的纳税应该代表我们，澳大利亚人民，我们恳求他们：让这个人（大使）回家，发出明确的信息，削减双向武器贸易。但很明显，我们的政府已经陷入困境。” 绿党参议员梅林·法鲁奇 (Mehreen Faruqi) 称联邦政府是“懦夫”，因为他们没有宣布将如何采取下一步行动，追究弗兰克科姆之死的责任。 “他们有权力。他们有责任，我们将追究他们的责任。他们早就应该制裁以色列了，”法鲁奇告诉抗议者。 “当以色列废除这一罪行时，黄参议员告诉我们澳大利亚政府有多么愤怒。相反，他们正在考虑采取什么行动......

reflection.en: The protesters' demand for accountability and justice for Zomi Frankcom and the Palestinian victims echoes the ancient prophetic call for righteousness to flow like a river. When official channels seem to fail or offer insufficient recourse, people often turn to public demonstration to voice their pain and demand that justice be done. May we remember that...
reflection.zh: 抗议者要求为扎米·弗兰科姆和巴勒斯坦受害者讨回公道和伸张正义，这呼应了古代先知关于公义如江河滔滔的呼唤。当官方渠道似乎失效或提供不足的补救措施时，人们常常诉诸公开示威来表达他们的痛苦并要求伸张正义。 愿我们铭记，真正的公义与怜悯和正直交织在一起，愿领导人倾听这些对问责的呼吁，确保和平的追求永远是至高无上的。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Canada braces for prolonged trade war as counter-tariffs on US take effect
title.zh: 加拿大为美国反制关税生效后的长期贸易战做准备

summary.en: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on a range of US goods, amounting to nearly C$28bn ($20bn), have taken effect, with no immediate prospect of a trade deal. The tariffs, which can be as high as 50%, apply to products from steel to furniture and T-shirts. While fresh fish and lobster were initially included, they were later...
summary.zh: 加拿大对一系列美国商品实施的报复性关税已生效，涉及近280亿加元（200亿美元）的商品，且短期内看不到达成贸易协议的希望。这些关税最高可达50%，适用于从钢铁到家具和T恤的各类产品。尽管最初将海鲜和龙虾列入清单，但在收到海产业界的反对后被删除，这凸显了加拿大在与最大贸易伙伴的互动中必须维持的微妙平衡。美加双方官员均表示...

body.en:
Canada's retaliatory tariffs on a range of US goods came into effect on Tuesday, with no sign of a trade deal on the horizon.

The counter-tariffs will apply to nearly C$28bn ($20bn; £15bn) worth of American products, from steel to furniture to cotton T-shirts, and will be as high as 50%.

Fresh fish and lobster were also on the list, but Canada later omitted them after pushback from its seafood industry - a sign of the tricky balance it has to strike as it retaliates against its largest trading partner.

Both US and Canadian officials have said they would like to strike a deal, but no movement has been made to resume talks after they collapsed in late August.

Speaking to reporters last week, Prime Minister Mark Carney said that Canada is still in search of a deal with the US that is "durable" and in the best interests of both countries.

"We're ready to sit down and and strike that deal when the Americans are ready," Carney said.

US trade representative Jamieson Greer, meanwhile, said on Thursday that the ball is in Canada's court.

"We offered them the best deal, they looked at it square in the face and turned around," Greer said in an interview with Fox News, adding that there has been sparse communication with the Canadians since talks collapsed.

In a separate interview with Canadian broadcaster CBC, Greer cautioned against retaliation and suggested the US might hit back by banning the import of some Canadian products.

President Donald Trump threatened on Monday to halt all US business with Canada-based airplane maker Bombardier unless it moved its manufacturing south.

The company is one of the largest in the country, contributing over C$7bn to Canada's annual GDP in 2024, according to a report commissioned by Bombarier by public accounting firm PwC.

Trump took aim at Canada in a series of other Truth Social posts over the weekend, including one that called Canada's exchange rate with the US "unacceptable".

Another post showed a map of North America - including Canada and Mexico - and Greenland all overlaid with the US flag.

Canada and the US have the world's largest bilateral trading relationship valued at nearly $900bn in 2025.

With new US tariffs and Canadian counter-tariffs are now in effect, businesses on both side are scrambling to deal with what comes next.

The US currently has in place a 25% tax on Canadian cars and trucks, as well as taxes on Canadian steel, aluminium and lumber. In late August, President Donald Trump imposed new 50% tariffs on other goods like dairy, alcohol, hockey sticks and perfume.

Canada's counter-tariffs, which were described by Carney as "dollar-for-dollar", will be applied to hundreds of items coming in from the US as of midnight on Tuesday.

They are in addition to existing retaliatory taxes Canada...
body.zh: 加拿大对一系列美国商品的报复性关税于周二生效，但没有迹象表明即将达成贸易协议。 反关税将适用于价值近 280 亿加元（200 亿美元；150 亿英镑）的美国产品，从钢铁到家具再到棉质 T 恤，关税​​将高达 50%。 新鲜的鱼和龙虾也在名单上，但加拿大后来在受到其海鲜行业的抵制后将其排除在外——这表明加拿大在对其最大的贸易伙伴进行报复时必须取得微妙的平衡。 美国和加拿大官员均表示愿意达成协议，但自八月下旬谈判破裂后，尚未采取任何恢复谈判的行动。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼上周对记者表示，加拿大仍在寻求与美国达成一项“持久”且符合两国最佳利益的协议。 卡尼说：“当美国人准备好时，我们准备坐下来达成协议。” 与此同时，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔周四表示，球在加拿大这边。 格里尔在接受福克斯新闻采访时说：“我们向他们提供了最好的交易，他们正视了这个交易，然后转身离开。”他补充说，自谈判破裂以来，与加拿大方面的沟通很少。 在接受加拿大广播公司 CBC 的单独采访时，格里尔警告不要进行报复，并暗示美国可能会通过禁止进口某些加拿大产品进行反击。 唐纳德·特朗普总统周一威胁称，除非加拿大飞机制造商庞巴迪将其制造业务转移到南方，否则美国将停止与该公司的所有业务。 根据公共会计师事务所普华永道 (PwC) 委托庞巴利 (Bombarier) 委托编写的一份报告，该公司是加拿大最大的公司之一，到 2024 年将为加拿大的年度 GDP 贡献超过 70 亿加元。 特朗普周末在“真相社会”网站上发表了一系列其他帖子，矛头直指加拿大，其中一篇称加拿大与美国的汇率“不可接受”。 另一篇帖子展示了北美（包括加拿大和墨西哥）和格陵兰岛的地图，上面都覆盖着美国国旗。 加拿大和美国拥有世界上最大的双边贸易关系，到 2025 年价值将接近 9000 亿美元。 随着美国新关税和加拿大反关税现已生效，双方企业都在争先恐后地应对接下来发生的事情。 美国目前对加拿大汽车和卡车征收 25% 的税，并对加拿大钢铁、铝和木材征税。 8 月底，唐纳德·特朗普总统对乳制品、酒类、曲棍球棒和香水等其他商品征收 50% 的新关税。 卡尼将加拿大的反关税称为“一美元对一美元”，将从周二午夜开始对数百种来自美国的商品实施反关税。 它们是加拿大现有报复性税的补充……

reflection.en: The imposition of tariffs and counter-tariffs escalates economic tensions, impacting businesses and consumers. While nations may feel compelled to retaliate, the path to resolution often lies in dialogue and a commitment to finding common ground, even when negotiations are difficult. May wisdom guide leaders to pursue peace and stability in their trade...
reflection.zh: 关税和反制关税的实施加剧了经济紧张局势，影响着企业和消费者。尽管国家可能感到有必要进行报复，但解决之道往往在于对话和寻求共同点的承诺，即使谈判过程充满挑战。愿智慧引导领导者在其贸易关系中追求和平与稳定。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: North Korea and Russia open first road bridge linking both countries
title.zh: 朝鲜和俄罗斯开设两国首座公路桥梁

summary.en: North Korea and Russia have inaugurated their first road bridge, enhancing the movement of goods and people between the two nations. This development occurs amidst strengthened bilateral ties since the Ukraine war began, with both countries pledging mutual support against external aggression. However, concerns exist...
summary.zh: 朝鲜和俄罗斯已启用两国首座公路桥梁，便利了两国间的货物和人员往来。自乌克兰战争爆发以来，两国关系得到加强，双方均承诺在遭受外部侵略时相互支持。然而，有担忧认为该桥梁可能被用作秘密军事后勤通道，以援助俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争。

body.en:
The first road bridge linking Russia and North Korea has opened, allowing the two countries to more easily move cargo and passengers between their border across the Tumen river.

Pyongyang state media said the bridge will be used for "personnel exchanges, tourism and trade".

But Ukrainian investigative organisation Truth Hounds said the bridge is intended "primarily to establish a covert military logistics corridor" to support Russia in the Ukraine war.

It comes amid stronger ties between the countries since the start of the Ukraine war, with Russia's Putin and North Korea's Kim Jong Un previously pledging that they would help each other in the event of "aggression" against either country.

Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin described the bridge as a "new symbol of friendship", while North Korea's Prime Minister Pak Thae Song said it was a "historical event".

Up to 300 vehicles and 2,323 people can cross the bridge daily, Russian state news TASS reports.

Satellite imagery reported by the BBC in May this year showed the kilometre-long bridge alongside several new access roads, a border checkpoint, support infrastructure and parking facilities.

There are existing air links, as well as the rail link between the two countries, but until now the only road link was a makeshift solution where, by special arrangement, wooden planks were placed on the rail bridge to allow cars to travel over it, according to Reuters.

The Russian government said the bridge will initially be used to transport cargo, Reuters reported, before opening to passenger traffic later this year.

The bridge would provide, a "powerful impetus for the further development of trade, economic, scientific, technological and cultural cooperation," said Mishustin.

Appearing at the opening ceremony via video link, he described ties between Moscow and Pyongyang as being "at an unprecedented high level."

Researchers at South Korea's spy agency estimates that North Korea has already transferred $7 to 14 billion dollars' worth of rockets, missiles, artillery shells using ships. An estimated 11,000 North Korean troops are actively fighting Ukrainians in Russia .

Truth Hounds said in a recent statement that given the strategic partnership treaty between the two countries in 2024 - the bridge could be used to transport North Korean military personnel, construction workers and senior military officials directly to Russia.

It would also enable the flow of Russian technology and resources in the opposite direction".

Construction started in 2025, after the agreement to build the bridge was made during Putin's 2024 visit to North Korea , his first trip to the state in 24 years, which resulted in the partnership treaty. The bridge took 495 days to complete, after delays.

body.zh: 连接俄罗斯和朝鲜的第一座公路桥已经开通，使两国能够更轻松地跨图们江在两国边境之间运输货物和乘客。 平壤官方媒体称，这座桥将用于“人员交流、旅游和贸易”。 但乌克兰调查组织“真相猎犬”表示，这座桥的目的“主要是为了建立一条秘密军事后勤走廊”，以在乌克兰战争中支持俄罗斯。 自乌克兰战争爆发以来，两国关系更加紧密，俄罗斯总统普京和朝鲜领导人金正恩此前承诺，如果任何一个国家遭受“侵略”，他们将互相帮助。 俄罗斯总理米哈伊尔·米舒斯京将这座桥描述为“友谊的新象征”，而朝鲜总理朴泰成则表示这是一个“历史性事件”。 据俄罗斯国家新闻塔斯社报道，每天有多达 300 辆汽车和 2,323 人过桥。 BBC 今年 5 月报道的卫星图像显示，这座一公里长的桥梁旁边有几条新的道路、一个边境检查站、支持基础设施和停车设施。 据路透社报道，两国之间现有空中交通和铁路连接，但到目前为止，唯一的道路连接是一个临时解决方案，通过特殊安排，在铁路桥上放置了木板，以便汽车通过。 据路透社报道，俄罗斯政府表示，这座桥最初将用于运输货物，然后在今年晚些时候开放客运。 米舒斯京说，这座桥将为“贸易、经济、科技和文化合作的进一步发展提供强大动力”。 他通过视频出席开幕式，称莫斯科和平壤之间的关系“处于前所未有的高水平”。 韩国间谍机构的研究人员估计，朝鲜已经利用船只转移了价值 7 至 140 亿美元的火箭、导弹和炮弹。据估计，有 11,000 名朝鲜军队正在俄罗斯积极与乌克兰人作战。 “真相猎犬”组织在最近的一份声明中表示，鉴于两国将于 2024 年签署战略伙伴关系条约，该桥可用于将朝鲜军事人员、建筑工人和高级军事官员直接运送到俄罗斯。 它还将使俄罗斯技术和资源朝相反方向流动”。 普京在 2024 年访问朝鲜期间签署了修建这座桥梁的协议，这是他 24 年来首次访问朝鲜，并签署了伙伴关系条约，该项目于 2025 年开始施工。这座桥在延误之后花了 495 天才完工。 俄罗斯游客...

The prophet Isaiah envisioned a time when nations would 'beat their swords into plowshares,' a stark contrast to the potential militarization of new infrastructure. May leaders seek paths of genuine...
reflection.zh: 朝鲜与俄罗斯之间这座新桥梁的开通，在便利贸易的同时，也引发了其可能被用于军事后勤的担忧。先知以赛亚曾预见一个时代，那时列国将“把刀打成犁头”，这与新基础设施的潜在军事化形成了鲜明对比。愿领导人寻求真正和平与裁军的道路，将冲突的工具转变为合作的手段。

title.en: Trial over alleged murders of Australian surfer brothers starts in Mexico
title.zh: 澳大利亚冲浪兄弟在墨西哥被 alleged 谋杀案开庭审理

summary.en: The bodies of Jake and Callum Robinson and their US friend were found with gunshot wounds to their heads.
summary.zh: 杰克和卡勒姆·罗宾逊兄弟以及他们的一位美国朋友的尸体被发现时头部有枪伤。

body.en:
Three men have gone on trial in Mexico for the alleged murders of two Australian brothers and their American friend in 2024.

The bodies of Callum Robinson, his younger brother Jake, and their friend Carter Rhoad from California - all in their early 30s - were found at the bottom of a well with gunshot wounds to their heads, days after they went missing during a surf trip in Baja California.

Prosecutors are seeking jail sentences of more than 200 years for the defendants, who also face charges of violent robbery and auto theft.

The parents of the brothers were in court on Tuesday in the coastal town of Ensenada, telling the media that it was "incredibly important and overwhelmingly difficult".

"We want the men accused of murdering our sons to see, in person, the human consequences of what happened," Martin and Debra Robinson said in a statement, according to Australia's national broadcaster, the ABC.

"Callum and Jake were not simply victims in a case file - they were our sons, deeply loved by their family and friends, with lives, dreams and futures that were brutally taken away."

On the opening day, the accused - Jesús "El Kekas" Gerardo, Irineo Francisco and Ángel Jesús - were moved to a smaller courtroom amid accusations that some witnesses had been intimidated by people associated with the defendants.

Dozens of witnesses are expected to give evidence during the four-week, judge-only trial.

The 2024 alleged killings of the Robinson brothers and their US friend shocked Australians as well as many residents of the normally peaceful town of Ensenada.

Despite high levels of cartel violence in the northern Mexican border states, tourists are rarely targeted for such violent attacks in Baja California's surf towns.

The ex-girlfriend of one of the accused, Ari Gisell, became the first person to be convicted over the tourists' killings last year and was sentenced to 20 years in prison for her role in their murders.

Mexican prosecutors are pursuing jail sentences of more than 200 years for each of the defendants, as well as an additional 168-year sentence for the alleged ringleader.

Prosecutors say the victims were killed due to a bungled robbery, while the defence argued there was not enough evidence to prove that theory.

Callum Robinson was a member of Australia's national lacrosse team and lived in San Diego where he was a professional lacrosse player.

His younger brother Jake had travelled from Australia for the surf trip and was due to start a job as a doctor when he returned while their friend Rhoad was killed a few months before his wedding.
body.zh: 三名男子因涉嫌在 2024 年谋杀两名澳大利亚兄弟及其美国朋友而在墨西哥接受审判。 卡勒姆·罗宾逊 (Callum Robinson)、他的弟弟杰克 (Jake) 以及他们来自加利福尼亚州的朋友卡特·罗德 (Carter Rhoad) 的尸体均在 30 岁出头，他们在下加利福尼亚州冲浪之旅中失踪几天后，他们的尸体在井底被发现，头部受枪伤。 检察官正在寻求对被告判处 200 多年监禁，他们还面临暴力抢劫和汽车盗窃的指控。 周二，兄弟俩的父母在沿海小镇恩塞纳达出庭，对媒体表示，这“极其重要，也极其困难”。 据澳大利亚国家广播公司 ABC 报道，马丁和黛布拉·罗宾逊在一份声明中表示：“我们希望被指控谋杀我们儿子的人亲眼目睹所发生事件对人类造成的后果。” “卡勒姆和杰克不仅仅是案件档案中的受害者——他们是我们的儿子，深受家人和朋友的爱戴，但他们的生命、梦想和未来却被残酷地夺走。” 开庭当天，被告 Jesús“El Kekas”Gerardo、Irineo Francisco 和 Ángel Jesús 被转移到一个较小的法庭，因为有人指控一些证人受到与被告有关的人的恐吓。 预计数十名证人将在为期四个星期、只有法官参加的审判中提供证据。 2024 年，罗宾逊兄弟和他们的美国朋友被指控被杀，这件事震惊了澳大利亚人和平时平静的恩塞纳达镇的许多居民。 尽管墨西哥北部边境各州卡特尔暴力活动频繁，但在下加利福尼亚州的冲浪小镇，游客很少成为此类暴力袭击的目标。 其中一名被告人阿里·吉塞尔 (Ari Gisell) 的前女友去年成为第一个因杀害游客而被定罪的人，并因参与谋杀而被判处 20 年监禁。 墨西哥检察官正在寻求对每名被告判处 200 多年监禁，并对被指控的头目追加 168 年徒刑。 检察官表示，受害者因抢劫失利而被杀，而辩方则辩称没有足够的证据证明这一理论。 卡勒姆·罗宾逊是澳大利亚国家长曲棍球队的成员，住在圣地亚哥，是一名职业长曲棍球运动员。 他的弟弟杰克从澳大利亚来参加冲浪之旅，回来后本来打算开始一份医生的工作，而他们的朋友罗德在婚礼前几个月被杀。

reflection.en: The trial in Mexico for the alleged murders of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad brings to light the brutal reality of violence. The discovery of their bodies, bearing gunshot wounds to the head, is a stark reminder of the destructive cycle that ensnares humanity. Jesus himself warned against this path, stating, 'All...
reflection.zh: 在墨西哥，澳大利亚兄弟杰克和卡勒姆·罗宾逊以及他们的朋友卡特·罗德被 alleged 谋杀案的审判，揭示了暴力的残酷现实。他们被发现时头部有枪伤的尸体， stark 地提醒着我们人类陷入的破坏性循环。耶稣自己曾警告过这条道路，说：“凡动刀的，必死在刀下。”

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: 3 years on, Morocco earthquake victims still wait for help
title.zh: 三年后，摩洛哥地震幸存者仍在等待援助

summary.en: Three years after the 2023 Morocco earthquake, which killed nearly 3,000 people and devastated the Al Haouz region, some survivors are still living in tents. While reconstruction has progressed, local opinions are divided on the success and adequacy of state aid.
summary.zh: 2023年摩洛哥地震发生三年后，这场地震造成近3000人死亡，并摧毁了阿尔豪兹地区，但一些幸存者仍然住在帐篷里。虽然重建工作已经取得进展，但当地居民对援助的成功程度和国家援助的充分性意见不一。

body.en:
Reconstruction has progressed in the three years since the 2023 Morocco earthquake, but some survivors are still living in tents. Locals are divided as to how successful it's been, and whether state aid is enough.

On September 8, 2023, a devastating earthquake struck the Al Haouz region in Morocco , killing over 2,900 people, injuring more than 5,500  and causing widespread destruction.

In the village of Ighermane in the High Atlas Mountains, about 50 kilometers (30 miles) southwest of Marrakech, Mohamed Ait Belaid, 72, feels like things are actually going pretty well for him three years later.

He had been living in a tent after the earthquake  but now resides in a newly built house, even though it's smaller than the one destroyed in the earthquake.

"I benefited from partial [state] support and received 80,000 dirhams [around €7,300] for rebuilding," he told DW. "I added about 100,000 [€9,110] dirhams from my own pocket. And thanks to God, I like my new house and I'm comfortable in it. I'm at peace because my wife, my children and I are all healthy and I haven't lost any of them."

Around 40 kilometers away, in the town of Azgour, it's a different story. Larbi Ait Jelloulat, also 72, is sitting in front of a pile of rubble that was once his house.

"I want to know where my rights have gone," he said angrily. "Who took what's rightfully mine? For three years, I've been going from one department to another, from one complaint to another, from one petition to another, just looking for an answer. Why have I been excluded? Am I not a Moroccan citizen?"

Ait Jelloulat was formerly a council employee and saved for years in order to build the large home that was destroyed in the 2023 earthquake. As far as he can tell, bureaucratic issues mean he must prove he was a resident in the area.

"My only dream was to spend the rest of my life in my own home, a rest after years of service," he explained. "Now they say I'm not a resident … Where's the logic in that?"

Reconstruction seems to be happening faster in Ighermane, the village where Ait Belaid lives. About 90% of the village is rebuilt and most residents' lives are back to normal , said Omar Saeed from the Ighermane Association for Development and Solidarity.

Of the village's around 150 families, 114 received state support of some kind, although most also had to contribute some of their own money to rebuild.

Meanwhile, in Azgour, where Ait Jelloulat lives, there's been more to do. Azgour was the village most impacted by the earthquake in the area.

There, about 76 families have had help with reconstruction, Ait Jelloulat said, while 56 others are still waiting for help. "What's more, the 76 families who rebuilt their homes in a different location are also having problems connecting...
body.zh: 自2023年摩洛哥地震以来的三年里，重建工作不断取得进展，但一些幸存者仍然住在帐篷里。当地人对于它的成功程度以及国家援助是否足够存在分歧。 2023 年 9 月 8 日，摩洛哥豪兹地区发生毁灭性地震，造成 2,900 多人死亡、5,500 多人受伤，并造成大面积破坏。 在马拉喀什西南约 50 公里（30 英里）处的高阿特拉斯山脉的伊格曼村，72 岁的穆罕默德·艾特·贝莱德 (Mohamed Ait Belaid) 感觉三年后他的生活实际上进展顺利。 地震后他一直住在帐篷里，但现在住在一栋新建的房子里，尽管它比地震中被毁的房子小。 “我受益于部分[国家]支持，并收到了80,000迪拉姆[约7,300欧元]用于重建，”他告诉德国之声。 “我从自己的口袋里添加了大约 100,000 [€9,110] 迪拉姆。感谢上帝，我喜欢我的新房子，而且我在里面很舒服。我很平静，因为我的妻子、孩子和我都很健康，我没有失去任何一个。” 大约 40 公里外的阿兹古尔镇却是另一番景象。 同样 72 岁的拉尔比·艾特·杰鲁拉特 (Larbi Ait Jelloulat) 坐在一堆瓦砾前，这里曾经是他的房子。 “我想知道我的权利去了哪里，”他愤怒地说。 “谁拿走了我应得的东西？三年来，我从一个部门到另一个部门，从一份投诉到另一份投诉，从一份请愿书到另一份请愿书，只是在寻找答案。为什么我被排除在外？我不是摩洛哥公民吗？” 艾特·杰卢拉特 (Ait Jelloulat) 以前是一名市议会雇员，为了建造在 2023 年地震中被毁的大房子，他存了多年的钱。据他所知，官僚问题意味着他必须证明自己是该地区的居民。 “我唯一的梦想是在自己的家里度过余生，在服役多年后得到休息，”他解释道。 “现在他们说我不是居民……这有什么逻辑吗？” 艾特·贝莱德 (Ait Belaid) 居住的村庄伊格曼 (Ighermane) 的重建似乎进展得更快。伊格曼发展与团结协会的奥马尔·赛义德表示，该村庄约 90% 的面积已得到重建，大多数居民的生活已恢复正常。 该村约有 150 个家庭，其中 114 个家庭得到了某种形式的国家支持，不过大多数家庭还必须自掏腰包进行重建。 与此同时，在艾特·杰鲁拉特 (Ait Jellolat) 居住的阿兹古尔 (Azgour)，还有更多事情要做。阿兹古尔是该地区受地震影响最严重的村庄。 Ait Jelloulat 说，在那里，大约 76 个家庭获得了重建帮助，而其他 56 个家庭仍在等待帮助。 “此外，在不同地点重建家园的 76 个家庭也遇到了连接问题......

reflection.en: The earthquake in Morocco in 2023 brought immense suffering, and even after three years, the journey of recovery is ongoing for many. The image of survivors still living in tents is a stark reminder that the work of rebuilding lives and communities requires sustained compassion and action. We are called to advocate for those whose needs persist, ensuring...
reflection.zh: 2023年摩洛哥地震带来了巨大的痛苦，即使在三年后，许多人的康复之路仍在继续。幸存者仍然住在帐篷里的景象， starkly提醒我们，重建生活和社区的工作需要持续的怜悯和行动。我们被呼召为那些需求持续存在的人们发声，确保他们不被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Nicaragua challenges German arms exports to Israel at ICJ
title.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在海牙国际法院提起诉讼

summary.en: Nicaragua has accused Germany of violating the Genocide Convention by supplying arms to Israel and has asked the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to take up the case. Germany has requested the ICJ dismiss the case on jurisdictional grounds, stating its arms exports are documented, published, and subject to...
summary.zh: 尼加拉瓜指控德国违反《灭绝种族公约》，向以色列供应武器，并已请求国际法院（ICJ）受理此案。德国则要求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案，并表示其武器出口均有记录、已公开且受到严格审查。

body.zh: 德国已请求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案。它还表示，其向以色列的武器出口是有记录、公开的，并且受到比大多数国家更严格的检查。 德国周一要求国际法院驳回尼加拉瓜提起的诉讼，指控柏林在加沙与哈马斯的战争中向以色列提供武器，违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》。 如果国际法院（也称为世界法院）决定审理此案，整个过程可能需要数年时间，并且取决于海牙单独的加沙相关案件的调查结果。 但德国辩称，它甚至不应该走那么远，称尼加拉瓜没有遵循适当的程序，而且该争端不属于国际法院的管辖范围。 另一方面，尼加拉瓜认为应该审理此案，因为它和德国都是《种族灭绝公约》的签署国——尽管双方都没有直接参与以色列和哈马斯在加沙的战争，而且国际法院关于以色列是否在加沙实施种族灭绝行为的听证会可能需要数年时间。 尼加拉瓜指责德国向以色列出售武器，协助和教唆加沙种族灭绝，并称其中一些武器已在加沙使用。 2024 年加沙战争最激烈时，最初申请紧急禁令停止出口的努力失败了，但德国也未能尽早立即永久驳回此案。 由于冲突持续且伤亡数字上升，德国政府于 2025 年暂停向以色列出口武器约三个月。但自去年年底达成休战以来，以色列又重新启动了这些行动，该休战基本上停止了战斗，但以色列的袭击并未完全结束。 一方面，1948 年《种族灭绝公约》在很大程度上是从大屠杀的教训和二战后“不再发生”的精神中诞生的。但出于同样的原因，德国始终寻求与以色列保持密切的合作关系，以色列的国家在很大程度上是由于大规模灭绝欧洲犹太人而形成的。它认为以色列的安全是其作为现代民主国家存在的理由的一部分。 哈马斯于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动恐怖袭击后，以色列在加沙发动了针对哈马斯的战争。 10 月 7 日是自大屠杀以来犹太人死亡人数最多的一天。哈马斯是一个总部位于加沙地带的巴勒斯坦伊斯兰组织。 德国辩称，该案应根据程序理由驳回，而尼加拉瓜关于协助和教唆种族灭绝的指控没有事实根据。 尽管德国、尼加拉瓜和以色列都...

reflection.en: The news of Nicaragua challenging Germany at the International Court of Justice over arms exports to Israel highlights the complex global dynamics of conflict and accountability. In times of war, the world often looks for divine intervention to cease hostilities and dismantle instruments of destruction. Psalm 46:9 speaks to this hope, envisioning a future...
reflection.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在国际法院提起诉讼的消息，凸显了冲突与问责在全球范围内的复杂动态。在战争时期，世界常常寻求神圣的干预来停止敌对行动并拆除毁灭的工具。《诗篇》46:9 呼应了这一希望，描绘了一个武器被废弃、和平得以实现的未来。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: War criminal Ratko Mladic buried with military honors in Belgrade, Serbia
title.zh: 战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德获军事荣誉下葬

summary.en: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, took place shortly before President Vucic was expected to call an election, and was attended by thousands of mourners.
summary.zh: 曾因斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪被定罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已在贝尔格莱德下葬。葬礼通过电视直播，在武契奇总统预计将宣布大选前不久举行，有数千名悼念者参加。

body.en:
Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, comes just days before President Vucic is expected to call an election.

Several thousand people lined the streets of Belgrade on Monday to follow the funeral service and burial of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic .

Earlier in the day, Serbian Patriarch Porfirije personally officiated at the funeral service for the former general,  who died while serving a life sentence in The Hague for genocide in Srebrenica and other war crimes committed during the violent breakup of Yugoslavia in the 1990s.

In accordance with his wishes, Mladic was laid to rest at Topcider Cemetery beside his daughter, who died by suicide in 1994.

Informer TV, a staunchly pro-government broadcaster, carried live coverage of what it described as a "magnificent farewell," without mentioning the roughly 8,000 Bosniak civilians and prisoners massacred by Mladic's Bosnian Serb forces in Srebrenica in July 1995 .

President Aleksandar Vucic did not attend the funeral, citing a previously scheduled visit by his counterpart from Uzbekistan.

Observers say that the president has tried to chart a middle course on the issue of Mladic's funeral.

Mladic was not buried with state honors, but with military honors, with Vucic insisting that the state was merely respecting the wishes of the family and ensuring a dignified burial.

"Were we supposed to forbid people from attending, forbid the funeral itself and create dog cemeteries?" he said in response to criticism from the EU .

The phrase "dog cemeteries" refers in Serbia to the unmarked graves of so-called "enemies of the people" who were executed by Yugoslav partisans during and immediately after World War II.

Vucic was equally dismissive of the decision by EU Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos to cancel a planned visit to Belgrade , calling her reaction "stupid." He has brushed aside other criticism of the public glorification of Mladic in much the same way.

An EU spokesman said in a statement that "Any glorification of war criminals, genocide denial and revisionism contradict the most fundamental European values and have no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries."

For Vucic, who has long sought to balance Serbia between the European Union and Russia, the situation is politically delicate.

He is expected to call a snap parliamentary election as early as this week. The poll is likely to take place on October 25.

For the first time in years, there is a credible possibility that his ruling bloc could be defeated by the student movement , which has led anti-government protests in Serbia for nearly two years now.

body.zh: 被判在斯雷布雷尼察犯有种族灭绝罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已被埋葬在贝尔格莱德。葬礼在电视上现场直播，就在武契奇总统预计将举行选举的几天前举行。 周一，数千人聚集在贝尔格莱德街头，参加前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼和埋葬仪式。 当天早些时候，塞尔维亚宗主教波尔菲里耶亲自为这位前将军主持了葬礼。这位将军因在 1990 年代南斯拉夫暴力解体期间犯下的斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪和其他战争罪而被判无期徒刑，在海牙服刑时去世。 按照姆拉迪奇的遗愿，姆拉迪奇被安葬在托普西德公墓，他的女儿于1994年自杀身亡。 坚定支持政府的广播公司 Informer TV 现场报道了一场自称为“盛大告别”的活动，但没有提及 1995 年 7 月在斯雷布雷尼察姆拉迪奇的波斯尼亚塞族军队屠杀的大约 8,000 名波斯尼亚平民和囚犯。 亚历山大·武契奇总统没有出席葬礼，理由是乌兹别克斯坦总统此前计划来访。 观察人士称，总统试图在姆拉迪奇的葬礼问题上制定中间路线。 姆拉迪奇的安葬不是以国家荣誉，而是以军事荣誉，武契奇坚称国家只是尊重家人的意愿并确保安葬有尊严。 “我们是否应该禁止人们参加、禁止葬礼本身并建立狗墓地？”他是在回应欧盟的批评时如此说道。 在塞尔维亚，“狗墓地”一词指的是在第二次世界大战期间和战后不久被南斯拉夫游击队处决的所谓“人民的敌人”的无标记坟墓。 武契奇同样对欧盟扩大委员玛塔·科斯取消计划访问贝尔格莱德的决定不屑一顾，称她的反应“愚蠢”。他以同样的方式驳回了其他对公开颂扬姆拉迪奇的批评。 欧盟发言人在一份声明中表示，“任何美化战犯、否认种族灭绝和修正主义的行为都违背了最基本的欧洲价值观，在欧盟或欧盟候选国中都没有立足之地。” 对于长期以来一直寻求在欧盟和俄罗斯之间平衡塞尔维亚的武契奇来说，局势在政治上很微妙。 预计他最早将于本周召开提前议会选举。投票可能于 10 月 25 日进行。 多年来第一次，他的统治集团有可能被学生运动击败，近两年来，学生运动在塞尔维亚引发了反政府抗议活动。 武契奇预计将成为他的塞尔维亚人名单中的首位......

reflection.en: The funeral of Ratko Mladic, a man convicted of genocide, was marked by military honors in Belgrade. This event raises profound questions about justice and accountability, particularly when such figures are celebrated rather than condemned. The prophet Habakkuk lamented a similar breakdown of justice, crying out, "The law is paralyzed, and justice never...
reflection.zh: 曾被判犯有种族灭绝罪的拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德举行了军事葬礼。这一事件引发了关于正义和问责的深刻问题，尤其是在此类人物受到颂扬而非谴责的时候。先知哈巴谷曾哀叹类似的司法败坏，呼喊说：“律法被废弃，公理永不显露。因为恶人围困义人，所以公理被屈枉了。”

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Pakistan: Can creating new provinces fix governance?
title.zh: 巴基斯坦：设立新省份能否解决治理问题？

summary.en: Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution. A debate has reignited over whether the current four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people, with proposals ranging...
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为国家需要更有效和响应迅速的政府，但许多人质疑仅仅设立更多省份是否是解决方案。关于该国目前的四省制能否有效治理近2.6亿人口的争论再次兴起，提议包括设立12至15个新省份或赋予县级政府权力。

body.en:
Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution.

A politically sensitive debate has reignited in Pakistan over whether its four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people.  

Ahsan Iqbal, minister for planning and development, recently called for a national political debate on administrative reform. He proposed creating 12 to 15 new provinces or setting up 160 empowered district governments to improve governance and the delivery of public services.

Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who first raised the idea of an administrative "reset" in July, said on Saturday that any new administrative units should be created with public support.

Defense Minister Khawaja Asif, meanwhile, has called for greater decentralization and devolution of power to the grassroots.

Despite the growing calls to create new provinces, no formal decision has been taken.

Even within the ruling coalition, there is disagreement over how and when such reforms should be pursued.

There are also questions about whether creating smaller provinces improves governance, or whether devolving power directly to local governments would be more effective.

Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether creating more provinces is the solution.

"Smaller provinces are not a substitute for empowered local governments. Even with smaller provinces, you will still need empowered local governments to make the system effective and improve service delivery to the people," Miftah Ismail, a former finance minister and economist, told DW.

Supporters of creating more provinces argue that Pakistan's four existing provinces — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , and Balochistan — have become too large and overly centralized.

Iqbal, the planning minister, has argued that the existing system has not delivered adequate improvements in health, education, and other social services.

Interior Minister Naqvi, on the other hand, has called for an administrative structure that is better suited to Pakistan's growing population.

"Without effective local governments, whether there is one province or 25, decision-making will remain centralized at the provincial level," Abid Qaiyum Suleri, executive director of the Sustainable Development Policy Institute, an Islamabad-based think tank, told DW. 

He said any proposal for new provinces or administrative units should be assessed against potential improvements in local tax collection and the costs of creating new provincial institutions, including secretariats, assemblies, and bureaucracies. 

Suleri stressed that it should also...
body.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑简单地设立更多省份是否就是解决方案。 巴基斯坦重新引发了一场政治敏感的争论，争论的焦点是其四省制能否有效治理这个拥有约2.6亿人口的国家。 规划和发展部长阿赫桑·伊克巴尔最近呼吁就行政改革进行全国政治辩论。他提议创建 12 至 15 个新省份或设立 160 个授权地区政府，以改善治理和公共服务的提供。 内政部长莫辛·纳克维 (Mohsin Naqvi) 在 7 月份首次提出行政“重置”的想法，他周六表示，任何新的行政单位的创建都应得到公众的支持。 与此同时，国防部长卡瓦贾·阿西夫呼吁加强权力下放，并将权力下放到基层。 尽管创建新省份的呼声越来越高，但尚未做出正式决定。 即使在执政联盟内部，对于如何以及何时进行此类改革也存在分歧。 还有一些问题是，创建较小的省份是否可以改善治理，或者将权力直接下放给地方政府是否会更有效。 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑设立更多省份是否是解决方案。 前财政部长兼经济学家米夫塔·伊斯梅尔（Miftah Ismail）对德国之声表示：“较小的省份并不能取代地方政府的授权。即使是规模较小的省份，你仍然需要地方政府的授权来使系统有效并改善为人民提供的服务。” 创建更多省份的支持者认为，巴基斯坦现有的四个省——旁遮普省、信德省、开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省和俾路支省——已经变得太大且过于集中。 规划部长伊克巴尔认为，现有的体系没有在卫生、教育和其他社会服务方面带来足够的改善。 另一方面，内政部长纳克维则呼吁建立一个更适合巴基斯坦不断增长的人口的行政结构。 伊斯兰堡智库可持续发展政策研究所执行主任阿比德·盖尤姆·苏莱里（Abid Qaiyum Suleri）告诉德国之声：“如果没有有效的地方政府，无论是一个省还是25个省，决策仍将集中在省一级。” 他表示，任何关于新省或行政单位的提议都应根据地方税收征收的潜在改进以及建立新省级机构（包括秘书处、议会和官僚机构）的成本进行评估。 苏莱里强调，还应该...

reflection.en: The debate in Pakistan over administrative reform highlights a deep-seated desire for better governance and public services. As leaders consider restructuring the nation, the ancient prophetic call to "execute justice and righteousness" serves as a timeless reminder of the core duties of leadership. True reform lies not just in administrative changes, but...
reflection.zh: 巴基斯坦关于行政改革的辩论凸显了对更好治理和公共服务的深切渴望。当领导人考虑国家结构调整时，古老的先知呼吁“施行公平和公义”，提醒人们领导者的核心职责。真正的改革不仅在于行政上的改变，更在于为所有公民切实地施行公义。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods
title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水近两周后又一名澳大利亚人被找到

summary.en: An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe following the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago. At least 1,399 people were killed and over 5,400 are missing in Nepal and Tibet, including around 800 foreigners.
summary.zh: 在近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水之后，一名在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。尼泊尔和西藏至少有1399人死亡，超过5400人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 近两周前席卷该地区的灾难性洪水后，一名身在尼泊尔的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。 据 SBS 新闻了解，这名澳大利亚人无法联系上，但今天确认他们安全无恙，不需要领事协助。 8月26日尼泊尔和西藏发生的泥石流和洪水造成至少1,399人死亡，5,400多人失踪，其中包括约800名外国人。 一群失踪亲人的澳大利亚家庭周日发表声明，呼吁旅游团和当局提高透明度。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们对澳大利亚联邦警察和寻找失踪澳大利亚人的搜救队表示感谢，但批评澳大利亚政府未能提供答案。 联邦政府已派出救灾响应小组和其他专业资源前往加德满都协助搜寻。 它还承诺提供 1100 万美元来支持救灾，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞周一表示，这对国家具有重要意义。 数百名水电工人失踪，但其中三人从隧道深处获救——周五是两名尼泊尔人，周六是一名中国男子——这让人们燃起了更多生还的希望。 8月26日，尼泊尔和中国边境的一座冰川崩塌成河，至少11个水电项目被吞没，这些项目的隧道入口被瓦砾和泥土掩埋，并切断了被困人员的通道。 当局周二表示，尼泊尔的救援人员正在重点关注三个水电项目隧道，他们认为那里可能有数十名工人被困。 “我们的搜索行动主要是寻找幸存者，包括在隧道中寻找幸存者。我们更关注的是 Chilime 水力发电项目，我们相信那里有人被困，因为那里有食堂、住所和食物安排，”该国灾害管理局局长 Dharma Raj Upreti 告诉路透社。 为尼泊尔救援队提供咨询的澳大利亚隧道救援专家阿诺德·迪克斯表示，这次行动带来了前所未有的挑战。 “这不是一次救援，而是多次潜在的救援，在不同的时间、不同的地点同时展开，每一次都有自己的危险、不确定性和仍然可以挽救的生命。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods that claimed over 1,300 lives and left thousands missing, the news of one Australian found safe offers a glimmer of hope. This moment of relief for one family echoes the biblical promise that weeping may last for a night, but joy comes with the morning.
reflection.zh: 在造成1300多人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水灾难中，一名澳大利亚人被找到的消息带来了希望的曙光。这个家庭的解脱时刻，呼应了圣经的应许：哭泣或许会持续一夜，但喜乐必在早晨来到。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏灾难如何成为中国“净网”运动的最新牺牲品
