body.en: The online campaign used to focus on tackling cybercrime and hacking but has since expanded to suppress information that differs from official narratives Tsering Phuntsok watched news of the Nepal-Tibet flood unfold from thousands of miles away in southern India. The 46-year-old Tibetan in exile has missing family members on both sides of the border; those in Nepal are named in official government lists, but in Tibet he has received no information. “I have started praying for the lost ones now. I have to accept they will not return [because] … I’m not getting any information.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 这场在线运动过去的重点是打击网络犯罪和黑客攻击，但后来扩大到压制与官方叙述不同的信息。次仁平措在千里之外的印度南部观看了尼泊尔西藏洪水的新闻。 46岁流亡藏人在边境两侧都有家人失踪；尼泊尔的那些人被列入政府官方名单，但在西藏，他没有收到任何信息。 “我现在开始为失踪的人祈祷。我必须接受他们不会回来的事实，[因为]……我没有得到任何信息。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the wake of the Nepal-Tibet disaster, Tsering Phuntsok faces a double tragedy: the potential loss of family members and the silencing of information. His inability to confirm their fate due to China's 'Clean Internet' campaign leaves him in agonizing uncertainty. This situation calls to mind the ancient call to 'speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏灾难之后，丹增·普措面临着双重悲剧：可能失去家人以及信息被噤声。由于中国“净网”运动，他无法确认家人的命运，这让他陷入痛苦的不确定之中。这种情况令人想起古老的呼吁：“为那些不能说话的人辩护，为所有贫困者伸张正义”（箴言31:8-9），敦促我们为那些声音被故意压制的人们发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: The US now has access to more than half Australia’s military bases – could it drag the country unwillingly into war?
title.zh: 美国现在可以进入澳大利亚一半以上的军事基地——这是否可能将该国不情愿地拖入战争？

summary.en: Exclusive reports reveal that US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to over 100 facilities across Australia. Some analysts liken this extensive presence to a 'colonisation' of Australia's military capabilities, with new data mapping the significant US militarisation on Australian soil.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露，美国控制的武器公司和部队在澳大利亚拥有超过100个设施的控制权或使用权。一些分析人士将这种广泛的存在比作对澳大利亚军事力量的“殖民化”，新的数据显示了澳大利亚本土美国军事化的程度。

body.en: Exclusive: US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to more than 100 facilities across the continent, which some analysts describe as a ‘colonisation’ of Australia’s military. Find a map of them here US military presence in Australia, mapped – video Why can the US access so many Australian military bases? – podcast US military interests control or have access to more than 100 defence facilities on Australian soil, in what some analysts describe as a “saturation” – even a “colonisation” – of the Australian continent. New data compiled by the Nautilus Institute and published by Guardian Australia maps the extent of US militarisation. The US military controls 17 facilities on mainland Australia and has access to 75 more Australian-run military installations. US defence corporations have access to an additional 18. Gathering intelligence, accessing satellite data for targeting information and communications intercepts. Training, including for 2,500 marines on dry-season rotation in the Northern Territory. Pre-positioning warfighting assets such as Osprey aircraft. Logistics hubs holding weapons, munitions and fuel, stored in case of a war in the Pacific. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：美国控制的武器公司和部队控制或进入了整个非洲大陆的 100 多个设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚军队的“殖民化”。在这里找到它们的地图 美国在澳大利亚的军事存在，已绘制 - 视频 为什么美国可以进入如此多的澳大利亚军事基地？ – 播客 美国军事利益集团控制或有权使用澳大利亚领土上的 100 多个防御设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚大陆的“饱和”，甚至是“殖民化”。鹦鹉螺研究所编制并由澳大利亚卫报发布的新数据绘制了美国军事化的程度。美国军方控制着澳大利亚大陆的 17 个设施，并有权使用另外 75 个澳大利亚管理的军事设施。美国国防公司可以使用额外的 18 个卫星数据来收集情报、访问卫星数据以进行目标信息和通信拦截。训练，包括为 2,500 名海军陆战队员在北领地进行旱季轮换训练。预先部署鱼鹰飞机等作战资产。储存武器、弹药和燃料的后勤中心，以防太平洋发生战争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The extensive US military presence across Australia, with access to over 100 facilities, raises profound questions about national sovereignty and the potential for entanglement in distant conflicts. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint, a hope for a world where military might is transformed into instruments of...
reflection.zh: 美国在澳大利亚广泛的军事存在，拥有超过100个设施的使用权，引发了关于国家主权和卷入遥远冲突的潜在问题的深刻疑问。以赛亚关于列国将刀打成犁头的异象提供了一个对照，一个关于军事力量被转化为和平与生产力工具的世界的希望。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China ‘colonises’ supply chains, industry warns
title.zh: 欧盟面临30万个工厂工作岗位流失，行业警告中国“殖民”供应链

summary.en: An industry trade body has warned that job losses in EU manufacturing will increase significantly unless Brussels addresses the "colonisation" of industry by Chinese component manufacturers. Eurometal forecasts 300,000 manufacturing job losses by the end of 2026 due to escalating competition from China, which...
summary.zh: 一家行业贸易机构警告称，除非布鲁塞尔解决中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民”问题，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将急剧增加。欧洲金属公司预测，到2026年底，由于来自中国的竞争加剧，制造业将损失30万个工作岗位，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差已达到创纪录的每日10亿欧元。

body.en: Protest using 10 coffins to symbolise struggling manufacturing industry to take place in Brussels Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers, a leading industry trade body has warned. Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一家领先的行业贸易机构警告说，除非布鲁塞尔停止中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民化”，否则布鲁塞尔将举行用十具棺材象征陷入困境的制造业的抗议活动，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将迅速增加。欧洲金属网预计，由于来自中国的竞争不断加剧，2026 年剩余时间制造业将有 30 万个就业岗位流失，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差每天达到创纪录的 10 亿欧元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning of 300,000 job losses in the EU manufacturing sector due to intense competition from China raises profound questions about economic justice and fairness. The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: China prepares £40bn stimulus for financial sector amid fears over sluggish growth
title.zh: 中国准备推出400亿英镑刺激措施以提振金融业，因担忧增长乏力

summary.en: Beijing plans to inject $54 billion (£40 billion) into its financial sector, aiming to support banks and insurers amidst concerns over faltering economic growth. The funds will come from state institutions and are intended to help replenish cash reserves and bolster investment in the stock market.
summary.zh: 北京计划向其金融业注入540亿美元（400亿英镑），旨在支持银行和保险公司应对经济增长乏力的问题。这笔资金将来自国家机构，用于补充现金储备并提振股市投资。

body.en: Beijing wants banks and insurers to bolster investment in stock market as it helps to replenish cash reserves China will inject $54bn (£40bn) into its financial sector as Beijing attempts to shore up banks and insurers in the face of faltering economic growth. A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北京希望银行和保险公司加强对股市的投资，以帮助补充现金储备 随着北京试图在经济增长放缓的情况下支撑银行和保险公司，中国将向其金融部门注资 540 亿美元（400 亿英镑）。许多金融机构表示，它们将从财政部甚至烟草专卖公司等国家机构获得数十亿元人民币的资金。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of economic headwinds, China is mobilizing significant capital to stabilize its financial markets. This action raises questions about the stewardship of national resources and the pursuit of economic justice. The prophet Micah reminds us that true governance involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that...
reflection.zh: 面对经济逆风，中国正动用巨额资金来稳定其金融市场。这一举措引发了关于国家资源管理和追求经济公正的疑问。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的治理在于秉公行义、喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行——这些原则为经济政策提供了永恒的标准。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: No bailouts for Jaguar Land Rover amid reports of thousands of job cuts, says minister
title.zh: 捷豹路虎面临裁员数千人的报道，部长称不会提供纾困金

summary.en: Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), facing challenges from trade tariffs and domestic competitors, is reportedly planning up to 4,000 job cuts. The UK government has indicated it will not use taxpayer funds to prevent these layoffs, with the business secretary stating that intervening in business operations is not his role,...
summary.zh: 捷豹路虎（JLR）正面临贸易关税和国内竞争的挑战，据报道计划裁员多达4000人。英国政府已表明不会动用纳税人的资金来阻止这些裁员，商务大臣在与工会领袖和政府官员进行关键会谈前表示，干预企业运营并非他的职责。

body.en: Carmaker, which is battling Trump tariffs and Chinese competitors, faces talks with union leaders and government The government has signalled that it will not invest taxpayers’ money to limit job losses at Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), after it emerged that the UK’s biggest carmaker is planning up to 4,000 redundancies . Before crunch talks on Tuesday between JLR, union leaders and government officials, the business secretary, Jonathan Reynolds, said it was not his job to “intervene and run businesses”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 正在与特朗普关税和中国竞争对手作斗争的汽车制造商面临与工会领导人和政府的谈判。在英国最大的汽车制造商计划裁员多达 4,000 人后，政府已表示不会投入纳税人的钱来限制捷豹路虎 (JLR) 的裁员。在周二捷豹路虎、工会领导人和政府官员举行重要会谈之前，商务大臣乔纳森·雷诺兹表示，“干预和经营企业”不是他的工作。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news about Jaguar Land Rover's potential job cuts and the government's refusal to intervene raises questions about corporate responsibility and the role of leadership. Micah 6:8 calls for leaders to 'act justly and to love mercy,' reminding us that economic decisions have profound human consequences. May leaders always seek wisdom to balance economic...
reflection.zh: 关于捷豹路虎潜在的裁员以及政府不愿干预的消息，引发了对企业责任和领导层角色的思考。弥迦书6:8呼吁领导者“施行公平，喜爱慈爱”，提醒我们经济决策会对人们产生深远的影响。愿领导者们在平衡经济现实与对受影响工人的怜悯之心时，常寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The world is being driven to the brink by thugs and dictators, but there is a route to a brighter future | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 世界被暴徒和独裁者推向边缘，但通往更光明未来的道路依然存在

summary.en: The article posits that the world is currently facing numerous crises, including unending wars, humanitarian emergencies, rising authoritarianism, economic inequality, and climate breakdown, leading some analysts to believe we are in the midst of a third world war. However, it suggests that ordinary people possess...
summary.zh: 文章认为，世界正面临着无数危机，包括无休止的战争、人道主义紧急状况、日益增长的威权主义、经济不平等和气候崩溃，一些分析人士甚至认为我们正处于第三次世界大战之中。然而，文章也指出，普通人拥有比他们想象中更大的力量，可以引领世界走向更光明的未来。

body.en: It’s no surprise some analysts say we are already in the midst of the third world war, but ordinary people have more power than we think Don’t look up! The world is a mess. The sky could fall in any day. Unending wars, expanding humanitarian crises, rising authoritarianism, dysfunctional democracies, rampant racial and religious extremism, and unchecked lawlessness cast a dark cloud as the west’s new political year begins. Set all that against a backdrop of staggering global economic inequality, corporate and individual greed, irresponsible government indebtedness, dangerous AI gambles, climate breakdown and proliferating nuclear weapons, and a truly apocalyptic global outlook begins to take shape. It’s enough to make anyone shut their eyes, cover their ears and utter a Munch-like scream. And it’s only getting worse. Democratic leaders who promise a better, safer, more optimistic future – what Britain’s freshly arrived prime minister, Andy Burnham, calls a “ new era of possibility ” – cannot escape this wider international context. Last week’s global bond market upheaval , sparked by external factors, left Burnham’s cash-strapped government struggling with sharply increased borrowing costs before he barely got started. The fact he chose Ukraine for his first overseas trip, while symbolically important, highlighted another grim reality. As a lead opponent of Vladimir Putin’s invasion, Britain now finds itself in a de facto state of war with Russia – and facing attack. Argentina, too, is eyeing UK defence vulnerabilities . These are not the sort of possibilities Burnham envisaged. Continue reading...
body.zh: 毫不奇怪，一些分析人士说，我们已经处于第三次世界大战之中，但普通人拥有比我们想象的更多的力量，不要抬头！世界一团糟。天随时可能塌下来。无休无止的战争、不断扩大的人道主义危机、日益抬头的威权主义、功能失调的民主国家、猖獗的种族和宗教极端主义以及不受约束的违法行为，在西方新的政治一年开始之际，蒙上了一层乌云。在全球经济严重不平等、企业和个人贪婪、不负责任的政府债务、危险的人工智能赌博、气候崩溃和核武器扩散的背景下，真正的世界末日般的全球前景开始形成。这足以让任何人闭上眼睛，捂住耳朵，发出蒙克式的尖叫声。而且情况只会变得更糟。民主党领导人许诺一个更好、更安全、更乐观的未来 — — 英国新任首相安迪·伯纳姆称之为“充满可能性的新时代” — — 无法摆脱这个更广泛的国际背景。上周由外部因素引发的全球债券市场动荡，让资金短缺的伯纳姆政府在刚刚开始执政之前就陷入了借贷成本急剧上升的困境。他选择乌克兰作为他的第一次海外访问，虽然具有重要的象征意义，但也凸显了另一个严峻的现实。作为弗拉基米尔·普京入侵的主要反对者，英国现在发现自己与俄罗斯处于事实上的战争状态 — — 并面临攻击。阿根廷也正在关注英国国防的弱点。这些不是伯纳姆设想的那种可能性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author paints a grim picture of global affairs, citing 'thugs and dictators' and 'unending wars' as driving forces toward a precipice. In such times, the temptation to despair or retaliate can be strong. Yet, the call remains to actively choose good over evil, refusing to be consumed by the darkness, and instead, to embody hope and constructive action.
reflection.zh: 作者描绘了一幅严峻的全球局势图景，指出“暴徒和独裁者”以及“无休止的战争”正将世界推向悬崖边缘。在这样的时代，绝望或报复的诱惑可能很强烈。然而，我们仍然被呼召要积极地以善胜恶，拒绝被黑暗吞噬，而是要体现希望和建设性的行动。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: How Australia hopes to help the nation that's accused China of 'weaponising tourism'
title.zh: 中国被指控影响太平洋的方式出人意料

summary.en: As Palau faces renewed criticism from China, its president is seeking Australian assistance to diversify its primary economic source, tourism.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次面临中国的批评之际，其总统正寻求澳大利亚的援助，以实现其主要经济来源——旅游业的多元化。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don't need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They're harmless, Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: "This is my office", he declares.

It's in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders' meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of "theft" and "a dangerous local marine environment".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was "unfortunate" that Beijing was "weaponising tourism", an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

"We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other's treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that," Whipps said.

"Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other."

Palau's ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn't the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

"We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between," Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a "tourism ban". By 2019, Palau's total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Despite the CCP's efforts, Chinese visitors are slowly increasing post-pandemic, with many instead taking flights to Palau via Hong Kong.

"We've learned to be more resilient against these different shocks...

title.en: Can communities be protected from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 融化的冰川能保护社区免受灾害吗？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives. High mountain glaciers are retreating and becoming unstable as climate change causes them to melt, leading to events...
summary.zh: 不断上升的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以挽救生命的工具。高山冰川正在退缩并变得不稳定，因为气候变化导致它们融化，从而引发了8月26日尼泊尔和西藏的“山体海啸”等事件，威胁着数千人的生命。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些成分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

The melting glaciers and resulting 'mountain tsunamis' are not just environmental events, but signs of a world in distress, awaiting healing. As we witness these impacts, we are reminded of the deep interconnectedness of all things and the urgent...
reflection.zh: 来自尼泊尔和西藏的新闻描绘了一幅严峻的画面，显示受气候变化影响的受造界正在呻吟。融化的冰川和由此产生的“山体海啸”不仅仅是环境事件，更是世界痛苦的迹象，等待着治愈。当我们目睹这些影响时，我们被提醒万物之间深刻的相互联系，以及对关怀和修复的迫切需要。

title.en: 'We are not the AfD': Barnaby Joyce rejects German far-right question
title.zh: “我们不是德国选择党”：巴纳比·乔伊斯否认与德国极右翼有关联

summary.en: Australian MP Barnaby Joyce has stated that One Nation is not aligned with Germany's far-right party, the AfD, following the latter's significant win in a German state election. The AfD, classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence, faces isolation as other parties refuse to cooperate with them.
summary.zh: 在德国极右翼政党德国选择党（AfD）在一场州选举中取得显著胜利后，澳大利亚议员巴纳比·乔伊斯表示，他的政党“一人党”（One Nation）与德国选择党无关。德国选择党被国内情报机构归类为“极右翼极端分子”，由于其他政党拒绝与其合作，该党在组建政府方面面临困难。

body.en:
Barnaby Joyce has sought to distance One Nation from the Alternative for Germany party (AfD), after the far-right, anti-immigration group's state election win on Sunday.

At a German state election in east-central Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD surged into first place, winning 44 per cent of the vote and delivering a significant blow to Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservatives, while short of an overall majority.

The AfD, which has been classified as 'far-right extremist' by domestic intelligence agencies, will have a difficult time forming government as other parties have said they will refuse to cooperate.

The party is seeking to secure a foothold for advancing its agenda, which includes heavy restrictions on immigration, restoring ties with ‌Russia, cutting support to Ukraine and quitting the euro.

The election win has placed a far-right party within reach of power at the state level in Germany for the first time since World War Two.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's the latest indication of a surge in far-right populism across Europe over recent years.

Asked whether One Nation was taking anything from the German populist party's victory, Joyce said: "I'm not — We are not the AfD. That is a different party."

"I have a completely different view about the AfD than I would to ... say Giorgia Meloni in Italy, who is just a very direct and competent lady doing a good job."

The member for New England went on to list several world leaders and the Donald Trump-linked MAGA movement described as right-wing populists: "Well, I don't see (the UK's Reform leader Nigel Farage) as dangerous at all ... the MAGA movement, they're just conservatives, and they're deciding now whether Trump's in them or not ... Then [2027 French presidential hopeful Marine] Le Pen... I suppose Le Pen is slightly to the right but, you know, tolerable."

"We are very aware of what fascism does; it's a disgusting, horrendous thing, and it's got nothing to do with One Nation or anything I would be involved with."

Thousands of people across Germany have protested against the AfD since Sunday's election.

Protesters carried banners with slogans including "Fascism is not an alternative" and "Stop AfD Nazis! End racism and social cuts," while crowds chanted: "All together against fascism!"

body.zh: 在极右翼反移民组织德国另类选择党周日赢得州选举后，巴纳比·乔伊斯试图拉开一国党与德国选择党的距离。 在德国中东部萨克森-安哈尔特州举行的州选举中，选择党以 44% 的选票飙升至第一，虽然未能获得绝对多数席位，但对德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨领导的保守派造成了沉重打击。 被国内情报机构列为“极右极端分子”的德国选择党将很难组建政府，因为其他政党已表示将拒绝合作。 该党正在寻求为推进其议程奠定基础，其中包括严格限制移民、恢复与俄罗斯的关系、削减对乌克兰的支持以及退出欧元区。 这次选举的胜利使极右翼政党自第二次世界大战以来首次获得德国州一级的权力。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 这是近年来欧洲极右民粹主义激增的最新迹象。 当被问及一国党是否从德国民粹主义政党的胜利中获益时，乔伊斯说：“我没有——我们不是选择党。那是一个不同的政党。” “我对德国选择党的看法与意大利的乔治亚·梅洛尼 (Giorgia Meloni) 的看法完全不同，她是一位非常直接、能干、工作出色的女士。” 新英格兰的成员接着列出了几位世界领导人和被描述为右翼民粹主义者的与唐纳德·特朗普有关的 MAGA 运动：“嗯，​​我不认为（英国改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇）有任何危险......MAGA 运动，他们只是保守派，他们现在正在决定特朗普是否在其中......然后是[2027 年法国总统候选人海军陆战队]勒庞......我认为勒庞稍微偏右，但你知道，可以容忍。” “我们非常清楚法西斯主义的所作所为；这是一件令人厌恶、可怕的事情，它与一国党或我参与的任何事情都没有关系。” 自周日选举以来，德国各地数千人抗议德国选择党。 抗议者举着写有“法西斯主义不是替代方案”和“阻止德国选择党纳粹！结束种族主义和社会削减”等口号的横幅，而人群则高呼：“大家一起反对法西斯主义！” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

title.en: 'No choice': Grim interest rate warning for borrowers as oil prices spike
title.zh: 石油价格飙升，借款人面临严峻的利率警告

summary.en: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) may need to increase interest rates if inflation proves higher than anticipated, driven by a surge in oil prices towards US$100 per barrel due to Middle East conflicts. Analysts predict higher oil prices for an extended period, suggesting the RBA will likely raise rates this month.
summary.zh: 由于中东冲突导致石油价格飙升至每桶100美元，澳大利亚储备银行（RBA）可能会在通胀高于预期的情况下提高利率。分析师预计油价将长期维持高位，这表明澳联储很可能在本月加息。

body.en:
The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) might have to raise interest rates if inflation is higher than expected as oil prices surge back towards US$100 a barrel.

More attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz drove Brent crude above US$97 a barrel, which will seep into domestic petrol and diesel prices and broader cost pressures for businesses.

Russel Chesler, VanEck's head of investments and capital markets, expects oil prices to stay higher for longer.

"The continuing Middle East conflict is showing no signs of a resolution and that will leave the RBA with no choice but to increase rates at its meeting later this month," he said.

RBA assistant governor Sarah Hunter did little to downplay expectations the bank would lift interest rates again if inflation continued to exceed its forecasts.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I think the board has been pretty clear, and the staff as well. I'm certainly myself pretty clear that inflation is top priority right now," she told the AFR Property Summit in Sydney.

"We are concerned about inflation and if there is a sense that inflation is going to be stronger than we think in the context of our forecast, then the board may well have to raise interest rates to tackle that."

Both headline and trimmed mean inflation came in above the RBA's forecasts in July.

Ongoing price pressures from the Middle East conflict have been taking their toll on businesses, particularly in manufacturing, construction and retail, NAB head of Australian economics Gareth Spence said.

Business conditions took a tumble in August, with profitability falling 10 points to the lowest level since the pandemic, NAB's monthly business survey showed on Tuesday.

How much businesses are able to pass through those costs to consumers will help determine how sticky inflation will remain going forward.

Expectations of more rate rises caused sentiment among home owners to collapse in September, the Westpac-Melbourne Institute consumer sentiment index showed.

Confidence plummeted 14 per cent among mortgage holders in the month, compared to a 0.9 per cent fall among renters.

''Interest rate concerns had a clear negative impact on consumers with a mortgage," Westpac's head of Australian macro-forecasting Matthew Hassan said.

Overall, the consumer sentiment index declined 5.2 per cent to 84.4, as interest rate expectations climbed 7.3 per cent.

Despite economists forecasting the housing downturn to deepen as high interest rates combine with federal budget tax changes, only 32 per cent of consumers expected prices to decline over the next 12 months, with 42 per cent expecting a rise.

title.en: Another Australian found alive nearly two weeks after Nepal-Tibet floods

summary.en: An Australian citizen, previously unaccounted for after catastrophic flooding in Nepal, has been confirmed safe. This news brings relief to families anxiously awaiting word of their loved ones, though 35 Australians remain missing following the disaster last month which killed at least 1,399 people and left over 5,400...
summary.zh: 一名在尼泊尔失联的澳大利亚公民在灾难性洪水过后已被确认安全。这一消息为焦急等待亲人消息的家庭带来了宽慰，尽管上个月的灾难已造成至少1399人死亡、超过5400人失踪，仍有35名澳大利亚人下落不明。

body.en:
An Australian citizen who was in Nepal has been confirmed safe in the wake of the catastrophic flooding that swept through the region nearly two weeks ago.

The Australian was uncontactable but has today confirmed they are safe and well and do not require consular assistance, SBS News understands.

At least 1,399 people were killed by the 26 August mudslide and flooding in Nepal and Tibet and more than 5,400 are missing, including around 800 foreigners.

A group of Australian families with missing loved ones released a statement on Sunday, calling for greater transparency from tour groups and authorities.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They expressed gratitude to the Australian Federal Police and search teams working to find missing Australians, but criticised the Australian government for what they said was its failure to provide answers.

The federal government has sent a disaster assistance response team and other specialist resources to Kathmandu to assist with the search.

It has also committed $11 million to support the disaster response, which Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Monday was of national importance.

Hundreds of hydropower workers are among the missing, but the rescue of three of them from deep inside tunnels — two Nepalis on Friday and a Chinese man on Saturday — have buoyed hopes that more could still be alive.

At least 11 hydropower projects were engulfed when a glacier collapsed into a river on the Nepal-China border on August 26, burying the entrances to the tunnels of these projects under debris and mud and cutting off those trapped inside.

Authorities said Tuesday that rescuers in Nepal are focusing on three hydropower project tunnels where they believe dozens of workers could be trapped.

"Our search operation is focussed on finding survivors, including in tunnels. Our bigger focus is on the Chilime hydroelectric project, where we believe people are trapped, because there was a canteen, residency and arrangements for food," Dharma Raj Upreti, chief of the country's disaster authority, told Reuters.

Australian tunnel rescue expert Arnold Dix, who is advising Nepali teams, has said the operation presents an unprecedented challenge.

"Not one rescue, but multiple potential rescues, unfolding at the same time, in different places, each with its own dangers, uncertainties, and lives that may still be saved."

title.en: Who are the Australians missing in the Nepal floods? What we know so far
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水失踪的澳大利亚人是谁？我们迄今所知

summary.en: Thirty-five Australians are among thousands missing as rescue efforts continue following deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border. One Australian citizen, previously uncontactable, was confirmed safe.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命的洪水灾难后，救援工作仍在继续，有35名澳大利亚人失踪于数千名失踪人员之中。此前一名失联的澳大利亚公民已被确认安全。

body.en: There are 35 Australians among the thousands of people missing as rescue efforts continue after deadly flash floods on the Nepal-Tibet border Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The number of Australians missing in the Nepal-Tibet flash flooding disaster has fallen from 36 to 35, after another person was confirmed safe on Tuesday. The Australian citizen, who was in Nepal and uncontactable in the wake of the flash flooding on 26 August, confirmed they were safe and well and did not require consular assistance. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏边境发生致命山洪后，救援工作仍在继续，数千人失踪，其中有 35 名澳大利亚人失踪 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 周二，另一人被确认安全后，在尼泊尔-西藏山洪灾害中失踪的澳大利亚人人数已从 36 人下降到 35 人。 8 月 26 日山洪暴发后，这名澳大利亚公民身在尼泊尔，无法联系到他，但他确认自己安然无恙，不需要领事协助。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal, 35 Australians are among the thousands missing. This crisis reminds us of our shared humanity and the call to care for those in distress, especially strangers in a foreign land. May we extend compassion and support to those affected, remembering Christ's words to care for the least among us.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难中，有35名澳大利亚人位列失踪的数千人之中。这场危机提醒我们共同的人性，以及关怀困境中人们的呼召，特别是身处异乡的陌生人。愿我们向受灾者伸出同情和支持之手，铭记基督关于照顾我们中间最小之人的话语。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Australia’s classroom disruption among worst in world, prompting calls for ‘digital detox’
title.zh: 澳大利亚课堂干扰是世界上最严重的之一，引发了对“数字排毒”的呼吁

summary.en: Public school students are equivalent to two and a half years behind their independent peers, as a global report indicates a decline in reading and mathematics skills. This disruption in Australian classrooms is among the worst globally.
summary.zh: 根据一份全球报告，公立学校的学生在阅读和数学技能方面落后于私立学校的学生两年半，澳大利亚课堂的干扰是全球最严重的之一。

body.en: Public school students are the equivalent of two and a half years behind their independent peers, as global report shows decline in reading and maths Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Public school students are more than two years behind their independent counterparts and Australia’s classroom disruption remains among the worst in the world, a global report has found. The 2025 Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa) results, released on Tuesday by the Australian Council for Educational Research (ACER), tested the literacy of 15-year-olds in 91 countries, including Australia . The tests have run every three years since 2000. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一份全球报告发现，公立学校学生的阅读和数学能力下降，相当于独立学生落后两年半。一份全球报告发现，公立学校学生的阅读和数学能力下降，公立学校学生落后独立学生两年半以上，澳大利亚的课堂混乱情况仍然是世界上最严重的。澳大利亚教育研究委员会(ACER)周二发布的2025年国际学生评估计划(Pisa)结果测试了包括澳大利亚在内的91个国家15岁学生的读写能力。自 2000 年以来，测试每三年进行一次。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Pisa report reveals a concerning gap in educational outcomes, with public school students falling significantly behind. This underscores the critical importance of effective teaching and a conducive learning environment for shaping the next generation. Proverbs 22:6 reminds us that the way we train children profoundly impacts their future.
reflection.zh: Pisa报告揭示了令人担忧的教育成果差距，公立学校的学生远远落后。这凸显了有效的教学和有利的学习环境对塑造下一代至关重要。箴言22:6提醒我们，我们训练孩子的方式将深刻影响他们的未来。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

The potential for substantial penalties underscores the seriousness with which Australia is approaching digital safety and ethical online conduct. It calls for a marketplace where fairness and...
reflection.zh: 这项立法标志着在追究强大科技公司对其托管内容和塑造用户体验的算法负责方面迈出了重要一步。巨额罚款的可能性凸显了澳大利亚在处理数字安全和道德在线行为方面的严肃态度。它呼吁建立一个优先考虑公平和保护的市场，这反映了古老的智慧——不公平的秤是可憎的。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Protesters call for Israeli ambassador's expulsion after Zomi Frankcom decision
title.zh: 抗议者呼吁驱逐以色列大使，此前对佐米·弗兰科姆事件做出裁决

summary.en: Activists gathered at the Israeli embassy in Canberra to protest the decision not to prosecute Israeli officers involved in the airstrike that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. Protesters displayed images of Palestinian casualties and chanted for the expulsion of Israel's ambassador.
summary.zh: 活动人士聚集在堪培拉的以色列大使馆，抗议一项决定，该决定不对以色列军官在加沙地带造成澳大利亚援助工作者佐米·弗兰科姆死亡的空袭事件进行起诉。抗议者展示了巴勒斯坦遇难者的照片，并高呼要求驱逐以色列大使。

body.en:
Dozens of activists have demanded Israel's ambassador in Canberra be expelled following the decision not to pursue criminal charges against officers who ordered strikes that killed Australian aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza.

The group converged in front of the Israeli embassy in Canberra on Tuesday displaying dozens of pictures of Palestinians killed by Israel since October 7 across the road from the embassy, with protesters chanting in unison: "Kick out the Israeli ambassador".

Israel's ambassador to Australia Hillel Newman last month declined to apologise to Zomi Frankcom’s family following the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) investigation which determined those responsible for the April 2024 strike that killed Frankcom and six of her colleagues would not be prosecuted.

Newman had said at the time he felt for the family but that the outcomes of Israel's investigation must be respected.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

A group called the Red Rebels staged a demonstration walking slowly to the embassy and pointing to its highly guarded gates, carrying a symbolic fake baby to represent the children killed by Israeli strikes in Gaza.

Activists blocked the entry to the embassy, leading police to physically move them from the driveway across the road. There was a tense standoff as protesters chanted "free Palestine" in front of a line of police officers.

Zomi's friend Karuna Bajracharya was among the protest group, saying he found remarks by one of the Israeli officers involved in the strike that he did not regret the attack as "disgusting".

Former IDF reserve colonel Nochi Mendel has told the ABC and the Guardian in separate interviews he would do "exactly the same thing" again and that he believed the World Central Kitchen workers killed were "not innocent".

"Like, disgusting the fact that he said, 'I'm not sorry', and the fact that he said he'd do it again.

"The people that we vote for and we put into power and that our taxes pay is supposed to represent us, the Australian people, and we are begging them: send this guy (the ambassador) home, send a clear message, cut the two-way arms trade. But it's obvious that our government is hamstrung."

Greens senator Mehreen Faruqi described the federal government as "cowards" for not declaring how it will proceed with its next steps to seek accountability over Frankcom’s death.

"They have power. They have responsibility, and we will hold them to account. They should have sanctioned Israel a long time ago," Faruqi told protesters.

"When Israel abrogated themselves of this crime, senator Wong told us how angry the Australian government was. Instead, they were considering what action to take...
body.zh: 数十名活动人士要求驱逐以色列驻堪培拉大使，此前以色列决定不对那些下令发动袭击并在加沙杀害澳大利亚援助人员佐米·弗兰克科姆的官员提出刑事指控。 周二，这群人聚集在堪培拉的以色列大使馆前，展示了数十张自 10 月 7 日以来在大使馆对面被以色列杀害的巴勒斯坦人的照片，抗议者齐声高呼：“赶走以色列大使”。 以色列驻澳大利亚大使希勒尔·纽曼 (Hillel Newman) 上个月拒绝向佐米·弗兰克科 (Zomi Frankcom) 的家人道歉，此前以色列国防军 (IDF) 进行了调查，确定对 2024 年 4 月导致弗兰克科 (Frankcom) 及其六名同事死亡的袭击负责的人不会受到起诉。 纽曼当时表示，他对这个家庭感到同情，但以色列的调查结果必须得到尊重。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 一个名为“红色叛军”的组织举行示威活动，缓慢走向使馆，指着戒备森严的大门，并举着一个象征性的假婴儿，代表在以色列对加沙的袭击中丧生的儿童。 活动人士封锁了大使馆的入口，导致警察将他们从车道上移到马路对面。抗议者在一排警察面前高呼“自由巴勒斯坦”，双方陷入紧张的对峙。 佐米的朋友卡鲁纳·巴杰拉查里亚（Karuna Bajracharya）是抗议团体之一，他说，他发现参与袭击的一名以色列军官表示他并不后悔这次袭击的言论“令人作呕”。 前以色列国防军后备上校诺奇·门德尔在接受美国广播公司和卫报的单独采访时告诉美国广播公司和卫报，他会再次做“完全相同的事情”，并且他相信被杀害的世界中央厨房工人“不是无辜的”。 “就像，令人恶心的是，他说‘我不抱歉’，而且他说他会再这样做。 “我们投票支持、我们掌权的人，我们的纳税应该代表我们，澳大利亚人民，我们恳求他们：让这个人（大使）回家，发出明确的信息，削减双向武器贸易。但很明显，我们的政府已经陷入困境。” 绿党参议员梅林·法鲁奇 (Mehreen Faruqi) 称联邦政府是“懦夫”，因为他们没有宣布将如何采取下一步行动，追究弗兰克科姆之死的责任。 “他们有权力。他们有责任，我们将追究他们的责任。他们早就应该制裁以色列了，”法鲁奇告诉抗议者。 “当以色列废除这一罪行时，黄参议员告诉我们澳大利亚政府有多么愤怒。相反，他们正在考虑采取什么行动......

reflection.en: The demand for accountability following the death of Zomi Frankcom highlights a deep human yearning for justice. When official channels seem to fail, people often turn to public protest, seeking a flow of righteousness that addresses suffering and holds power accountable. May all parties seek paths toward true justice and peace.
reflection.zh: 在佐米·弗兰科姆去世后，人们对问责的呼吁凸显了人类对正义的深切渴望。当官方渠道似乎失效时，人们常常诉诸公众抗议，寻求一种能够解决苦难并追究权力责任的公义之流。愿各方都能寻求通往真正正义与和平的道路。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Anthony Albanese says he's not trying to stop you from doomscrolling
title.zh: 总理说他不想阻止你“末日刷屏”

summary.en: New laws proposed in Australia could give internet users the choice to opt out of algorithmic recommendations on social media, allowing them to control their online feeds under an initiative called 'My Feed, My Way'.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚提议的新法律可能让互联网用户选择退出社交媒体上的算法推荐，让他们在“我的信息流，我的方式”倡议下控制自己的在线信息流。

body.en:
Australian internet users will be given the choice to opt out of algorithmic recommendations   under proposed social media reforms.

Draft laws setting up a digital duty of care were introduced by Prime Minister Anthony Albanese on Tuesday.

As part of the measures, social media companies will need to provide tools for people to choose what they see in their online feeds, under a government initiative called My Feed, My Way.

Social media companies have been accused of creating addictive algorithms that keep people endlessly scrolling through recommended content. Advocates have called for a reversion to chronological feeds that show posts from friends and other accounts a user follows.

"This is not about giving government control. It's about giving people control. It's about putting choice back into the hands of Australians online," Albanese told reporters in Canberra.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"If people want to doom scroll, as you call it, that's fine, that's up to them," he said.

"But if people want to have a change, then this will provide them with the opportunity."

He pointed to global discussion over harms linked to social media, including at the United Nations.

"It's a debate that's taking place in countries all around the world, because of the sort of impact that we're seeing," he added, citing a rise in mental health issues and eating disorders as examples.

The reforms had drawn backlash from both the Coalition and Greens before being formally announced, with Opposition leader Angus Taylor suggesting it could be akin to censorship.

Meanwhile, Greens senator Sarah Hanson-Young called for the opt-out algorithm to be made the default setting.

Under the draft laws, social media companies will also be required to protect people from harmful content online.

Harmful content will include the promotion of eating disorders, misogynistic content, pornography or content that glorifies crime.

Albanese said the legislation would empower the government to issue removal notices for 'nudify' apps and websites, which typically use artificial intelligence to create fake nude images of people without their consent.

Sharing that type of content — nonconsensual deepfake sexualised images — is already illegal in much of Australia, but developing the tools to do so isn't.

Companies could face fines of $100 million if they don't enact the duty of care.

Communications Minister Anika Wells said the duty of care would build on the world-leading ban on social media for under-16s Australia introduced last year.

"The digital duty of care is not about controlling adults online. It is about giving adults a choice," she said.

reflection.en: The constant stream of curated content on social media can lead to endless scrolling, often called 'doomscrolling.' This proposed Australian law aims to give users agency over their digital environment, encouraging a more intentional engagement with online information. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure,...
reflection.zh: 社交媒体上不断涌现的精选内容可能导致无休止的滚动，这通常被称为“末日刷屏”。澳大利亚这项提议的法律旨在让用户掌控自己的数字环境，鼓励更有意识地参与在线信息。腓立比书4:8提醒我们要思念地上“凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的”，这些都可作为我们线上和线下选择的指导原则。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.

Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that "where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety." The public deserves policies built on thorough analysis, not just assertion.

title.en: The unusual tactics some shoppers admit to as fruit and vegetable prices spike
title.zh: 一些购物者承认，随着水果和蔬菜价格飙升，他们采取了不寻常的购物策略

summary.en: A new survey reveals that over 40% of shoppers are now prioritizing affordability over their desired purchases, with 22% reducing their fresh produce consumption to save money as living costs rise.
summary.zh: 一项新调查显示，随着生活成本的上涨，超过四成的购物者现在优先考虑可负担性而非他们想要的购买，其中22%的人为了省钱而减少了新鲜农产品的消费。

body.en:
Australians are cutting their fresh produce spending by more than a quarter as the cost of living crunch changes how they shop — with some admitting to removing broccoli stalks and others selecting cheaper varieties at self-serve checkouts.

New research from price comparison site Canstar, released on Tuesday morning, found that the average amount Australians spend on fresh fruit and vegetables each week has fallen by 26 per cent, from $43 in 2025 to $32 this year.

The survey of over 2,500 shoppers also found more than one in five — 22 per cent — are eating less fresh produce to save money.

Previous Canstar research from July found that a grocery shop of staple items was around 8.5 per cent more expensive than in March 2025, with essentials like eggs and milk seeing some of the sharpest increases.

Supply chain pressures have affected fuel and freight expenses, with farmers also spending more on fertiliser, driving up prices at the checkout.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

For some households, cutting costs means changing what they buy rather than simply buying less – but some of the cost-cutting measures are more unusual.

The findings suggest rising grocery costs are affecting not only how much Australians spend, but also what they eat and how they shop.

Canstar consumer expert Eden Radford told SBS News the figures show households are actively looking for ways to manage rising grocery bills.

"Cost of living pressures are reshaping how Australians shop for fresh produce," Radford said.

"It's evident that shoppers are trying all approaches to stretch their dollar further."

More than four in 10 shoppers, or 42 per cent, said they are buying only what they can afford rather than what they would ideally like to eat, according to Canstar.

A third are opting for so-called "ugly" fruit and vegetables, while a quarter are buying more frozen produce because it is cheaper.

Another 23 per cent said they are buying more frozen produce to avoid fresh food going to waste.

Twelve per cent of shoppers said they have reduced the weight of their purchases — including by removing parts of produce such as broccoli stalks.

And 6 per cent admitted to deliberately selecting a cheaper option at self-service checkouts, such as entering a lower-priced variety of produce rather than the item they had actually chosen. For example, brown mushrooms attract a higher price than the regular, white button variety.

Radford explained that shoppers are becoming more "savvy" out of necessity, and half are splitting their time between multiple stores.

reflection.en: As the cost of living bites, many Australians are finding themselves unable to purchase the foods they want, instead buying only what they can afford. This situation echoes the ancient wisdom that 'the borrower is slave to the lender,' highlighting how financial pressures can limit choices and create a sense of being bound by necessity.

title.en: If Australia has a housing shortage, why are so many home builders collapsing?
title.zh: 如果澳大利亚住房短缺，为什么这么多房屋建筑商倒闭？

summary.en: Several Australian home developers have gone bankrupt, leaving thousands of people uncertain about whether their homes will be completed. The Bathla Group's collapse alone has put over 2,000 apartments in limbo and jeopardized 14,000 more homes, with 3,472 construction companies failing in the last financial year.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚多家房屋开发商破产，令数千人对房屋能否建成感到担忧。仅Bathla集团的倒闭就使2000多套公寓的建设陷入停滞，并危及另外14000套房屋的建设。在过去一个财年里，共有3472家澳大利亚建筑公司破产。

body.en:
Across Australia, thousands of people are waiting to find out if their homes will be built, after several separate construction company collapses.

By far the biggest of those recent collapses has been the Bathla Group , a Sydney developer that’s been one of Australia’s largest affordable home builders.

Owing about $3.4 billion to private lenders, Bathla's voluntary administration has thrown the construction of more than 2,000 apartments into limbo, while jeopardising a further pipeline of 14,000 homes.

Figures released last week show 3,472 Australian construction companies went bust in the financial year to 30 June 2026: one in four (24.5 per cent) of all company insolvencies nationally.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The only good news? The number of builder insolvencies was slightly down for the first time since a steep rise began during COVID.

However, our research has found insolvencies in the construction sector remain consistently higher than in other industries. That makes it harder to build the housing we need.

Australia is falling further behind in meeting the federal government’s 1.2 million new homes goal by 2029.

Official forecasts released last month indicate the target won’t be met until December 2030. NSW — Australia’s largest housing market — may not meet its targets until March 2032, three years late on a five-year target.

There's no shortage of demand for new homes. What we lack is a construction system capable of delivering them reliably, sustainably and at scale.

On Monday, more than 200 of Bathla’s 350 staff were stood down as the administrator continues to work on a rescue deal.

While most of its building projects are in western Sydney, Bathla's collapse is being watched around Australia because of its wider financial impacts.

Like any company collapse, there are specific circumstances involved in Bathla's current woes. Its business model relied on high volumes of low-cost building.

The NSW building regulator has also conducted more than 40 inspections of Bathla sites in recent months, and ordered the builder to fix serious defects in one major development.

Bathla may have taken as many as 1,000 deposits from buyers for homes now stalled. But home buyers aren't the only people affected.

As well as owing money to subcontractors, Bathla owes money to a long list of non‑bank lenders — also known as private credit firms.

This reflects the construction industry's heavy reliance on alternative finance, because banks have reduced their exposure to riskier lending.

body.zh: 在几家独立的建筑公司倒闭后，澳大利亚各地成千上万的人正在等待他们的房屋能否建成。 到目前为止，最近倒闭的最大的是悉尼开发商巴斯拉集团(Bathla Group)，它是澳大利亚最大的经济适用房建筑商之一。 巴斯拉政府欠私人贷款约 34 亿美元，导致 2,000 多套公寓的建设陷入困境，同时危及另外 14,000 套住房的建设。 上周公布的数据显示，截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的财政年度，有 3,472 家澳大利亚建筑公司破产：占全国所有破产公司的四分之一（24.5%）。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 唯一的好消息？自新冠疫情期间破产建筑商数量急剧上升以来，首次出现小幅下降。 然而，我们的研究发现，建筑行业的破产率始终高于其他行业。这使得建造我们需要的住房变得更加困难。 澳大利亚在实现联邦政府到 2029 年建造 120 万套新房的目标方面进一步落后。 上个月发布的官方预测表明，该目标要到 2030 年 12 月才能实现。澳大利亚最大的房地产市场新南威尔士州可能要到 2032 年 3 月才能实现目标，比五年目标晚了三年。 对新房的需求并不缺乏。我们缺乏的是一个能够可靠、可持续和大规模交付这些项目的施工系统。 周一，Bathla 的 350 名员工中有 200 多人被解雇，管理人员仍在继续制定救援协议。 虽然其大部分建筑项目都在悉尼西部，但巴斯拉的倒塌因其更广泛的财务影响而受到澳大利亚各地的关注。 与任何倒闭的公司一样，巴斯拉目前的困境也有其特定的情况。其商业模式依赖于大量低成本建筑。 新南威尔士州建筑监管机构近几个月还对 Bathla 工地进行了 40 多次检查，并命令建筑商修复一项重大开发项目的严重缺陷。 Bathla 可能已经向目前停滞不前的房屋买家收取了多达 1,000 美元的定金。但购房者并不是唯一受到影响的人。 除了欠分包商的钱外，巴斯拉还欠一长串非银行贷款机构（也称为私人信贷公司）的钱。 这反映出建筑行业对替代金融的严重依赖，因为银行减少了风险较高的贷款。 周五，澳大利亚证券和投资委员会主席莎拉·考特表示……

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that Russian airspace is becoming increasingly unsafe due to Ukraine's expanding long-range drone campaign. Despite this warning, dozens of foreign airlines continue to operate scheduled services to Russian airports or cross the country, potentially carrying...
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告说，由于乌克兰不断扩大远程无人机袭击，俄罗斯领空正变得越来越不安全。尽管有此警告，仍有数十家外国航空公司继续运营飞往俄罗斯机场的定期航班或飞越该国，可能载有澳大利亚乘客，而西方竞争对手则已绕道而行。

body.en:
Russian airspace has been closed to Australian, European and North American airlines for more than four years, but it has not been empty.

Around 60 foreign carriers still operate scheduled services to Russian airports, and a larger number cross the country without landing, taking the shortest route between Europe and Asia while Western competitors detour south.

Last week, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told all of them to reconsider, warning that "Russian airspace is becoming completely unsafe" as Ukraine expands its long-range drone campaign.

Passengers from Australian airports cannot fly to Russia directly, and Qantas has avoided the airspace since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. But those connecting through China's Guangzhou or Shanghai airports, or India's Delhi airport, may still spend part of their journey over Russian territory because the carriers operating those sectors retain access.

An independent Russian outlet reported that 27 foreign airlines cancelled flights to Moscow within a day of Zelenskyy's warning. Several of those carriers offered explanations that did not reference the Ukrainian president's announcement, while others were still overflying as normal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The airlines with access to airspace come almost entirely from countries that have not sanctioned Russia.

Russia closed its own skies in 2022 to more than 35 countries and territories, a list that included all 27 European Union member states, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Australia, and New Zealand.

Chinese carriers form the largest group still flying. Air China, China Eastern, China Southern, Hainan Airlines, Xiamen Air and Beijing Capital Airlines all use Russian airspace, principally to reach western Europe.

British Airways' London–Beijing service is around 1,600km longer than its Chinese competitors' equivalent, adding almost two hours.

Gulf carriers have become Russia's main link to the wider world. Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways and flydubai all serve Russian cities, connecting Moscow and St Petersburg to hundreds of destinations — including Australia — through their hubs.

Emirates flies to Moscow and routes its Dubai–US West Coast services along a polar track over northern Russia. Air India operates no Russian services but crosses the country on every flight to the US and Canada.

body.zh: 俄罗斯领空对澳大利亚、欧洲和北美航空公司关闭已有四年多了，但它并没有空空如也。 大约 60 家外国航空公司仍在运营飞往俄罗斯机场的定期航班，其中更多航空公司在不着陆的情况下穿越该国，选择欧洲和亚洲之间的最短路线，而西方竞争对手则绕道南下。 上周，乌克兰总统泽连斯基要求所有人重新考虑，并警告称，随着乌克兰扩大远程无人机行动，“俄罗斯领空正变得完全不安全”。 从澳大利亚机场出发的乘客无法直接飞往俄罗斯，自 2022 年 2 月俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰以来，澳洲航空就避开了该空域。但通过中国广州或上海机场或印度德里机场转机的乘客可能仍会在部分旅程中飞越俄罗斯领土，因为运营这些航段的航空公司保留了通行权。 俄罗斯一家独立媒体报道称，泽连斯基发出警告后一天内，27 家外国航空公司取消了飞往莫斯科的航班。其中几家航空公司提供的解释没有提及乌克兰总统的声明，而其他航空公司仍然照常飞越领空。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 能够进入空域的航空公司几乎全部来自未制裁俄罗斯的国家。 俄罗斯于 2022 年对超过 35 个国家和地区关闭了领空，其中包括所有 27 个欧盟成员国、英国、美国、加拿大、日本、韩国、新加坡、澳大利亚和新西兰。 中国航空公司是仍在飞行的最大群体。中国国际航空、中国东方航空、中国南方航空、海南航空、厦门航空和北京首都航空均使用俄罗斯领空，主要飞往西欧。 英国航空的伦敦至北京航线比中国竞争对手的航线长约 1,600 公里，增加了近两个小时。 海湾航空公司已成为俄罗斯与更广阔世界的主要纽带。阿联酋航空、阿提哈德航空、卡塔尔航空和迪拜航空均提供俄罗斯城市航班服务，通过其枢纽将莫斯科和圣彼得堡与包括澳大利亚在内的数百个目的地连接起来。 阿联酋航空有飞往莫斯科的航班，其迪拜至美国西海岸的航班沿着俄罗斯北部的极地轨道运行。印度航空不运营俄罗斯航班，但每趟飞往美国和加拿大的航班都会穿越该国。 四家欧洲航空公司保留了通航权，全部来自与俄罗斯保持合作关系的国家：土耳其航空公司，为俄罗斯七个机场提供服务；飞马座；白俄罗斯的Belavia；塞尔维亚航空，飞往莫斯科、圣...

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict creates a complex web of decisions for international carriers. As Ukraine expands its drone operations, the safety of Russian airspace is called into question, prompting a call for airlines to reconsider their routes. This situation presents a stark reminder of the principle to overcome evil with good, rather than being drawn into...
reflection.zh: 持续的冲突给国际航空公司带来了复杂的决策。随着乌克兰扩大其无人机行动，俄罗斯领空的安全受到质疑，促使航空公司重新考虑其航线。这种情况严峻地提醒我们，要以善胜恶，而不是卷入报复或风险的循环。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: 'Probably feel worse, not better': Government proposal to change daily habit questioned
title.zh: ‘感觉会更糟，而不是更好’：政府改变日常习惯的提议受到质疑

summary.en: New laws could let you switch off your feed's algorithm — but how is the real question.
summary.zh: 新法律可能允许您关闭信息流的算法——但如何实现才是真正的问题。

body.en:
Your morning scroll could look very different under new draft laws from the federal government, which plan to give social media users the chance to switch off the algorithm shaping their feed.

An exposure draft of the long-awaited Digital Duty of Care is expected this week, which will put the onus on platforms to risk-test their products before rolling them out — with one proposed measure forcing social media giants to let users opt out of the recommender systems that decide what content they see.

But the plan is already facing pushback, with the Coalition and the Greens both flagging problems with the approach from opposite directions, while other experts have welcomed the change but say the devil is in the detail.

Under the new laws, platforms will be required to offer an opt-out from algorithm-driven feeds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Communications Minister Anika Wells says the goal is choice, not a ban on algorithms altogether.

"A lot of Australians appreciate the algorithm, both for the enjoyment that they get out of it or the utility that they get out of it," she told ABC News on Monday morning, adding that big tech should "offer them the choice in the first place" and "respect that choice".

Companies could be fined up to $109.2 million for breaching the wider duty of care laws, which also require platforms to actively mitigate risks on their platforms.

"People can already opt out of algorithms in their accounts. Why do we need the government here?" he said on Monday morning, accusing the government of using the policy to "silence people" from engaging with content critical of it.

But existing options to opt out of the algorithm are harder to use than that suggests.

"It's not true that you can opt out of recommender systems on all platforms," Tama Leaver, professor of internet studies at Curtin University, told SBS News.

On Instagram for instance, users can toggle to a followers-only feed, he says, but it snaps back to the algorithmic version every time they log back in. A different setting that lets users snooze certain personalised content resets every month.

Where opt-outs do exist, he said they're often "buried" in menus, requiring a "deep dive" to find them.

"The question of what you will get instead is the thing that will decide whether people will try this out or not," Leaver told SBS News.

He said a return to a reverse chronological feed — the model Instagram launched with — would show only posts from accounts you follow, in the order they were posted, and you could reach the end of your feed — rather than today's endless scroll.

But that's a harder sell than it sounds. Fewer people...
body.zh: 根据联邦政府的新法律草案，你的早间滚动可能看起来非常不同，该法律计划让社交媒体用户有机会关闭塑造其信息流的算法。 期待已久的数字谨慎责任草案预计将于本周发布，该草案将让平台有责任在推出产品之前对其产品进行风险测试，其中一项拟议措施迫使社交媒体巨头让用户选择退出决定他们看到什么内容的推荐系统。 但该计划已经面临阻力，联盟党和绿党都从相反的方向指出了这一做法的问题，而其他专家则对这一变化表示欢迎，但表示问题在于细节。 根据新法律，平台将被要求提供从算法驱动的源中选择退出的功能。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 通信部长阿尼卡·威尔斯表示，目标是选择，而不是完全禁止算法。 她周一早上告诉美国广播公司新闻，“许多澳大利亚人都很欣赏这种算法，无论是因为他们从中获得的乐趣，还是因为他们从中获得的效用”，并补充说大型科技公司应该“首先为他们提供选择”并“尊重这种选择”。 公司可能因违反更广泛的注意义务法而被处以最高 1.092 亿美元的罚款，该法还要求平台积极降低其平台上的风险。 “人们已经可以选择退出账户中的算法。为什么我们需要政府？”他周一上午表示，指责政府利用该政策“压制人们”参与批评政府的内容。 但现有的退出该算法的选项比所暗示的更难使用。 科廷大学互联网研究教授 Tama Leaver 告诉 SBS 新闻：“并不是说你可以在所有平台上选择退出推荐系统。” 他说，例如在 Instagram 上，用户可以切换到仅限关注者的提要，但每次重新登录时，它都会快速返回到算法版本。允许用户暂停某些个性化内容的不同设置每月都会重置。 他说，在确实存在选择退出的情况下，它们通常“埋藏”在菜单中，需要“深入研究”才能找到它们。 利弗告诉 SBS 新闻：“你会得到什么的问题将决定人们是否会尝试这一点。” 他表示，回归逆时间顺序推送（Instagram 推出的模型）将只显示您关注的帐户中的帖子，按照发布的顺序，并且您可以到达推送的末尾，而不是今天的无休止的滚动。 但这比听起来更难。人少了...

reflection.en: The proposal to allow users to opt out of social media algorithms raises questions about how we curate our digital environment. Philippians 4:8 encourages us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, and praiseworthy. As we navigate the complexities of online content, may we seek to fill our minds with that which...
reflection.zh: 允许用户选择退出社交媒体算法的提议，引发了关于我们如何管理数字环境的问题。《腓立比书》4:8 鼓励我们将心思意念专注于凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，若有什么德行，若有什么称赞，这些事。当我们应对在线内容的复杂性时，愿我们寻求用那能造就我们并反映雅伟良善的事物来充实我们的思想，而不是那些使我们分心或受伤的事物。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong Desk
title.zh: 香港快讯

strap.en: News, policy, and public life in Hong Kong.
strap.zh: 聚焦香港时事、政策与社会动态。

title.en: MTR seek police action over alleged mass fare evasion
title.zh: 港铁就涉嫌集体逃票事件报警

summary.en: Hong Kong's MTR Corporation has filed a complaint with the police after an online video surfaced showing a group of people allegedly evading fares at Tsim Sha Tsui Station. The MTR stated that reviewing surveillance footage confirmed the incident occurred around 11 PM on August 23rd. The company condemned the...
summary.zh: 香港铁路有限公司（港铁）周二表示，已就一段网上流传的视频向警方报案，该视频据称显示一群人在尖沙咀站集体逃票。港铁称，经检阅闭路电视片段后，相信事件发生于8月23日晚上约11时。该公司谴责此类行为，并表示对此事高度重视。港铁补充说，将加强车站巡逻。公司指出，任何逃避支付正确车费的行为均违反港铁附例，违例者可能面临附加费甚...

body.en: The MTR on Tuesday said it had lodged a complaint with the police following an online video that allegedly showed a group of people engaged in fare evasion at Tsim Sha Tsui Station. The railway operator said it believed, upon reviewing surveillance footage, that the incident happened at around 11pm on August 23. It condemned such behaviour, saying that it attaches great importance to the matter. It will step up patrols at stations, the MTR added. Any failure to pay the correct fare and other forms of fare evasion is a breach of the MTR by-laws, the company said, and it would impose a surcharge on violators or even initiate prosecutions. The railway operator added that it would continue to remind passengers to pay the correct fare and use valid tickets through enforcement, patrols and education campaigns. It urged commuters to notify station staff as soon as possible if they find any suspected breaches of the by-laws. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 港铁周二表示，因网上一段视频据称显示一群人在尖沙咀站逃票，已向警方投诉。该铁路运营商表示，经查看监控录像，事件发生在8月23日晚上11点左右，该铁路运营商对此类行为表示谴责，并表示高度重视此事。港铁补充称，将加强车站巡逻。该公司表示，任何未支付正确车费和其他形式逃票的行为均违反港铁公司章程，公司将对违规者处以附加费，甚至提出检控。铁路运营商表示，将继续通过执法、巡逻和教育活动，提醒乘客正确支付票价并使用有效车票。它敦促通勤者如果发现任何涉嫌违反附则的行为，请尽快通知车站工作人员。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The MTR's report of fare evasion at Tsim Sha Tsui Station points to a disregard for shared resources and rules. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves not only avoiding wrongdoing but actively pursuing justice and acting with compassion. Upholding the integrity of public services requires both accountability for those who break rules and a...
reflection.zh: 港铁就尖沙咀站发生的逃票事件报警，这反映出对公共资源和规则的漠视。弥迦书6章8节提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于避免不法行为，更在于积极追求公正并以怜悯之心行事。维护公共服务的诚信，既需要追究违规者的责任，也需要对所有人秉持公平的原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: More than half of registered visitors to Sai Kung trail fail to turn up on 1st weekend of booking system
title.zh: 预订系统首周末近半访客未现身 专家称或因宣传不足

summary.en: A trial booking system for the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail in Sai Kung saw over half of the registered visitors fail to show up during its first weekend. Out of 3,230 bookings, only 1,560 visitors attended, with authorities attributing the low turnout partly to insufficient publicity for the new...
summary.zh: 香港西贡郊野公园的岩石导览径“破边洲”段，在试行预约系统首个周末，登记访客中超过一半未有现身。在3,230个预约中，只有1,560名访客实际到访。当局将此归因于新预约系统宣传不足，该系统旨在控制过度旅游和减轻生态破坏。

body.en: More than half of the registered visitors to a hiking hotspot in Sai Kung failed to turn up on the first weekend of a trial booking system intended to curb overtourism and blunt ecological damage, authorities have said. Of the 3,230 people who make bookings under the real-name reservation system, only 1,560 registered and walk-in patrons arrived at the Po Pin Chau section of the High Island Geo Trail over the weekend. Visitors show their booking record to AFCD staff before entering the Po Pin Chau section in the first weekend of September, 2026. Photo: AFCD. Hong Kong’s Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) unveiled the reservation system last month in a bid to address overcrowding and improve visitor safety. The AFCD said on Facebook that around 900 of the 1,800 people signed up on Saturday turned up at the trailhead in Sai Kung East Country Park. On Sunday, some 660 of 1,430 registered visitors arrived. An unspecified number of these were walk-ins who registered on-site. Despite the high no-show rate, the department said the operations went smoothly over the weekend. “Visitors entered the trail after having their QR codes scanned and identities verified, with immediate entry available during most time slots without queueing,” the AFCD’s post read in Chinese. Po Pin Chau. Photo: AFCD. Visitors were satisfied, according to country park authorities, with some pointing out that foot traffic along the trail had decreased compared to before the trial booking system’s introduction. Fatal accident The trail, which leads to a cliff overlooking the island of Po Pin Chau, has become a popular tourism attraction in recent years, particularly among visitors from the Chinese mainland. On New Year’s Eve last year, a 21-year-old tourist from Guangzhou died after falling 70 metres from the cliff into the sea. The man and his friends had been taking photos at the site, which is famous for its vertical columns of volcanic rock, when the accident occurred. Under the trial booking system, visitors must book in advance for all weekends and public holidays beginning in September and ending on October 7 – the final day of mainland China’s National Day Golden Week holiday, a peak travel season for visitors from across the border. The maximum number of daily visitors during this periods has been capped at 2,000. Po Pin Chau. Photo: AFCD. Registration is not required for visits before 9am and after 5pm. The AFCD said on Monday that it will collect on-site data and visitors’ opinions and review the trial system at a later date.
body.zh: 当局表示，在旨在抑制过度旅游和减轻生态破坏的试订系统的第一个周末，超过一半的西贡远足热点登记游客未能到场。在3,230名通过实名预约系统预约的人士中，只有1,560名登记及到场的顾客于周末到达万宜地质径破边洲段。 2026年9月第一个周末，游客在进入破边洲路段前向渔护署工作人员出示预订记录。图片：渔护署。香港渔农自然护理署（AFCD）上个月推出了预订系统，以解决过度拥挤问题并提高游客安全。渔护署在脸书上表示，周六报名的 1,800 人中，约有 900 人出现在西贡东郊野公园的步道起点。周日，1,430 名登记参观者中约有 660 人抵达。其中有数量不详的现场注册者。尽管缺席率很高，但该部门表示周末的运营进展顺利。渔护署的中文帖子写道：“游客在扫描二维码和验证身份后进入步道，大部分时段均可立即进入，无需排队。”破边洲.图片：渔护署。郊野公园当局表示，游客对此表示满意，有人指出，与试订系统推出前相比，沿途的人流量有所减少。致命事故 这条小径通往俯瞰破边洲岛的悬崖，近年来已成为热门旅游景点，尤其受到中国大陆游客的欢迎。去年除夕夜，一名21岁的广州游客从70米悬崖坠海身亡。事故发生时，该男子和他的朋友正在该地点拍照，该地点以垂直的火山岩柱而闻名。在试订制度下，游客必须提前预订9月开始至10月7日（中国大陆国庆黄金周假期的最后一天）的所有周末和公众假期，这是跨境游客的旅游旺季。在此期间，每日访客人数上限为 2,000 人。破边洲.图片：渔护署。上午 9 点之前和下午 5 点之后参观无需登记。渔护署周一表示，将收集现场数据和访客意见，并稍后检讨试用制度。

reflection.en: The natural beauty of places like Sai Kung is a gift, entrusted to us for care. When systems designed to protect these spaces falter due to low participation, it calls us to consider our role as stewards. We are reminded that all creation belongs to Yahweh, and our responsibility is to engage thoughtfully in its preservation.
reflection.zh: 西贡等地的自然美景是受托于我们的恩赐，需要我们去爱护。当旨在保护这些地方的系统因参与度低而失效时，它促使我们反思作为管理者的角色。我们被提醒，一切受造物都属于雅伟，我们的责任是认真地参与其保护工作。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Disciplinary board postpones hearing against fire safety firms over Tai Po blaze
title.zh: 消防安全公司因太子大厦大火案听证会被推迟

summary.en: A disciplinary board has postponed a hearing for two fire safety contractors accused of failing to properly manage disabled fire safety systems before the Wang Fuk Court fire last year. The Fire Services Department announced the adjournment of the hearing for Victory Fire Engineering Limited until further notice,...
summary.zh: 消防部门的一个纪律委员会已将原定于周五举行的针对两家消防安全承包商的听证会推迟，这两家承包商被指控在去年太子大厦发生火灾前未能妥善管理失效的消防安全系统。消防部门周一晚间在一份声明中表示，注册消防工程承建商纪律委员会已应双方联合要求，将胜利消防工程有限公司的听证会延期“直至另行通知”。

body.en: A disciplinary board has postponed a hearing for two fire safety contractors said to have failed to properly manage disabled fire safety systems before Wang Fuk Court went up in flames last year. Chung Kit-man (centre), a director and engineer at Victory Fire Engineering, testifies at a public hearing on March 30, 2026, into the massive Tai Po fire. File photo: Hans Tse/HKFP. The Fire Services Department said in a statement on Monday night that the Registered Fire Service Installation Contractors Disciplinary Board had adjourned the hearing for Victory Fire Engineering Limited, originally scheduled for Friday, “until further notice.” Upon a joint request from both parties, the hearing was adjourned “for their preparation.” A hearing against China Status Development and Engineering Company Limited, another fire services contractor at Wang Fuk Court, has also been adjourned to allow the prosecution more time to process the case. China Status did not object to the adjournment, the statement read. The massive fire broke out at Wang Fuk Court on November 26 last year. It tore through seven of the eight buildings at the estate, killing 168 people and displacing thousands in its wake. Limited powers Earlier hearings held by an independent committee investigating the cause and rapid spread of the deadly fire have revealed alleged negligence by the two firms, which are reportedly still in business. It was revealed that China Status disabled Wang Fuk Court’s fire safety system in April last year for repairs on the rooftop water tanks and applied to extend the shutdown period 16 times. The estate’s fire alarms remained disabled when the blaze broke out last November. A photo showing the control panel of the upfeed water pump at Wang Cheong House, dated December 2, 2025. Photo: Wang Fuk Court independent committee. On November 19, a week before the blaze, Victory Fire discovered that the master switch had been turned off, affecting both the alarms and the fire hoses, but did not take further action. At a hearing this March, Chung Kit-man, a director and engineer at Victory Fire, defended himself, saying it was not his responsibility to address the disabled systems. Monday’s announcement comes after newspaper Ming Pao ran a front page report noting that disciplinary proceedings can result in the board reprimanding a contractor or removing their name from the register, permanently or for a specific period. Criminal prosecution would involve a separate procedure. In response to the paper’s enquiry as to whether the authorities had pressed charges against the two firms, the Fire Services Department only said that prosecutions would be initiated if there is sufficient evidence.
body.zh: 纪律委员会推迟了对两家消防安全承包商的听证会，据称这两家承包商在宏福苑去年起火之前未能妥善管理受损的消防安全系统。胜利消防工程公司董事兼工程师钟洁文（中）于 2026 年 3 月 30 日在公开听证会上就大埔大火作证。资料照片：Hans Tse/HKFP。消防处周一晚上在一份声明中表示，注册消防装置承建商纪律委员会已推迟原定于周五举行的胜利消防工程有限公司的听证会，“直至另行通知”。应双方共同要求，听证会延期“以进行准备”。针对宏福苑另一家消防承办商华基发展工程有限公司的聆讯也已延期，以便检方有更多时间处理案件。声明称，China Status 不反对延期。去年11月26日，宏福苑发生大火。庄园内八栋建筑中的七栋被它摧毁，造成 168 人死亡，数千人流离失所。有限的权力 一个独立委员会早些时候举行的听证会调查了致命火灾的原因和迅速蔓延，揭露了这两家公司涉嫌的疏忽，据报道，这两家公司仍在营业。据透露，China Status于去年4月因维修天台水箱而关闭宏福苑的消防安全系统，并申请延长关闭期16次。去年11月火灾爆发时，该庄园的火警警报器仍然处于禁用状态。宏昌楼上给水泵控制面板的照片，日期为 2025 年 12 月 2 日。照片：宏福苑独立委员会。 11月19日，即火灾发生前一周，胜利消防发现主开关已关闭，影响了警报器和消防水带，但没有采取进一步行动。在今年三月的一次听证会上，胜利消防公司董事兼工程师钟杰文为自己辩护，称解决瘫痪系统问题不是他的责任。周一宣布这一消息之前，《明报》在头版刊登了一篇报道，指出纪律程序可能导致董事会谴责承包商或将其名字从名册中永久或在特定时期内删除。刑事起诉将涉及一个单独的程序。消防处回应本报询问当局是否向两间公司提出检控时，仅表示如有足够证据会提出检控。

reflection.en: The postponement of the hearing for fire safety contractors in Hong Kong, following the Wang Fuk Court blaze, leaves questions of accountability lingering. Micah 6:8 reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, urging us to seek accountability and responsible stewardship in all our endeavors, especially when public safety is...
reflection.zh: 香港太子大厦火灾后，消防安全承包商的听证会被推迟，这使得问责问题悬而未决。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉持公平、喜爱怜悯，这敦促我们在所有事业中，尤其是在涉及公共安全时，寻求问责和负责任的管理。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Hong Kong’s MTR Corp wins bid as part of group to build new Sydney station, properties
title.zh: 香港地铁公司中标，参与建设悉尼新车站及物业

summary.en: Hong Kong's MTR Corporation, as part of a consortium, has won a bid to design and build a metro station and develop property in Sydney's second central business district. The deal, reportedly worth A$880 million, involves MTR and two partners, subsidiaries of Malaysian firm Gamuda Berhad.

The corporation said on Tuesday that it and its two partners – both subsidiaries of Malaysian engineering firm and developer Gamuda Berhad – won the bid as the joint-venture Riverside Link Consortium, with Australian media reporting the deal was worth A$880 million (HK$4.99 billion). The deal is a major...

reflection.en: The MTR Corporation's success in securing a major infrastructure project in Sydney is a testament to careful planning and execution. This achievement reminds us of the biblical principle to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that our plans will succeed through His guidance and blessing. It's a story of ambition realized through collaboration and...
reflection.zh: 香港铁路公司在悉尼赢得一项重大基础设施项目，是周密规划和执行的证明。这一成就提醒我们，应将我们的事业奉献给雅伟的原则，并信靠祂的指引和祝福使我们的计划得以成功。这是一个关于通过合作和战略远见实现抱负的故事。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Beijing sends record 16 Hong Kong civil servants for UN positions
title.zh: 北京派遣创纪录的16名香港公务员担任联合国职位

summary.en: Beijing has recommended the largest-ever cohort of civil servants from Hong Kong for roles in United Nations agencies this year, expecting the deployments to broaden their global perspective and strengthen the city’s position as a bridge between China and the international community. The 16 officers sent under the UN...
summary.zh: 今年，北京推荐了有史以来数量最多的香港公务员进入联合国机构任职，期望此举能拓宽他们的国际视野，并巩固香港作为中国与国际社会之间桥梁的地位。这16名官员通过联合国初级专业人员（JPO）计划被派往海外，他们来自13个不同级别和部门，包括海关、警察和廉政公署。

The 16 officers sent under the UN Junior Professional Officer (JPO) scheme represent 13 grades and departments, including customs, police and the city’s anti-corruption agency. This marks a steady increase from the...
body.zh: 北京今年推荐了有史以来规模最大的香港公务员到联合国机构任职，期望这些部署能够拓宽他们的全球视野，并加强香港作为中国与国际社会之间桥梁的地位。根据联合国初级专业官员（JPO）计划派出的16名官员代表13个级别和部门，包括海关、警察和该市反腐败机构。这标志着……的稳步增长。
