While this story concerns international postings rather than direct justice, it speaks to the broader mandate of public service. May these Hong Kong civil servants, in their new roles, embody integrity and serve with a spirit...
reflection.zh: 耶利米书22:3呼吁领袖要“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手。”虽然这个故事涉及的是国际任职而非直接的司法公正，但它触及了更广泛的公共服务职责。愿这些香港公务员在新的岗位上，秉持诚信，以提升全球社群的精神服务他人。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Free screenings to tackle myopia crisis
title.zh: 免费筛查应对近视危机

summary.en: The non-profit organisation Orbis International and the University of Hong Kong’s Faculty of Medicine (HKUMed) have launched a joint initiative to combat the city's myopia crisis. The partnership will offer 1,000 free paediatric eye exams and 1,000 adult myopia screenings, alongside a three-year clinical trial for...
summary.zh: 非营利组织爱明会（Orbis...

body.en: The non-profit organisation, Orbis International, and the University of Hong Kong’s Faculty of Medicine (HKUMed) have launched a joint initiative to combat the city's myopia crisis. The partnership will offer 1,000 free paediatric eye exams and 1,000 adult myopia screenings, alongside a three-year clinical trial for advanced therapies. Medical experts describe short-sightedness as a lifelong threat — a condition that takes root in primary school but, if left unmanaged, drastically raises the risk of irreversible blindness in adulthood. A 2025 HKUMed study conducted at the HKU Eye Centre examined 501 children aged five to 12 and found that nearly eight in 20 children, or 39.7 percent, suffered from myopia. Professor Christopher Leung, from the Department of Ophthalmology at HKUMed, said myopia development and progression actively happens during this age range. “The length of the eyeball keeps growing during childhood. We are talking about when we were young, two or three years of age, typically we see hyperopia, but after three four years of age, the eyeball continues to grow and this is the time when myopia kicks in,” he said. “In some cases, we even see a relatively high degree of myopia developing at the age of five or six years old. It's by the time when we reach about 15 or 16 years of age, the growth begins to retard and that's the time when the length of the eyeball becomes stabilised.” To evaluate the long‑term impact, HKUMed researchers also analysed 4,217 adults aged 50 and older, revealing that 44.5 percent of older adults suffered from myopia, with 6.7 percent suffering from high myopia. Experts caution that while glasses correct blurred distance vision, they do not reverse the excessive elongation of the eyeball or eliminate the risks of high myopia, including retinal disease, cataracts, and permanent sight loss. In direct response, the organisations are rolling out these free services targeting 1,000 children and 1,000 high-risk older adults. Alongside these immediate community services, the organisations are planning the Children Myopia Control Study in 2027, a three-year clinical trial that will evaluate 0.05 percent atropine eye drops, optical defocus spectacle lenses, and a combination of both therapies for children aged five to 12. Ophthalmologists are calling on parents to prioritise annual professional eye examinations. If myopia is detected, they urge families to seek professional advice and discuss evidence-based control options beyond standard prescriptions. They also recommend that children get regular outdoor time, take regular breaks from close work, and maintain a comfortable reading distance. Registration for the children's screenings is now open, with adult screening details to be announced soon. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 非盈利组织国际奥比斯和香港大学医学院（HKUMed）发起了一项联合倡议，以应对香港的近视危机。该合作伙伴关系将提供 1,000 次免费儿科眼科检查和 1,000 次成人近视筛查，以及为期三年的先进疗法临床试验。医学专家将近视描述为一种终生威胁——这种情况在小学就已扎根，但如果不加以控制，会大大增加成年后不可逆转失明的风险。香港大学眼科中心于2025年对501名5至12岁的儿童进行了一项研究，结果发现，每20名儿童中近八名（即39.7%）患有近视。香港大学医学院眼科系梁基文教授表示，近视的发展和进展在这个年龄段非常活跃。 “眼球的长度在童年时期一直在增长。我们说的是小时候，两三岁时，我们通常会看到远视，但三四岁之后，眼球继续增长，这就是近视发生的时候，”他说。 “在某些情况下，我们甚至在五六岁的时候就出现了相对较高的近视度数。到了大约15、16岁的时候，近视度数的增长开始放缓，此时眼球的长度才趋于稳定。”为了评估长期影响，港大医学院研究人员还对4,217名50岁或以上的成年人进行了分析，发现44.5%的老年人患有近视，其中6.7%患有高度近视。专家警告说，虽然眼镜可以矫正远处视力模糊，但它们并不能扭转眼球的过度拉长或消除高度近视的风险，包括视网膜疾病、白内障和永久性视力丧失。作为直接回应，这些组织正在针对 1,000 名儿童和 1,000 名高危老年人推出这些免费服务。除了这些直接的社区服务外，这些组织还计划在 2027 年开展儿童近视控制研究，这是一项为期三年的临床试验，将针对 5 至 12 岁的儿童评估 0.05% 阿托品滴眼液、光学散焦眼镜片以及这两种疗法的组合。眼科医生呼吁家长优先考虑每年一次的专业眼科检查。如果发现近视，他们敦促家人寻求专业建议并讨论标准处方之外的基于证据的控制方案。他们还建议孩子们有规律的户外时间，在近距离工作中定期休息，并保持舒适的阅读距离。儿童放映报名现已开放，成人放映详情即将公布。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: This initiative by Orbis International and HKUMed directly addresses the growing crisis of myopia among children and adults in Hong Kong. By providing free screenings and eye exams, they are acting as a voice for those who might otherwise not receive necessary care, preventing potential lifelong vision impairment. This proactive approach embodies the...
reflection.zh: 爱明会与香港大学医学院的这项倡议，直接应对了香港儿童和成人日益严重的近视危机。通过提供免费筛查和眼科检查，他们为那些可能无法获得必要护理的人发声，从而预防了可能伴随终身的视力损害。这种积极主动的方法体现了为弱势群体代言的原则，确保早期发现和治疗的可及性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: HK sends record 16 young civil servants to UN
title.zh: 香港向联合国输送创纪录的16名年轻公务员

summary.en: A record number of sixteen young public officers from Hong Kong have been selected for positions at the United Nations through its junior professional officer programme. This marks the largest contingent from Hong Kong since the program's inception. These officers, representing diverse government departments, will...
summary.zh: 香港有创纪录的十六名年轻公务员通过其初级专业人员方案被选派到联合国任职。这是自该计划启动以来香港人数最多的一次。这些来自不同政府部门的官员将在联合国总部及日内瓦、维也纳和内罗毕的办事处任职两年。

body.en: Sixteen young public officers from Hong Kong will take up positions at the United Nations under its junior professional officer programme, the highest number since the scheme began. The news came as the officers, the third batch from Hong Kong to join the programme, took part in a ceremony at the Office of the Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in the SAR on Tuesday. They come from 12 government departments, including the Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau, the Department of Justice, the Hong Kong Police Force and the Independent Commission Against Corruption. They will serve two-year tenures at UN headquarters and offices in Geneva, Vienna and Nairobi and begin departing this month. Speaking at the ceremony, Chief Executive John Lee said the SAR government will soon publish its first-ever Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development, which will align with the nation's 15th Five-Year Plan. He encouraged the third batch of officers to serve with three "hearts" – one for the nation, a second for Hong Kong, and a third for the world. Lee also urged them to serve as super connectors and super value-adders linking the nation with the international community, and to tell authentic and compelling stories of the SAR on the global stage. Hong Kong previously sent five officers in 2019 and 12 in 2023 under the same programme. The UN side has commended their performance, with some having their tenures extended. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 根据初级专业官员计划，来自香港的 16 名年轻公职人员将在联合国任职，这是该计划启动以来的最高数字。消息传出之际，第三批参加该计划的香港官员周二在外交部驻特派员公署参加了仪式。他们来自财经事务及库务局、律政司、香港警务处、廉政公署等12个政府部门。他们将在联合国总部以及日内瓦、维也纳和内罗毕办事处任职两年，并于本月开始离职。行政长官李家超在仪式上致辞时表示，特区政府即将公布首个经济社会发展五年规划，与国家“十五五”规划相衔接。他勉励第三批军官要怀着三颗“心”服役，一颗为国家，一颗为香港，一颗为世界。李光耀还敦促他们成为连接国家与国际社会的超级联系人和超级增值者，在国际舞台上讲述真实而引人入胜的特区故事。香港此前曾在同一计划下于 2019 年派遣了 5 名官员，并于 2023 年派遣了 12 名官员。联合国方面对他们的表现给予了赞扬，并延长了一些人的任期。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: It is encouraging to see young public servants from Hong Kong embarking on international service at the United Nations. This initiative reflects a commitment to global engagement and the development of future leaders. May they carry out their duties with integrity, seeking justice and serving all people with compassion, embodying the principles of good...
reflection.zh: 看到香港的年轻公务员在联合国开启国际服务生涯，令人鼓舞。这一举措体现了对全球参与和未来领导者培养的承诺。愿他们秉持正直履行职责，寻求公义，并以怜悯之心服务于所有人，体现良好治理的原则。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: 'Contractors pushed to fix QMH lifts by Q4'
title.zh: 承建商被敦促在第四季度修复QMH电梯

summary.en: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn stated on Tuesday that the government is pressuring contractors to repair the malfunctioning lifts in the new clinical block of Queen Mary Hospital, expressing confidence that the work will be finished within the fourth quarter of this year. This follows a series of lift...
summary.zh: 发展局局长林郑月娥周二表示，政府正敦促承建商修复玛丽医院新临床大楼的故障电梯，并有信心该修复工程将于今年第四季度完成。此前，一系列电梯故障已导致该医院重建计划中的新大楼启用延迟。林郑月娥将问题归咎于工程、技术和检验方面的问题，指出部分电梯组件可能安装不当或已损坏，而某些电梯井道的尺寸问题也阻碍了电梯的顺畅运行。

body.en: Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn on Tuesday said the government is pushing contractors to fix the faulty lifts at Queen Mary Hospital's new clinical block, and she is confident the rectification work would be completed in the fourth quarter of this year. It follows a series of lift defects that delayed the opening of the new building, which is part of the hospital's redevelopment plan. Speaking to reporters, Linn said the problems stem from engineering, technical and inspection issues. She explained that some lift components may have been poorly installed or damaged, while problems with the sizing of some lift shafts have left too little room for the lifts to operate smoothly. But she said engineers believed they could solve the problems. "We will definitely ensure that all these elevators comply with all requirements before handing over the remaining parts of the building to Queen Mary Hospital for their preparation work," she said. She stressed that all costs arising from the rectification work would be borne by the main contractor and subcontractors, and the government would reserve the right to claim damages under the contract. As for the impact on hospital services, Linn said that would be assessed by the Health Bureau and the Hospital Authority. She said her team hopes to get the job done as soon as possible and hand over the building safely and properly. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 发展局局长伯纳黛特·林恩(Bernadette Linn)周二表示，政府正在推动承包商修复玛丽医院新临床区有故障的电梯，她相信整改工作将在今年第四季度完成。此前，一系列电梯缺陷导致新大楼的启用被推迟，而新大楼是医院重建计划的一部分。林恩在接受记者采访时表示，这些问题源于工程、技术和检查问题。她解释，部分升降机组件可能安装不良或损坏，而部分升降机井道尺寸问题导致升降机平稳运行的空间太小。但她说工程师相信他们可以解决这些问题。她说：“我们一定会确保所有这些电梯符合所有要求，然后再将建筑物的其余部分移交给玛丽医院进行准备工作。”她强调，整改工程产生的所有费用将由总承建商及分包商承担，政府保留根据合约索偿损失的权利。至于对医院服务的影响，林恩表示，将由卫生局和医院管理局评估。她表示，她的团队希望尽快完成工作，安全、妥善地移交大楼。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The news highlights the frustration and inconvenience caused by malfunctioning essential infrastructure, like the lifts at Queen Mary Hospital. It underscores the responsibility of public officials and contractors to ensure that public services, particularly in healthcare settings, are reliable and functional. The commitment to rectify these issues by the...
reflection.zh: 该新闻突显了像玛丽医院电梯这类关键基础设施故障所带来的挫败感和不便。它强调了公职人员和承包商确保公共服务（尤其是在医疗环境中）可靠和正常运行的责任。承诺在第四季度前解决这些问题，体现了履行这一职责的努力。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong families hit as volcanic ash strands up to 200 helpers in Indonesia
title.zh: 火山灰滞留印尼，香港家庭受影响，多达200名帮佣滞留

summary.en: Up to 200 domestic helpers bound for Hong Kong are stranded in Indonesia due to volcanic ash from Mount Anak Krakatoa, causing disruptions and potential further closures of affected airports.
summary.zh: 由于喀拉喀托火山喷发产生的火山灰，多达200名前往香港的家庭佣工滞留在印度尼西亚，导致航班延误和机场关闭。

body.en: Up to 200 Hong Kong-bound domestic helpers remain stranded in Indonesia despite the reopening of several affected airports, as the city’s employment agencies association braces for possible further closures due to volcanic ash. The Indonesian transport ministry said Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport resumed operations on Tuesday after being shut for several days, following the eruption of Mount Anak Krakatoa on Saturday, which affected thousands of travellers. Among those stranded...
body.zh: 尽管多个受影响的机场已重新开放，但仍有多达 200 名前往香港的家庭佣工滞留在印度尼西亚，因为该市的职业介绍所协会正准备应对因火山灰而进一步关闭的情况。印度尼西亚交通部表示，周六阿纳克喀拉喀托火山喷发影响了数千名旅客，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场在关闭数天后于周二恢复运营。在那些被困的人中...

reflection.en: The eruption of Mount Anak Krakatoa has disrupted travel plans, leaving hundreds of domestic helpers stranded in Indonesia. These workers, often the sole breadwinners for their families, face uncertainty and hardship far from home. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for everyone who is charged may not have the...
reflection.zh: 喀拉喀托火山的喷发扰乱了旅行计划，导致数百名家庭佣工滞留在印度尼西亚。这些工人常常是家庭的唯一经济支柱，他们在远离家乡的地方面临着不确定和困苦。《箴言》31:8-9 呼吁我们：“为不能说自己话的人，为所有被审判的人，要开口说话，为所有孤苦无依的人，要伸张正义。”...

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Rewards for tipoffs 'can help cut out forced shopping'
title.zh: 举报奖励可助杜绝强迫购物

summary.en: A tourism industry representative suggested on Tuesday that authorities consider implementing a reward system to incentivize tour guides to report malpractices, such as forced shopping. This proposal follows the recent revocation of licenses for two travel agencies and a tour guide by the Travel Industry Authority for...
summary.zh: 一位旅游业代表周二呼吁当局考虑设立奖励制度，鼓励导游举报诸如强迫购物等不当行为。此建议是在旅游业监管机构吊销了两家旅行社和一名导游的牌照后提出的，原因是他们强迫内地游客购物，这是该机构一个月内采取的第二次此类执法行动。该代表指出，旅游业监管机构表示缺乏足够人手进行检查和执法，因此奖励制度可以鼓励更多人举报。

body.en: A tourism-industry representative called on authorities on Tuesday to consider putting in place a reward system to encourage tour guides to report malpractices such as forced shopping. The suggestion came after the Travel Industry Authority revoked the licences of two travel agencies and a tour guide on Monday for coercing mainland tourists into making purchases – the second such enforcement action in a month. Speaking on RTHK, Sara Leung, chairwoman of the Hong Kong Tourism Industry Employees' General Union, said that with the Travel Industry Authority saying it lacked the manpower to carry out inspections and law-enforcement action, a reward system could encourage more people to report malpractices. "Look, people in the trade sometimes see things. If they can report them and get a reward, then more people might be willing to take part," she said. "That way, you won't have to worry about the manpower problem.'' Leung said low‑cost package tours are the easiest way to attract customers in the highly competitive sector, with agents often having to resort to methods like coercive shopping in order to to make a profit. For some agencies, she added, it's a quick way to earn money. However, Leung said, such reports of forced shopping are very damaging to the reputation of the industry, making visitors reluctant to join package tours. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 一位旅游业代表周二呼吁当局考虑建立奖励制度，鼓励导游举报强迫购物等不当行为。这项建议是在周一吊销两家旅行社和一名导游的执照后提出的，原因是两家旅行社和一名导游强迫大陆游客购物，这是一个月内的第二起此类执法行动。香港旅游业总工会主席梁绍文在接受香港电台采访时表示，由于旅游业监管局表示缺乏人手进行检查和执法行动，奖励制度可以鼓励更多人举报不当行为。 “你看，业内人士有时会看到一些事情。如果他们能够举报并获得奖励，那么可能会有更多的人愿意参与其中，”她说。 “这样就不用担心人手问题了。”梁女士表示，在竞争激烈的行业中，低价跟团游是最容易吸引顾客的方式，旅行社往往不得不采取强制购物等方式来获取利润。她补充说，对一些旅行社来说，这是一种快速赚钱的方法。不过，梁女士表示，此类强迫购物的报道对行业声誉造成很大损害，导致游客不愿参加跟团游。编辑：Tony Sabine

reflection.en: The proposal for a reward system to combat forced shopping highlights a need for ethical practices within the tourism industry. It points to the responsibility of authorities to ensure justice and protect visitors from exploitation. This echoes the ancient call for rulers to uphold righteousness and deliver the oppressed from their oppressors.
reflection.zh: 为打击强迫购物而提出的奖励制度建议，凸显了旅游业在道德实践方面的需求。这表明了当局有责任确保公正并保护游客免受剥削。这呼应了古代要求统治者维护公义、拯救受压迫者脱离压迫者的呼吁。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Hong Kong a boon to Kazakhstan’s advanced manufacturing ambitions, ties to Europe: expert
title.zh: 香港助力哈萨克斯坦先进制造业雄心，连接欧洲：专家

summary.en: Hong Kong firms could leverage Kazakhstan as a hub for advanced manufacturing and a gateway to Europe, while Kazakhstan's businesses could tap into Hong Kong's strong capital markets, according to a diplomat and business advisor.
summary.zh: 一位外交官兼商业顾问表示，香港公司可以利用哈萨克斯坦作为先进制造业基地和通往欧洲的门户，而香港强大的资本市场则可以吸引中亚国家的企业。

body.en: Hong Kong firms could look to Kazakhstan as a base for advanced manufacturing and as a gateway to Europe, while the city’s robust capital markets could attract businesses in the Central Asian country, a diplomat and business adviser has said. Sabr Yessimbekov, adviser to the chairman of the presidium of the National Chamber of Entrepreneurs of the Republic of Kazakhstan, told the South China Morning Post on the sidelines of the inaugural China Conference: Central Asia 2026 that some projects in...
body.zh: 一位外交官兼商业顾问表示，香港公司可以将哈萨克斯坦视为先进制造业的基地和通往欧洲的门户，而该市强劲的资本市场可以吸引这个中亚国家的企业。哈萨克斯坦共和国国家企业家商会主席团主席顾问萨布尔·叶辛别科夫 (Sabr Yesimbekov) 在首届中国会议：中亚 2026 的间隙告诉《南华早报》，...

reflection.en: This news points to the potential for fruitful collaboration between Hong Kong and Kazakhstan. As businesses and nations forge new partnerships, the ancient wisdom of Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh. When our plans are aligned with divine purpose and pursued with integrity, we can trust that our efforts will be established,...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻指出了香港与哈萨克斯坦之间潜在的富有成效的合作。当企业和国家建立新的伙伴关系时，箴言16:3的古老智慧提醒我们要将我们的努力托付给雅伟。当我们的计划与神的旨意一致并以诚信追求时，我们可以相信我们的努力将得以建立，从而带来互利的增长。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Commercial Radio fined HK$120,000 over failure to broadcast hourly news, weather reports
title.zh: 香港商业电台因未能播报新闻和天气报告而被罚款12万港元

summary.en: Commercial Radio Hong Kong has been fined HK$120,000 by the city's broadcasting watchdog for failing to broadcast certain hourly news and weather reports on its English channel, AM864, since May 2022. The Communications Authority cited "human error and administrative inadvertence" for the breaches, which violated the...
summary.zh: 香港商业电台因未能自2022年5月起在其英语频道AM864播报特定时段的新闻和天气报告，被香港广播事务管理局罚款12万港元。通讯事务管理局将此次违规归咎于“人为失误和行政疏忽”，违反了该电台每日早上7点至晚上11点之间播报新闻的协议。

body.en: A Hong Kong radio station has been fined HK$120,000 for failing to broadcast certain hourly news and weather reports since 2022, the city’s broadcasting watchdog has said. Office of the Communications Authority. Photo: OFCA. Commercial Radio Hong Kong’s (CRHK) English radio channel, AM864, failed to broadcast the reports between May 1, 2022, and April 2, 2026, due to “human error and administrative inadvertence,” according to a Monday statement issued by the Communications Authority (CA). Under the broadcaster’s agreement with the authorities, AM864 is required to broadcast hourly news reports between 7am and 11pm daily, with no further changes allowed without the watchdog’s prior approval, the statement said. The station is also supposed to broadcast weather reports at 7am and from 6pm to 11pm. According to Hong Kong law, the authority can issue monetary fines when a station or broadcaster breaks certain rules. ‘Hardly acceptable’ Despite the broadcaster’s assessment that the impact on listeners was likely minimal, given the channel’s relatively small audience base, its non-compliance “over a prolonged four-year period was hardly acceptable,” the statement read. The statement said that the broadcaster submitted inaccurate records to the watchdog. The authority also said that CRHK has rectified its errors by resuming all required hourly news and weather reports since April 3 this year. Apart from the financial penalty, CRHK should “enhance internal monitoring to prevent recurrence of incidents of a similar nature,” the watchdog added. The broadcaster will also be required to submit plans for “enhanced procedures” to the watchdog within one month, to strengthen internal operations and establish a monitoring system to ensure compliance. “The CA stresses that licensed broadcasters bear the responsibility of ensuring continued compliance with all regulatory requirements,” the statement read.
body.zh: 香港广播监管机构表示，香港一家广播电台因自 2022 年以来未能播放某些每小时新闻和天气预报而被罚款 12 万港元。通讯事务管理局办公室。照片：通讯办。根据通讯事务管理局 (CA) 周一发布的声明，由于“人为错误和行政疏忽”，香港商业电台 (CRHK) 的英语广播频道 AM864 在 2022 年 5 月 1 日至 2026 年 4 月 2 日期间未能播出这些报道。声明称，根据广播公司与当局的协议，AM864 必须每天上午 7 点至晚上 11 点之间每小时播放新闻报道，未经监管机构事先批准，不得进行进一步更改。该电视台还应在早上 7 点和下午 6 点至晚上 11 点播放天气预报。根据香港法律，当电台或广播公司违反某些规则时，当局可以处以罚款。声明称，尽管广播公司评估认为，考虑到该频道的观众基础相对较小，对听众的影响可能很小，但其“在长达四年的时间里”的不合规行为是难以接受的。声明称，广播公司向监管机构提交了不准确的记录。当局还表示，CRHK已纠正错误，自今年4月3日起恢复所有规定的每小时新闻和天气预报。该监管机构补充说，除了经济处罚外，CRHK还应“加强内部监控，防止类似性质的事件再次发生”。广播公司还需要在一个月内向监管机构提交“强化程序”计划，以加强内部运营并建立监控系统以确保合规。声明中写道：“通讯局强调，持牌广播公司有责任确保持续遵守所有监管要求。”

reflection.en: The Communications Authority's fine on Commercial Radio Hong Kong for administrative oversights serves as a reminder of the importance of diligence and faithfulness in fulfilling public duties. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God,' principles that extend to the reliable execution of responsibilities, even in...
reflection.zh: 通讯事务管理局对香港商业电台因行政疏忽处以罚款，提醒我们履行公共职责时勤勉和忠实的重要性。弥迦书6章8节呼吁我们“行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行”，这些原则也适用于可靠地履行职责，即使是在播报基本信息这样看似日常的事务上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Elderly woman charged with displaying seditious publications outside flat, remanded at psychiatric centre
title.zh: 老妇被控在家外展示煽动性刊物，遭还押精神科中心

summary.en: An elderly woman has been charged with displaying publications with a seditious intention outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai. Yang Chau-kei, 61, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for the first mention of her case. She stands accused of putting up materials with a seditious intention outside her...
summary.zh: 一名老妇被控在天水围的住所外展示意图煽动的刊物。61岁的杨秋记（Yang Chau-kei）周一在西九龙裁判法院首次提堂。她被指控于2024年3月至11月期间，在其天颂苑的住所外——包括公寓门、客厅窗户和楼道内——张贴意图煽动的材料。杨女士此举意在煽动对香港当局和“宪法确立的国家根本制度”的仇恨。

body.en: An elderly woman has been charged with displaying publications with a seditious intention outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai. West Kowloon Law Courts Building. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yang Chau-kei, 61, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for the first mention of her case. She stands accused of putting up materials with a seditious intention outside her apartment in Tin Chung Court – including on her apartment door, on the living room window, and in the building corridor – between March and November 2024. In doing so, Yang intended to stir up hatred against Hong Kong authorities and “the fundamental system of the state established by the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China,” a charge sheet prepared by the prosecution stated. According to local media, Yang chose to defend herself, refusing the services of a duty lawyer assigned to defendants who lack representation. Wearing a black top and black face mask, she said multiple times in Cantonese: “I did not break the law, they framed me” – a phrase she repeated when asked by Chief Magistrate Victor So if she needed a lawyer. Tin Chung Court in Tin Shui Wai. Photo: Wikicommons. So expressed concerns about Yang’s mental state, and asked the prosecution whether she had a history of seeking psychiatric treatment. The prosecution said she had no such record. When asked by So whether she knew she was in a courtroom, and if she had sought psychiatric help before, the defendant continued repeating, “I did not break the law, they framed me.” So adjourned the case to September 21 to give time for the prosecution to order psychiatric reports to assess whether Yang is fit to submit a plea. She was remanded in Siu Lam Psychiatric Centre. Yang faces up to seven years’ imprisonment under the local security law, if convicted. Separate from the 2020 Beijing-enacted security law , the homegrown Safeguarding National Security Ordinance targets treason, insurrection, sabotage, external interference, sedition, theft of state secrets and espionage. It allows for pre-charge detention of up to 16 days, and suspects’ access to lawyers may be restricted, with penalties involving up to life in prison . Article 23 was shelved in 2003 amid mass protests, remaining taboo for years. But, on March 23, 2024, it was enacted having been fast-tracked and unanimously approved at the city’s opposition-free legislature. The law has been criticised by rights NGOs , Western states and the UN as vague, broad and “regressive.” Authorities, however, cited perceived foreign interference and a constitutional duty to “close loopholes” after the 2019 protests and unrest .
body.zh: 一名年长妇女被指控在天水围的公寓外展示具有煽动意图的出版物。西九龙法院大楼。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 61 岁的杨秋琪周一在西九龙裁判法院出庭，首次审理她的案件。她被指控于2024年3月至11月期间在天颂苑公寓外张贴具有煽动意图的材料，包括在公寓门上、客厅窗户上和大楼走廊上。检方准备的一份指控书称，杨这样做的目的是煽动对香港当局和“中华人民共和国宪法确立的国家基本制度”的仇恨。据当地媒体报道，杨选择为自己辩护，拒绝为缺乏代理的被告指派的值班律师提供服务。她身穿黑色上衣，戴着黑色口罩，多次用粤语说：“我没有违法，是他们陷害我。”当首席裁判官苏维乔询问她是否需要律师时，她重复了这句话。天水围天颂苑。照片：维基共享资源。因此对杨的精神状态表示担忧，并询问检方是否有寻求精神治疗的历史。检方称她没有此类记录。当苏问她是否知道自己在法庭上，以及之前是否寻求过精神科帮助时，被告继续重复：“我没有违法，他们陷害了我。”因此，案件押后至9月21日，以便检方有时间下令提供精神病学报告，以评估杨是否适合提出抗辩。她被还押于小榄精神科中心。如果罪名成立，杨根据当地安全法将面临最高七年的监禁。与2020年北京颁布的国安法不同，本土制定的《维护国家安全条例》针对的是叛国、叛乱、破坏、外部干涉、煽动叛乱、窃取国家机密和间谍活动。它允许指控前拘留长达 16 天，并且嫌疑人会见律师的机会可能受到限制，最高可判处终身监禁。 2003年，第23条在大规模抗议活动中被搁置，多年来一直是禁忌。但是，该法案于 2024 年 3 月 23 日在该市无反对派的立法机构快速审议并获得一致批准后颁布。该法律被人权非政府组织、西方国家和联合国批评为含糊、宽泛和“倒退”。然而，当局表示，在 2019 年抗议和骚乱之后，认为有外国干涉，并规定了“堵住漏洞”的宪法义务。

reflection.en: The case of Yang Chau-kei, a 61-year-old woman facing charges for displaying publications deemed seditious, raises questions about freedom of expression and the potential silencing of individuals, particularly the elderly, who voice dissent. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are...
reflection.zh: 杨秋记女士，一位61岁的女性，因展示被视为煽动性的刊物而面临指控，此案引发了关于言论自由以及那些表达异议的个人（尤其是老年人）可能被压制的疑问。《箴言》31:8-9 提醒我们：“当为不能言语的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤。”这促使我们要关注弱势群体，并确保所有声音都有机会被听见，即使它们挑战了既有的体系。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Driver thanks ‘superhero’ rival for saving him from flaming race car at Shanghai Int’l Circuit
title.zh: 赛车手感谢“超级英雄”对手在上海国际赛道救出着火赛车

summary.en: British racing driver Ollie Millroy expressed gratitude towards his rival, Loek Hartog, for rescuing him from his burning car after a severe crash at the Shanghai International Circuit. Hartog stopped his own race, used a fire extinguisher on Millroy's vehicle, and then pulled him to safety, an act Millroy described...
summary.zh: 英国赛车手奥利·米尔罗伊（Ollie Millroy）对他的对手洛克·哈特og（Loek Hartog）表示感谢，后者在上海国际赛车场发生严重碰撞后，将他从燃烧的赛车中救出。哈特og停下自己的比赛，用灭火器扑灭了米尔罗伊赛车的火焰，然后将他拉了出来，米尔罗伊称此举是英雄之举。

body.en: A British racing driver thanked a “superhero” rival for pulling him from the flaming wreckage of his car after a horror crash in Shanghai, saying the quick response saved his life. Loek Hartog saves fellow racer Ollie Millroy from a burning car in a daring rescue on Saturday, September 5, 2026 in Shanghai. Photo: Ollie Millroy via Instagram. Loek Hartog stopped and leapt out of his own car to rush to the aid of Ollie Millroy during the China GT Championship race at the Shanghai International Circuit, home of the Chinese Formula One Grand Prix. The Dutchman used a fire extinguisher on Millroy’s Ferrari as a blaze raged before yanking open the driver’s door and dragging him to safety. “I am still alive tonight entirely thanks to one man,” Millroy posted on Instagram. “Loek Hartog stopped instantly with no flag marshals or fire crews in sight and risked his own life to get me out of the car,” he added. The 36-year-old Millroy suffered a huge impact in the multi-car crash during Saturday’s race, which resulted in his car erupting instantly in flames. “I don’t remember anything… but I will remember his incredible act of bravery for the rest of my life,” Millroy said. “One day I will tell our three kids this story and Loek will be the biggest superhero in history in their eyes too. “I’m lying here tonight with five broken ribs, broken collar bone, broken hand and finger and a bruised lung, but it could have been much worse. “Thank you Loek. I owe you my life for your selfless act today.” Hartog, 23, played down his heroics in a social media note posted after visiting Millroy in hospital. “It was terrifying and there were moments when I didn’t know if I’d ever manage to get Ollie out,” he said. “But it’s not about what I did. I’m sure many people in my position would have reacted exactly the same way. “The most important thing is that Ollie is okay. Things could have turned out very differently today and I’m truly grateful that they didn’t.” Millroy’s team, AAI Motorsport, said they would “no longer participate in any races organised by China GT” in a statement that criticised safety standards at the circuit. The team said Millroy’s car “continued to burn for more than a minute” after the crash and that “no timely and effective firefighting and rescue operations were seen”. The China GT Championship organising committee said in a statement on Weibo: “We sincerely apologise for this accident and for the subsequent shock and distress it has caused. “We will conduct a thorough review and investigation into this accident, and draw...
body.zh: 一名英国赛车手感谢一位“超级英雄”竞争对手在上海发生恐怖车祸后将他从燃烧的汽车残骸中拉了出来，并表示快速反应救了他的命。 2026 年 9 月 5 日星期六，上海，洛克·哈托格 (Loek Hartog) 在一次大胆的救援行动中从一辆着火的汽车中救出了赛车手奥利·米尔罗伊 (Ollie Millroy)。照片：Ollie Millroy，来自 Instagram。在中国一级方程式大奖赛的举办地——上海国际赛车场举行的 China GT 锦标赛上，洛克·哈托格 (Loek Hartog) 停下来，跳下自己的车，冲向奥利·米尔罗伊 (Ollie Millroy) 施救。当大火蔓延时，荷兰人对米尔罗伊的法拉利使用了灭火器，然后拉开驾驶座车门，将他拖到安全地带。米尔罗伊在 Instagram 上发帖称：“今晚我还活着，完全归功于一个人。” “洛克·哈托格立即停下来，看不到旗警或消防人员，他冒着生命危险把我从车里救出来，”他补充道。 36岁的米尔罗伊在周六的比赛中遭遇多车相撞事故，受到巨大冲击，导致他的赛车立即起火。 “我什么都不记得了……但我会终生记住他令人难以置信的勇敢行为，”米尔罗伊说。 “有一天，我会告诉我们的三个孩子这个故事，洛克也将成为他们眼中历史上最伟大的超级英雄。“今晚我躺在这里，五根肋骨骨折，锁骨骨折，手和手指骨折，肺部瘀伤，但情况可能会更糟。 “谢谢你洛克。今天你的无私行为我欠你一条命。” 23 岁的哈托格在探望米尔罗伊住院后，在社交媒体上发表了一篇文章，淡化了自己的英雄事迹。 “这太可怕了，有时候我不知道自己是否能把奥利救出来，”他说。 “但这与我做了什么无关。我相信很多处于我位置的人都会做出完全相同的反应。“最重要的是奥利没事。今天事情的结果可能会大不相同，我真的很感激他们没有这么做。”米尔罗伊的车队 AAI Motorsport 在一份批评赛道安全标准的声明中表示，他们将“不再参加 China GT 组织的任何比赛”。该团队表示，事故发生后，米尔罗伊的汽车“继续燃烧一分多钟”，并且“没有看到及时有效的消防和救援行动”。中国GT锦标赛组委会在微博上发表声明称：“对于此次事故以及由此造成的震惊和痛苦，我们深表歉意。 “我们将对这起事故进行彻底审查和调查，并得出...

reflection.en: In the heat of competition, Loek Hartog saw not a rival, but a person in desperate need. His immediate, selfless action to rescue Ollie Millroy from a burning car transcends the race itself. It reminds us that in moments of crisis, our shared humanity calls us to be neighbors, even to those we might otherwise see as opponents.
reflection.zh: 在竞争激烈的赛场上，洛克·哈特og看到的不是对手，而是一个处于危难中的人。他毫不犹豫地冲上前去，将奥利·米尔罗伊从燃烧的赛车中救出，这一举动超越了比赛本身。它提醒我们，在危机时刻，我们共同的人性呼唤我们成为邻舍，即使是对那些我们本可能视为对手的人。

verse.textEn: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers? ... 'Go and do likewise.'
verse.textZh: 你想这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？……「你去照样行吧。」

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein 股票在快时尚零售商上市首日下跌

summary.en: Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein fell by up to 10% on their trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26bn, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100bn. This listing followed unsuccessful attempts...
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港股市首次亮相时股价下跌了高达10%。这家起源于中国、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。此次上市是在未能在美国和英国上市之后进行的。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港上市 260 亿美元，此前快时尚品牌 Shein 在美国和英国上市失败，这家中国成立的公司在香港证券交易所首次上市，股价下跌 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's stock value on its Hong Kong debut, from a peak of nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, underscores the volatile nature of the business world. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, acknowledging that ultimate success and stability come from Him, not solely from market performance or human planning.
reflection.zh: Shein公司在香港上市首日股价大幅下跌，从近1000亿美元的峰值跌至略高于260亿美元，这凸显了商业世界的波动性。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，承认最终的成功和稳定源于祂，而不仅仅是市场表现或人的计划。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 希音伦敦股市避险，香港上市价格缩水，商业模式引人质疑

summary.en: China's fast-fashion giant Shein will list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation, raising significant questions about its business model. The company had previously considered a listing on the London stock market, with politicians from both major parties reportedly wooing it as a boost to the UK's financial scene and...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头希音（Shein）将在香港上市，估值有所缩水，并引发对其商业模式的重大疑问。该公司此前曾考虑在伦敦证券交易所上市，据报道，两党政治家都在争取其上市，认为这将提振英国金融业并表明其对国际资本的开放态度。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news about Shein's Hong Kong listing, with its 'shrunken price tag and big questions over its business model,' touches on the persistent concerns surrounding the fast-fashion industry. The pursuit of profit can sometimes overshadow ethical considerations in labor and environmental practices. The Bible warns, 'For the love of money is a root of all kinds...
reflection.zh: 关于希音在香港上市的消息，伴随着其“缩水的价格标签和对其商业模式的重大疑问”，触及了快时尚行业持续存在的担忧。对利润的追求有时会掩盖劳工和环境实践中的道德考量。《圣经》警告说：“贪财是万恶之根”（提摩太前书 6:10），提醒我们不受约束的财务野心可能导致有害的后果。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.zh: 自然科学

title.en: Shetland spaceport project secures £30m of UK government investment
title.zh: 萨克萨沃德太空港项目获得英国政府3000万英镑投资

summary.en: The UK government has announced an investment of £30 million in the SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland, which will be used to construct two additional launchpads. This funding is part of a new national space strategy and is expected to unlock further private investment.
summary.zh: 英国政府宣布向设在设得兰群岛的萨克萨沃德太空港投资3000万英镑，这笔资金将用于建造另外两个发射台。这项投资是国家太空战略的一部分，预计还将吸引更多的私人投资。

body.en:
The UK government has announced investment of £30m in SaxaVord Spaceport in Shetland as part of a new national space strategy.

A spaceport spokesperson said the funding was a "hugely significant" vote of confidence and would unlock a further £30m of private investment.

Several companies hope to use SaxaVord in Unst, the northernmost point in the UK, as a launch site for small commercial rockets.

A government spokesperson said space was "an increasingly important domain" for keeping the country safe.

SaxaVord is the UK's first fully-licensed spaceport and has regulatory approval for up to 30 rocket launches a year.

The company said the £60m public-private investment package would be used to design and build a second hangar and two more launchpads.

Chief executive officer Scott Hammond said the funding would take the company to the next stage of its development.

"We are building the spaceport for the thousandth as much as the first launch," he said.

"We're trying to create a successful, safe and sustainable business. This is direct investment into Shetland."

Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) is working towards its first vertical orbital test flight from UK soil. In August, SaxaVord paused plans for a test launch after RFA said it had "encountered an issue".

A five-week "launch window" had been due to begin, with temporary traffic restrictions introduced in the event of a flight attempt.

A second company, HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse), plans the second flight of its SR75 suborbital launch vehicle from Shetland this year.

SaxaVord Spaceport has confirmed that it is in discussions with other companies.

The UK government said the new space strategy would "drive growth, strengthen security and back the technologies that underpin modern life".

Ministers said they wanted to create jobs and help Britain and its partners launch satellites without relying on countries "further afield".

The money for the Shetland project is part of a £148m investment across Europe which ministers said would help UK space technology firms secure more work.

Scottish Secretary Douglas Alexander said: "Scotland already builds more satellites than anywhere else in Europe, and with a £30m UK government investment boost, SaxaVord is now poised to deliver up to three-quarters of the continent's orbital launch slots."

He added that defence, security and economic growth were at the heart of the plan.

Lise Kaae, chief executive of Heartland, which has a majority stake in SaxaVord Spaceport through its investment arm Wild Ventures, said: "We are very pleased to welcome the UK government as an investor and partner."
body.zh: 英国政府宣布向设得兰群岛的 SaxaVord 太空港投资 3000 万英镑，作为新国家太空战略的一部分。 太空港发言人表示，这笔资金是一次“意义重大”的信任投票，将进一步释放 3000 万英镑的私人投资。 多家公司希望利用位于英国最北端安斯特的 SaxaVord 作为小型商业火箭的发射场。 一位政府发言人表示，太空对于维护国家安全来说是“一个日益重要的领域”。 SaxaVord 是英国第一个获得完全许可的太空港，并获得监管部门批准，每年最多可进行 30 次火箭发射。 该公司表示，6000万英镑的公私投资计划将用于设计和建造第二个机库和另外两个发射台。 首席执行官斯科特·哈蒙德表示，这笔资金将带领公司进入下一发展阶段。 他说：“我们正在建造太空港，这与第一次发射的次数一样多。” “我们正在努力创建一个成功、安全和可持续的企业。这是对设得兰群岛的直接投资。” 奥格斯堡火箭工厂（RFA）正在努力从英国本土进行首次垂直轨道试飞。 8 月，在 RFA 表示“遇到问题”后，SaxaVord 暂停了测试发射计划。 为期五周的“发射窗口”原定开始，在尝试飞行时会实施临时交通限制。 第二家公司 HyImpulse Technologies GmbH (HyImpulse) 计划今年从设得兰群岛进行第二次 SR75 亚轨道运载火箭飞行。 SaxaVord Spaceport 已证实正在与其他公司进行讨论。 英国政府表示，新的太空战略将“推动增长、加强安全并支持支撑现代生活的技术”。 部长们表示，他们希望创造就业机会并帮助英国及其合作伙伴发射卫星，而不依赖“更远的”国家。 设得兰群岛项目的资金是整个欧洲 1.48 亿英镑投资的一部分，部长们表示，该投资将帮助英国太空技术公司获得更多工作。 苏格兰大臣道格拉斯·亚历山大 (Douglas Alexander) 表示：“苏格兰建造的卫星数量已经超过欧洲其他任何地方，在英国政府 3000 万英镑的投资推动下，SaxaVord 现在准备提供欧洲大陆多达四分之三的轨道发射位。” 他补充说，国防、安全和经济增长是该计划的核心。 Heartland 通过其投资部门 Wild Ventures 持有 SaxaVord Spaceport 的多数股权，其首席执行官 Lise Kaae 表示：“我们非常高兴欢迎英国政府作为投资者和合作伙伴。”

reflection.en: This significant investment in the SaxaVord Spaceport represents a bold step into the future of commercial spaceflight. As this ambitious project moves forward, may its leaders commit their endeavors to Yahweh, seeking His guidance and blessing for success and for the responsible development of this new frontier. May their work be a testament to human...
reflection.zh: 这项对萨克萨沃德太空港的巨额投资，标志着商业航天领域迈出了大胆的一步。随着这个雄心勃勃的项目向前推进，愿其领导者将他们的事业托付给雅伟，寻求祂的指引和祝福，以期取得成功并负责任地开发这一新领域。愿他们的工作成为人类智慧在神圣智慧引导下的明证。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Wildlife and access boost planned for city park
title.zh: 城市公园计划增加野生动植物和游客通道

summary.en: Coventry City Council is set to enhance Longford Nature Park by improving wildlife habitats and public access, utilizing funds from developers.
summary.zh: 考文垂市议会将利用开发商的资金，改善朗福德自然公园的野生动植物栖息地和公共通道。

body.en:
Work is due to start improving access and habitats for wildlife at a nature park in Coventry.

Longford Nature Park is a small reserve which the city council has designated as being of high importance to the city.

The improvements will include a new boardwalk across muddy parts of the park, litter-picking and the creation of shallow wetland habitats.

The work is being funded through Section 106 money, paid by developers to councils for major development projects in the area.

Councillor Patricia Hetherton said the improvements would help protect the biodiversity already at the park and make it easier for people to get closer to nature.

"Green spaces like Longford Park play an important role in supporting our health and wellbeing," she added.

Longford Park, as well as being a nature reserve, also acts as a public path, connecting the Coventry Building Society Arena and the Coventry Canal.

The project will be delivered by the council's urban ranger team, working with volunteers from the Friends of Longfofd Park.

Follow BBC Coventry & Warwickshire on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 考文垂自然公园的工作将开始改善野生动物的通道和栖息地。 朗福德自然公园是一个小型保护区，被市议会指定为对该市非常重要的保护区。 改进措施包括在公园的泥泞部分修建一条新的木板路、清理垃圾以及建立浅层湿地栖息地。 这项工程的资金来源是第 106 条规定的资金，由开发商向该地区重大开发项目的议会支付。 议员帕特里夏·赫瑟顿 (Patricia Hetherton) 表示，这些改进将有助于保护公园现有的生物多样性，让人们更容易亲近自然。 “像朗福德公园这样的绿色空间在支持我们的健康和福祉方面发挥着重要作用，”她补充道。 朗福德公园不仅是一个自然保护区，也是一条公共道路，连接考文垂建筑协会竞技场和考文垂运河。 该项目将由市议会的城市护林员团队与朗福德公园之友的志愿者合作实施。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Coventry & Warwickshire。

reflection.en: The planned improvements to Longford Nature Park, including new boardwalks and wetland habitats, reflect a thoughtful approach to enhancing biodiversity. It is a reminder of the intricate wisdom woven into the natural world, a testament to Yahweh's abundant creation that sustains life and offers beauty. May we, like the council, recognize the value in...
reflection.zh: 考文垂朗福德自然公园计划进行的改善，包括新建木板路和湿地栖息地，体现了对增强生物多样性的深思熟虑。这提醒我们自然界中蕴含的精妙智慧，是雅伟丰盛创造的明证，它维系生命并提供美丽。 愿我们也能像议会一样，认识到培育这些绿色空间的重要性，让野生动植物和人类和谐共存。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Are rich people really worse behaved? Here’s the science – podcast
title.zh: 富人真的行为更差吗？科学是这么说的——播客

summary.en: Research suggests that wealthy individuals are more prone to unethical behavior, such as stealing sweets from children. This finding, which won an Ig Nobel prize, prompts reflection on the relationship between wealth and morality, with scientists exploring potential underlying reasons for this phenomenon.
summary.zh: 研究表明，富裕人士更容易做出不道德行为，例如偷窃儿童的糖果。这项获得搞笑诺贝尔奖的研究促使人们反思财富与道德之间的关系，科学家们正在探索这种现象背后可能的原因。

body.en: Who’s more likely to steal sweets from a child? According to science, it’s the rich. A study seemingly confirming our suspicions about the moral behaviour of the wealthy was one of the winners of the 2026 Ig Nobel prizes, which honour research that makes you laugh and then think. Science editor Ian Sample tells Madeleine Finlay what the researchers think could be behind the phenomenon, and they explore some of the other awards, including one for a surprising quality we look for in our friends and another for a biomechanical definition of kissing Rich people more likely to steal children’s sweets, finds Ig Nobel prize-winning study Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...

reflection.en: This Ig Nobel prize-winning study humorously highlights a potential disconnect between wealth and ethical conduct, suggesting that affluence might correlate with a greater willingness to transgress. It prompts us to consider the societal implications of such findings and the importance of justice and mercy in all walks of life, regardless of economic status.
reflection.zh: 这项搞笑诺贝尔奖获奖研究以幽默的方式揭示了财富与道德行为之间可能存在的脱节，暗示富裕可能与更强的越轨意愿相关。它促使我们思考此类发现的社会影响，以及无论经济地位如何，在所有生活领域中公正和怜悯的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How beavers can help create fire breaks as part of a drought preparation plan
title.zh: 河狸如何作为干旱准备计划的一部分帮助创建防火带

summary.en: Most of the countryside around the Holnicote estate in Somerset has been dry and dusty for most of the summer. But one corner remains conspicuously green. Reintroduced just six years ago, beavers have helped turn a small watercourse on the estate into a wet meadow—a true oasis amid the parched landscape.
summary.zh: 索默塞特郡霍尔尼科特庄园周围的大部分乡村在整个夏天都干燥多尘。但有一个角落却格外翠绿。重新引入仅六年后，河狸已帮助将庄园里的一条小水道变成了一片湿草地——在一片干涸的土地中真正的绿洲。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Most of the countryside around the Holnicote estate in Somerset has been dry and dusty for most of the summer. But one corner remains conspicuously green.

Here in southwest England, an animal that was made extinct in Britain in the 16th century, mostly because of hunting, is making a comeback. Reintroduced just six years ago, beavers have helped turn a small watercourse on the estate into a wet meadow—a true oasis amid the parched landscape.

It is an Instagram-worthy example of why reintroducing beavers to more of Britain could help us prepare for the next drought. It shows how they reshape rivers and the surrounding land to hold water in the landscape for longer, rather than allowing it to drain away rapidly.

Beavers are often called ecosystem engineers. They fell small trees, build dams and dig channels . Water backs up behind their dams, spills across the valley bottom and soaks into the surrounding soil. Sediment and woody debris accumulate, while wetland plants establish themselves.

The result can be a mosaic of ponds, channels, marshes and wet woodland. During dry weather, this stored water can keep soil and vegetation wetter for longer.

This effect was highlighted in a 2008 Canadian study that examined aerial photographs of Elk Island National Park in Alberta over 54 years. Beavers had disappeared from that landscape in the 19th century but returned in 1954.

The number of active beaver lodges, where beavers live and raise their young, was found to explain more than 80% of the variation in the area of open water. During 2002, the driest year studied, wetlands with beavers contained nine times more open water than those without them.

This does not mean releasing beavers in Britain will reproduce the Canadian numbers. It is a different beaver species in a different landscape, and the effects of any beaver colony depend on the shape, soils and land use of its catchment. But British research points in the same direction.

Researchers studying a beaver enclosure on an intensively managed grassland in Devon in 2011 found that 13 dams stored around 1 million liters (264,000 gallons) of additional water. The dam structures built by the beavers held back the stream to create a series of ponds. Because such dams are leaky , this water was released gradually, slowing storm flows while maintaining water downstream during dry periods.

More recent work across four wild beaver territories in Devon estimated that their wetlands held more than 24 million liters (6.3 million gallons) of water.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 夏季的大部分时间里，萨默塞特郡霍尔尼科特庄园周围的大部分乡村都处于干燥和尘土飞扬的状态。但有一个角落仍然显眼地呈绿色。 在英格兰西南部，一种16世纪在英国因狩猎而灭绝的动物正在卷土重来。六年前，海狸才重新引入，帮助将庄园里的一条小河道变成了潮湿的草地——干旱景观中真正的绿洲。 这是一个值得在 Instagram 上发布的例子，说明了为什么将海狸重新引入英国更多地区可以帮助我们为下一次干旱做好准备。它展示了它们如何重塑河流和周围的土地，以更长时间地保留景观中的水，而不是让它迅速流失。 海狸通常被称为生态系统工程师。他们砍伐小树，修建水坝，挖掘渠道。水在水坝后面回流，溢出谷底并渗入周围的土壤。沉积物和木质残骸不断积累，而湿地植物则自行生长。 其结果可能是池塘、渠道、沼泽和潮湿林地的镶嵌。在干燥天气期间，这些储存的水可以使土壤和植被保持更长时间的湿润。 2008 年加拿大的一项研究强调了这种效应，该研究检查了艾伯塔省麋鹿岛国家公园 54 年来的航空照片。海狸在 19 世纪从这片土地上消失，但在 1954 年又重新出现。 研究发现，海狸居住和抚养幼崽的活跃海狸小屋的数量可以解释开放水域面积变化的 80% 以上。 2002年是研究中最干旱的一年，有海狸的湿地所含的开放水域是没有海狸的湿地的九倍。 这并不意味着在英国释放海狸会复制加拿大的海狸数量。它是不同景观中的不同海狸物种，任何海狸群体的影响都取决于其流域的形状、土壤和土地利用。但英国的研究也指向同样的方向。 2011 年，研究人员在德文郡集约化管理的草原上研究海狸围栏时发现，13 个水坝额外储存了约 100 万升（264,000 加仑）的水。海狸建造的水坝拦住了溪流，形成了一系列池塘。由于这些水坝存在渗漏，这些水会逐渐释放，减缓暴风雨的流速，同时在干旱时期保持下游的水流。 最近对德文郡四个野生海狸栖息地的研究估计，它们的湿地拥有超过 2400 万升（630 万加仑）的水。 与超过 100,000 名订阅者一起探索科学、技术和太空领域的最新动态……

reflection.en: The reintroduction of beavers to the Holnicote estate has transformed a dry landscape into a vibrant wet meadow. This ecological restoration, driven by the industrious work of these animals, serves as a powerful reminder that creation itself, when allowed to function as intended, can bring forth life and resilience. It echoes the Genesis account where...
reflection.zh: 河狸被重新引入霍尔尼科特庄园，将一片干旱的土地变成了一个生机勃勃的湿草地。这种由这些动物辛勤工作驱动的生态恢复，有力地提醒我们，当造物被允许按其本意运作时，它本身就能带来生命和韧性。这呼应了创世记中雅伟宣告一切受造物“甚好”的记载。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Changing the antibiotic playbook to catch an ESKAPE artist
title.zh: 改变抗生素的策略以应对ESKAPE的“艺术家”

summary.en: Nearly a century ago, a single colony of Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) helped launch the antibiotic age. In 1928, Alexander Fleming returned to his London lab to find that a stray mold had wiped out the Staphylococcus growing on one of his plates. The accident gave the world penicillin, ushering in the age of...
summary.zh: 近一个世纪前，一株金黄色葡萄球菌（S....

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Nearly a century ago, a single colony of Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) helped launch the antibiotic age. In 1928, Alexander Fleming returned to his London lab to find that a stray mold had wiped out the Staphylococcus growing on one of his plates. The accident gave the world penicillin, ushering in the age of biomedicine and ensuring that an infected cut or scrape would not be fatal.

S. aureus was among the first bacteria that penicillin humbled. It is ironic that the same organism now sits on the World Health Organization's roster of most-feared superbugs.

Methicillin-resistant S. aureus, or MRSA, represents the "S" in ESKAPE, a group of six pathogens notorious for their ability to escape or evade multiple antibiotics. The bacterium is notorious for causing skin, bloodstream and surgical-implant infections.

Public health officials routinely warn of a "silent pandemic" of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), in which routine medical procedures could once again become life-threatening because of untreatable infections.

According to the 2024 Global Research on Antimicrobial Resistance (GRAM) study published in The Lancet , drug-resistant infections could directly kill more than 39 million people between 2025 and 2050, with resistant Staphylococcus infections directly linked to about 130,000 deaths. South Asia, including India, is expected to bear the heaviest burden, with an estimated 11.8 million deaths.

It is against this backdrop that a collaborative study involving the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IITGN) has designed a laboratory-made molecule that kills S. aureus by disabling an enzyme most antibiotics ignore. The study was published in Chemistry & Biodiversity .

"Most antibiotics attack bacteria through a handful of familiar routes, including puncturing their walls and jamming their protein-making machinery. The trouble is that bacteria have spent decades learning to dodge those blows," explains Professor Bhaskar Datta, corresponding author of the study and affiliated with IITGN's Departments of Chemistry and Biological Sciences and Engineering.

"Antibiotic resistance is, in many ways, an evolutionary arms race. That is why researchers hunt for fresh points of attack."

IITGN researchers, working with colleagues at Jamia Millia Islamia, Jamia Hamdard, Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University and the Ahmedabad-based company Sushen Medicamentos, decided to try a new approach to tackling the AMR problem. To survive and multiply, every bacterial cell must replicate its genome.

This process relies on a continuous supply of molecular building blocks,...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 近一个世纪前，金黄色葡萄球菌（S. aureus）的单个菌落帮助开启了抗生素时代。 1928 年，亚历山大·弗莱明 (Alexander Fleming) 回到他的伦敦实验室，发现一种流浪霉菌消灭了他的一个培养皿上生长的葡萄球菌。这次事故为世界带来了青霉素，开启了生物医学时代，并确保受感染的割伤或擦伤不会致命。 金黄色葡萄球菌是青霉素最先消灭的细菌之一。具有讽刺意味的是，同样的生物体现在却出现在世界卫生组织最令人恐惧的超级细菌名册上。 耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）代表 ESKAPE 中的“S”，ESKAPE 是一组六种病原体，因其能够逃避或逃避多种抗生素而臭名昭著。这种细菌因引起皮肤、血液和手术植入物感染而臭名昭著。 公共卫生官员经常警告抗菌素耐药性（AMR）的“无声流行”，其中常规医疗程序可能会因无法治疗的感染而再次危及生命。 根据《柳叶刀》发表的 2024 年全球抗菌素耐药性研究 (GRAM)，耐药性感染可能在 2025 年至 2050 年间直接导致超过 3900 万人死亡，其中耐药性葡萄球菌感染与约 13 万人死亡直接相关。包括印度在内的南亚预计将承受最重的负担，估计有 1180 万人死亡。 正是在这种背景下，印度甘地讷格尔理工学院 (IITGN) 参与的一项合作研究设计了一种实验室制造的分子，该分子可以通过禁用大多数抗生素忽视的一种酶来杀死金黄色葡萄球菌。该研究发表在《化学与生物多样性》上。 “大多数抗生素通过一些熟悉的途径攻击细菌，包括刺穿细菌的细胞壁和干扰细菌的蛋白质制造机器。问题是细菌花了几十年的时间学会躲避这些攻击，”该研究的通讯作者、IITGN 化学与生物科学与工程系的巴斯卡·达塔教授解释道。 “从很多方面来说，抗生素耐药性都是一场进化军备竞赛。这就是研究人员寻找新攻击点的原因。” IITGN 的研究人员与 Jamia Millia Islamia、Jamia Hamdard、西交利物浦大学和艾哈迈达巴德公司 Sushen Medicamentos 的同事合作，决定尝试一种新方法来解决抗菌素耐药性问题。为了生存和繁殖，每个细菌细胞都必须复制其基因组。 这个过程依赖于分子构建块的持续供应，...

As Daniel prophesied, in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' May we approach new...

title.en: Early Earth's auroral belts may have formed a natural ion-beam reactor for prebiotic chemistry
title.zh: 早期地球的极光带可能形成了生命前化学的天然离子束反应堆

summary.en: A new study suggests that the auroral belts on early Earth, formed by the interaction of the sun, Earth's magnetic field, and atmosphere, could have acted as a natural reactor for prebiotic chemistry, potentially playing a role in the origin of life.
summary.zh: 一项新研究表明，早期地球上的极光带，由太阳、地球磁场和大气相互作用形成，可能充当了生命前化学的天然反应堆，并在生命的起源中发挥了作用。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

We usually think of auroras as beautiful lights in the night sky. I see them as visible traces of a connection between the sun, Earth's magnetic field and the atmosphere. This led me to an origin-of-life question: Could the planetary structure that produces auroras also have organized chemical reactions on early Earth?

Origin-of-life studies have examined ultraviolet radiation, lightning, impacts, hydrothermal activity and energetic particles as sources of energy for prebiotic chemistry. My study, published in the journal BioSystems , asks a complementary question: Where might that energy have been repeatedly concentrated?

My research often begins with relationships rather than isolated objects. The sun sends energy and charged particles toward Earth; Earth's magnetic field guides some of them into high-latitude regions, where they interact with the atmosphere. Reaction products may then descend into polar surface environments.

Solar activity, magnetospheric physics, atmospheric chemistry, polar ice and prebiotic chemistry are usually studied separately. Considered as one environmental structure, however, the auroral belts emerge as possible reaction environments rather than merely places where colored light appears.

Paleomagnetic evidence indicates that Earth had a functioning geodynamo more than 3.4 billion years ago, while the young sun was more active than today. Ancient auroras need not have resembled modern ones, but these conditions make it reasonable to ask how the early magnetic field organized the entry of energetic particles.

Energetic electrons and ions follow magnetic-field structures and preferentially enter the atmosphere at high latitudes. Collisions with nitrogen, carbon dioxide, water vapor and minor reduced gases can produce ions, radicals, excited molecules and secondary electrons.

Previous irradiation experiments have shown that energetic particles can form amino acids, carboxylic acids and hydrolyzable organic precursors under plausible prebiotic conditions.

Particle-driven prebiotic chemistry is not itself my new proposal. In this sense, Earth's auroral belts may collectively have formed a Natural Ion-Beam Reactor: a planetary-scale reaction system in which magnetically guided energetic particles—including electrons, protons and other ions—energized localized atmospheric reaction zones.

The new element is spatial organization: Earth's magnetic field may have repeatedly concentrated particle-driven chemistry within geographically restricted auroral belts, sustaining localized chemical disequilibrium.

body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 我们通常认为极光是夜空中美丽的灯光。我将它们视为太阳、地球磁场和大气之间联系的可见痕迹。这让我想到了一个生命起源的问题：产生极光的行星结构是否也能在早期地球上发生有组织的化学反应？ 生命起源研究考察了紫外线辐射、闪电、撞击、热液活动和高能粒子作为生命起源前化学的能源。我的研究发表在《生物系统》杂志上，提出了一个补充问题：这些能量可能反复集中在哪里？ 我的研究通常从关系开始，而不是从孤立的对象开始。太阳向地球发送能量和带电粒子；地球磁场引导其中一些进入高纬度地区，在那里与大气相互作用。然后反应产物可能会下降到极地表面环境中。 太阳活动、磁层物理、大气化学、极地冰和生命起源化学通常是分开研究的。然而，被视为一种环境结构，极光带作为可能的反应环境而不仅仅是出现彩色光的地方。 古地磁证据表明，地球在 34 亿多年前就有了运转的地球发电机，而年轻的太阳比今天更加活跃。古代极光不一定与现代极光相似，但这些条件使人们有理由询问早期磁场如何组织高能粒子的进入。 高能电子和离子遵循磁场结构并优先进入高纬度地区的大气层。与氮气、二氧化碳、水蒸气和少量还原气体的碰撞可以产生离子、自由基、激发分子和二次电子。 先前的辐照实验表明，高能粒子可以在合理的益生元条件下形成氨基酸、羧酸和可水解的有机前体。 粒子驱动的益生元化学本身并不是我的新提议。从这个意义上说，地球的极光带可能共同形成了一个天然离子束反应堆：一个行星规模的反应系统，其中磁引导的高能粒子（包括电子、质子和其他离子）为局部大气反应区提供能量。 新的元素是空间组织：地球磁场可能反复将粒子驱动的化学物质集中在地理有限的极光带内，维持局部化学不平衡。 这并不意味着完整...

It reminds us that Yahweh's creation, from the grandest cosmic interactions to the smallest chemical reactions, is filled with intricate wisdom and purpose, waiting to be discovered. As Job 12:7-9 says, 'But ask the...

title.en: Crime is falling—but the public doesn't feel safer, UK study finds
title.zh: 犯罪率下降——但公众并不觉得更安全，英国研究发现

summary.en: Crime levels are falling for most offenses across the UK—but the public doesn't necessarily feel safer. Researchers suggest this is a human trait to focus on frightening information in the news or on social media, which could mean people are more fearful about crime than they need to be.
summary.zh: 在英国，大多数犯罪的发生率正在下降——但公众并不一定觉得更安全。研究人员认为，这是人类倾向于关注新闻或社交媒体上令人恐惧的信息的特质，这可能意味着人们对犯罪的恐惧程度超出了实际需要。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Crime levels are falling for most offenses across the UK—but the public doesn't necessarily feel safer. It's a human trait to focus on frightening information in the news or on social media—but it could also mean that people are more fearful about crime than they need to be.

Reform UK's leader Nigel Farage claimed last month that "everyone knows" law and order in the UK is in a worse place than it was five or ten years ago. Farage was launching a new Reform policy document called Keeping Criminals Behind Bars.

More than eight in ten of the British public really do believe that crime has gone up in the past few years. But as a study I was recently involved in shows, this sense of increasing lawlessness is based on very faulty perceptions of trends in actual crime rates.

Eight in ten of the UK public think mobile phone thefts have increased since 2010 and around six in ten believe both vehicle-related thefts and burglary have increased. In fact, all are down by 50% or more over that time period.

These figures are based on the Crime Survey for England and Wales , which Farage has criticized as no longer fit for purpose. There are real challenges in accurately tracking crime over time, but the Office for Statistics Regulation recently backed the study as a robust source of data on crime trends.

In any case, it is clear from our study that overly negative views of crime cannot be fully explained by one source being faulty. The murder rate, measured by police crime statistics and difficult to argue with, has come down 20% since 2010 . But our study found that two-thirds of the public think the number of murders has increased or remained the same.

Our sense that things are going downhill extends to many features of criminal justice. Police numbers in England and Wales have increased by 20% since 2018, but only 4% of us get that right. Two-thirds think numbers have fallen.

We're particularly wrong when our concerns about different areas of life connect, for example, when crime is linked to immigration. On average, we guess that 30% of those cautioned or convicted of sexual offenses are foreign nationals, when the actual figure is 15%. Reform UK supporters guess it's 50%.

This starts to point to some of the reasons why we are so wrong about so much when it comes to crime. Our perceptions of reality are more tied to emotional reactions and identity than a careful study of the statistics. We are partly sending signals about what's worrying us.

When explaining misperceptions, the key reasons break down into two interlinked groups: how we think and what we're told.

The...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 英国各地大多数犯罪行为的犯罪率正在下降，但公众并不一定感到更安全。关注新闻或社交媒体中的可怕信息是人类的特征，但这也可能意味着人们对犯罪的恐惧超出了他们的需要。 英国改革党领导人奈杰尔·法拉奇上个月声称，“每个人都知道”英国的法律和秩序比五年前或十年前更糟糕。法拉奇正在推出一项新的改革政策文件，名为“将罪犯关进监狱”。 超过十分之八的英国公众确实相信过去几年犯罪率有所上升。但我最近参与的一项研究表明，这种无法无天的感觉是基于对实际犯罪率趋势的非常错误的认识。 十分之八的英国公众认为自 2010 年以来手机盗窃案有所增加，大约十分之六的人认为与车辆相关的盗窃和入室盗窃都有所增加。事实上，所有这些都在这段时间内下降了 50% 或更多。 这些数字基于英格兰和威尔士的犯罪调查，法拉奇批评该调查不再适合目的。随着时间的推移，准确追踪犯罪确实存在挑战，但统计监管办公室最近支持这项研究，将其视为犯罪趋势的可靠数据来源。 无论如何，从我们的研究中可以清楚地看出，对犯罪的过度负面看法不能用一个错误的来源来完全解释。自 2010 年以来，根据警方犯罪统计数据衡量的谋杀率已下降了 20%，这是无可辩驳的。但我们的研究发现，三分之二的公众认为谋杀案数量有所增加或保持不变。 我们对事情正在走下坡路的感觉延伸到了刑事司法的许多方面。自 2018 年以来，英格兰和威尔士的警察人数增加了 20%，但只有 4% 的人做到了这一点。三分之二的人认为数字已经下降。 当我们对生活不同领域的担忧相互联系时，例如，当犯罪与移民相关时，我们尤其错误。平均而言，我们猜测因性犯罪而受到警告或定罪的人中，有 30% 是外国人，而实际数字为 15%。英国改革派的支持者猜测是 50%。 这开始说明我们在犯罪问题上的错误认识如此之多的一些原因。我们对现实的感知更多地与情绪反应和身份相关，而不是对统计数据的仔细研究。我们正在部分地发出有关我们担心的事情的信号。 在解释误解时，关键原因分为两个相互关联的组：我们如何思考和我们被告知的内容。 这...

reflection.en: Even as crime statistics show improvement in the UK, a study reveals that public perception lags behind. This tendency to fixate on alarming news, rather than objective data, can amplify fear. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to intentionally direct our thoughts toward what is good and true, counteracting the pervasive negativity that can distort our sense of...
reflection.zh: 尽管犯罪统计数据显示英国有所改善，但一项研究表明公众的看法滞后于实际情况。这种倾向于专注于令人担忧的新闻，而不是客观数据，会加剧恐惧。腓立比书 4:8 提醒我们要有意识地将思想引向良善和真实的事物，以对抗可能扭曲我们安全感和幸福感的普遍负面情绪。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.

title.en: China’s fast-track clinical trials are in the spotlight after child deaths

summary.en: A new government policy aims to strike a balance between fostering innovation and ensuring safety in clinical trials, following reports of child deaths linked to expedited processes.

The tragic deaths of children in fast-track trials underscore the urgent need for robust safety protocols and ethical oversight. We are called to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring that progress serves humanity without...

title.en: Two children died from gene therapies in China: where the field goes next
title.zh: 中国基因疗法致两名儿童死亡：该领域何去何从

summary.en: Two children have died from gene therapies in China, raising concerns about the safety and disclosure practices within the field. This incident puts China's reputation for gene therapy research at risk and underscores the need for strengthened laws to ensure prompt public disclosure of such outcomes.
summary.zh: 中国基因疗法已导致两名儿童死亡，引发了对该领域安全性和披露实践的担忧。这一事件使中国在基因疗法研究方面的声誉面临风险，并强调了加强法律以确保此类后果得到及时公开披露的必要性。

reflection.en: The development of gene therapies holds immense promise for healing, yet the tragic deaths of two children in China serve as a somber reminder of the delicate balance between innovation and safety. We are each 'fearfully and wonderfully made,' a testament to the intricate design of life that calls for both bold exploration and profound reverence.
reflection.zh: 基因疗法的发展为治愈疾病带来了巨大希望，但中国两名儿童的悲惨死亡事件，却警示我们创新与安全之间微妙的平衡。我们每个人都是‘奇妙可畏地被造’的，这证明了生命的精妙设计，既需要大胆探索，也需要深深的敬畏。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: How Indigenous Protected Areas became a vital way to protect nature in Australia
title.zh: 原住民保护区如何成为澳大利亚保护自然的重要途径

summary.en: Indigenous Protected Areas (IPAs) are a growing conservation method in Australia, where Traditional Owners voluntarily dedicate land and sea Country to protect its natural and cultural values. These IPAs become part of Australia's National Reserve System, with Indigenous rangers actively managing these areas by...
summary.zh: 原住民保护区（IPA）是澳大利亚一种日益增长的保护方法，传统所有者自愿奉献土地和海洋区域以保护其自然和文化价值。这些IPA成为澳大利亚国家保护区系统的一部分，原住民护林员通过清除入侵物种和开展文化实践来积极管理这些区域。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When you think of conservation in Australia, chances are you'll think of a national park.

But there's another fast-growing way of conserving land: Indigenous Protected Areas (IPAs). These areas of land or sea Country are voluntarily dedicated by Traditional Owners to protect nature and cultural values and responsibilities.

Once dedicated, an IPA becomes part of Australia's National Reserve System —our network of protected areas. To protect the area, Indigenous rangers tackle invasive species and undertake cultural burning and many other tasks.

In 2022, the Australian government signed up to an international pledge to protect 30% of lands and waters by 2030. This is one reason why IPAs have grown so rapidly in recent years.

In July, 4.7 million hectares (11.6 million acres) of the Simpson Desert was dedicated as the newest protected area—the Pmere Atherre Antenterreme IPA.

Maintaining the success of Indigenous Protected Areas will require long-term funding, strong Indigenous governance and complementary conservation elsewhere.

While national parks are established and managed by governments, IPAs are Indigenous-led.

After deciding to establish an IPA, Traditional Owners develop a management plan and determine how Country is to be cared for, drawing on Indigenous knowledge and contemporary conservation science.

Caring for Country means looking after plants, animals, water, fire, sacred places and cultural practices as part of an interconnected whole .

Declaring an IPA doesn't change existing tenure arrangements. For example, an IPA can cover freehold Indigenous land, land granted under land-rights legislation, Indigenous-held leasehold or pastoral land, Crown land and marine areas.

In 1998, Nantawarrina became Australia's first Indigenous Protected Area. The former pastoral station in South Australia's Flinders Ranges was heavily degraded. Over the following decades, the Nipapanha people worked to restore the land and its biodiversity.

There are now 96 IPAs across Australia, spanning 113 million hectares (279 million acres). That's almost 15% of the continent. Marine IPAs cover a smaller portion of Australian waters—9.3 million hectares (23 million acres), or about 1.1% of our marine estate.

The growth of IPAs has far outstripped the growth of other types of conservation land. IPAs now make up more than 55% of lands protected in Australia's National Reserve System.

Across all types of protection—both government and non-government— 25% of Australia's land is now protected, and 24% of seas are highly protected "no-take" areas where fishing is banned.

The largest...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当您想到澳大利亚的环境保护时，您很可能会想到国家公园。 但还有另一种快速发展的土地保护方式：土著保护区 (IPA)。这些陆地或海洋区域由传统所有者自愿奉献，以保护自然和文化价值和责任。 一旦投入使用，IPA 就成为澳大利亚国家保护区系统（我们的保护区网络）的一部分。为了保护该地区，原住民护林员应对入侵物种并承担文化焚烧和许多其他任务。 2022 年，澳大利亚政府签署了一项国际承诺，到 2030 年保护 30% 的土地和水域。这也是近年来 IPA 增长如此迅速的原因之一。 7 月，辛普森沙漠 470 万公顷（1160 万英亩）的土地被指定为最新的保护区——Pmere Atherre Antenterreme IPA。 保持土著保护区的成功需要长期资金、强有力的土著治理和其他地方的补充性保护。 国家公园是由政府建立和管理的，而 IPA 则是由原住民主导的。 在决定建立 IPA 后，传统所有者会利用土著知识和当代保护科学制定管理计划并确定如何照顾国家。 关爱国家意味着将植物、动物、水、火、圣地和文化习俗视为一个相互关联的整体的一部分。 宣布 IPA 不会改变现有的权属安排。例如，IPA 可以涵盖永久业权原住民土地、根据土地权利立法授予的土地、原住民拥有的租赁土地或牧区土地、公有土地和海洋区域。 1998 年，南塔瓦里纳成为澳大利亚第一个土著保护区。南澳大利亚弗林德斯山脉的前牧区已严重退化。在接下来的几十年里，尼帕帕尼亚人致力于恢复土地及其生物多样性。 澳大利亚目前有 96 个 IPA，占地 1.13 亿公顷（2.79 亿英亩）。这几乎是非洲大陆的 15%。海洋 IPA 覆盖了澳大利亚水域的一小部分——930 万公顷（2,300 万英亩），约占我们海洋面积的 1.1%。 IPA 的增长远远超过了其他类型保护土地的增长。目前，IPA 占澳大利亚国家保护区系统保护土地的 55% 以上。 在所有类型的保护中（包括政府和非政府），澳大利亚 25% 的土地现已受到保护，24% 的海洋是受到高度保护的“禁渔”区域，禁止捕鱼。 最大...

reflection.en: The dedication of Indigenous Protected Areas in Australia is a powerful testament to a worldview where land is not merely owned but stewarded. It echoes the ancient truth that all creation, including these sacred lands, ultimately belongs to the Creator. This approach honors both the natural world and the deep cultural responsibilities of its caretakers.
reflection.zh: 澳大利亚原住民保护区的设立，有力地证明了一种世界观，即土地不仅仅是被拥有，更是被守护的。这呼应了一个古老的真理：所有被造之物，包括这些神圣的土地，最终都属于造物主。这种方法既尊重了自然界，也尊重了其守护者深厚的文化责任。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Gaps in evidence on vaccinating badgers against TB, researchers say
title.zh: 研究人员称疫苗接种獾类以对抗牛结核病证据存在不足

summary.en: Researchers are calling for more monitoring of how badger vaccinations affect bovine tuberculosis and for a review of the existing evidence, stating there are significant gaps in knowledge that reduce the method's effectiveness.
summary.zh: 研究人员呼吁加强对獾类疫苗接种影响牛结核病的监测，并审查现有证据，指出知识和证据存在重大差距，降低了该方法的有效性。

body.en:
There are "significant gaps" in knowledge and evidence about the effect of vaccinating badgers in Wales against bovine tuberculosis (TB), according to researchers.

A team from the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, along with staff from Cardiff and Aberystwyth universities, argue the gaps reduce the effectiveness of this method of trying to deal with the disease.

Vaccination is part of a programme to eradicate bovine TB in Wales, but it is a controversial topic.

The Welsh government said it was "renewing" its approach to eradicating bovine TB.

There have been calls for alternative methods to vaccination for controlling the infection among cattle, such as badger culling, as they can carry the disease and transmit it to cattle.

Cattle are regularly tested for the presence of the infection and are slaughtered if they are found to be carriers.

They are calling for increased monitoring of the vaccination's impact, a review of the evidence, and collaboration with farmers "to ensure the greatest possible impact" from the programmes.

In their policy briefing, they say "major questions remain about how many badgers are being vaccinated, what impact vaccinating badgers is having on disease levels in cattle, and how confidence in vaccination can be improved among farmers and veterinary professionals".

Dr Niall McKeown, a lecturer in the department of life sciences at Aberystwyth University and vice-chair of the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, said the infection "remains one of the biggest animal health challenges facing Wales".

"Badger vaccination should not be presented as a stand-alone route to eradicating bovine tuberculosis," said McKeown.

"There is strong evidence that BCG vaccination protects badgers, but evidence that operational vaccination programmes reduce disease in cattle remains limited.

"Any cattle-level benefit is likely to depend on sustained and sufficiently extensive vaccination coverage alongside effective cattle controls."

He emphasised it was not simply more vaccination that was needed "but vaccination that is better targeted, measured and evaluated".

"By combining non-invasive genetic monitoring with sett surveys, camera traps and movement data, we can estimate local badger numbers, check the proportion of the population reached and identify significant gaps," he added.

A spokesperson for the Welsh government said: "We are renewing our approach to eradicating bovine TB in Wales, focusing on three main elements: cattle, people, and wildlife.

"This work will be evidence-based and science-led, taking into account advice from the programme board and the technical advisory group, while ensuring that value for money remains a core consideration in decision-making."

body.zh: 研究人员表示，关于威尔士獾疫苗接种对牛结核病（TB）效果的了解和证据存在“重大差距”。 英国生态学会威尔士政策小组的一个团队以及卡迪夫大学和阿伯里斯特威斯大学的工作人员认为，这些差距降低了这种应对这种疾病的方法的有效性。 疫苗接种是威尔士根除牛结核病计划的一部分，但这是一个有争议的话题。 威尔士政府表示正在“更新”根除牛结核病的方法。 有人呼吁采用疫苗接种以外的替代方法来控制牛群感染，例如扑杀獾，因为它们可以携带疾病并将其传播给牛群。 定期对牛进行检测以确定是否存在感染，如果发现是携带者，则将其宰杀。 他们呼吁加强对疫苗接种影响的监测、对证据的审查以及与农民的合作，“以确保该计划产生最大可能的影响”。 他们在政策简报中表示，“主要问题仍然是有多少獾正在接种疫苗，獾接种疫苗对牛的疾病水平有何影响，以及如何提高农民和兽医专业人员对疫苗接种的信心”。 阿伯里斯特威斯大学生命科学系讲师、英国生态学会威尔士政策小组副主席尼尔·麦基翁博士表示，这种感染“仍然是威尔士面临的最大动物健康挑战之一”。 “獾疫苗接种不应作为根除牛结核病的独立途径，”麦基翁说。 “有强有力的证据表明卡介苗疫苗接种可以保护獾，但有效的疫苗接种计划减少牛疾病的证据仍然有限。 “任何牛水平的效益都可能取决于持续且足够广泛的疫苗接种覆盖率以及有效的牛控制。” 他强调，需要的不仅仅是更多的疫苗接种，“而是更有针对性、更好地衡量和评估的疫苗接种”。 “通过将非侵入性基因监测与设置调查、相机陷阱和运动数据相结合，我们可以估计当地獾的数量，检查达到的种群比例并确定显着的差距，”他补充道。 威尔士政府发言人表示：“我们正在更新根除威尔士牛结核病的方法，重点关注三个主要因素：牛、人和野生动物。 “这项工作将以证据为基础，以科学为主导，同时考虑项目委员会和技术咨询小组的建议，同时确保物有所值仍然是决策的核心考虑因素。” 上个月，Llyr Gruffydd...

reflection.en: In Wales, researchers are highlighting significant gaps in the evidence supporting badger vaccination as a strategy against bovine TB. They urge for more monitoring and a review, suggesting that current knowledge may not fully support the policy. This situation underscores the importance of thorough investigation and wise counsel when implementing public...
reflection.zh: 在威尔士，研究人员指出，支持通过疫苗接种獾类来对抗牛结核病的证据存在重大不足。他们敦促加强监测和审查，认为目前的知识可能并不完全支持该政策。这种情况凸显了在实施公共卫生措施时，进行彻底调查和寻求明智建议的重要性，以确保决策有坚实的数据支持。
