title.en: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
title.zh: 诈骗者以虚假版权声明向Instagram用户勒索赎金

summary.en: Instagram creators are losing money or facing account suspension due to fake copyright claims filed by scammers. Meta's systems are struggling to identify these bad actors, leading to users paying ransoms to recover their accounts, as the appeal process is too slow.
summary.zh: Instagram创作者因诈骗者提出的虚假版权声明而损失金钱或面临账户暂停。Meta的系统难以识别这些不良行为者，导致用户支付赎金以恢复账户，因为申诉过程过于缓慢。

body.en:
Instagram creators say they have lost thousands of pounds after their accounts were suspended or taken down due to fake copyright claims.

Extorters have filed bogus claims to the Meta-owned social media platform, then asked for ransoms to withdraw them - knowing repeated claims can lead to account bans.

One Instagram user, who has 1.5 million followers, told the BBC he paid a scammer $50 (£37) to get his account back, claiming Meta's appeal process would take weeks, which had previously cost him thousands in lost income.

"We understand this can be frustrating for those impacted, and our systems are designed to protect people from this happening in the first place," a Meta spokesperson said.

"Following our review, we have restored the affected content and added additional protections to safeguard accounts against further attempts of this kind."

However, content creators the BBC has spoken to say Meta is poor at identifying obviously spurious cases, and say its appeals process is slow to respond unless you pay a monthly fee.

The Lost in Time History Instagram account posts historical pictures to its more than 1.5 million followers.

Its creator Olly, who did not share his last name, told the BBC he posts pictures in the public domain or where he has permission from the rights holder.

Yet he has received dozens of "obviously fake" copyright complaints so far in 2026.

Meta does not check the authenticity of complaints when they are made, so if someone is hit repeatedly, their account can be temporarily taken down.

Olly says he often gets struck for multiple posts at a time, all from the same email address.

He then gets contacted by the person asking to go on to the private messaging app Telegram.

"They'll demand a certain amount of money," he said - usually amounting to a few hundred dollars - to withdraw the claim.

The BBC has seen messages from the claimants where they demand money or threaten future copyright strikes.

This article contains content provided by Instagram. We ask for your permission before anything is loaded, as they may be using cookies and other technologies. You may want to read Meta’s Instagram cookie policy , external and privacy policy , external before accepting. To view this content choose ‘accept and continue’ .

Olly ultimately agreed to pay an extorter $50 in cryptocurrency to restore his account, which had been temporarily taken down by Instagram.

Law enforcement organisations tell extortion victims not to pay ransoms as it fuels the criminal ecosystem.

Olly said he paid as a "last resort" because it was quicker than going through Meta, which could take weeks.

"Having to pay the person who's actively put you through all of that anguish only for it to happen straight away again."

As a result of the number of...
body.zh: Instagram 创作者表示，由于虚假版权声明，他们的账户被暂停或删除，他们损失了数千英镑。 勒索者向 Meta 拥有的社交媒体平台提出虚假索赔，然后要求赎金才能撤回这些索赔 - 他们知道重复索赔可能会导致帐户被禁止。 一位拥有 150 万粉丝的 Instagram 用户告诉 BBC，他向骗子支付了 50 美元（37 英镑）才能取回自己的账户，并声称 Meta 的上诉过程需要数周时间，这此前让他损失了数千美元的收入。 Meta 发言人表示：“我们知道这可能会让受影响的人感到沮丧，我们的系统旨在从一开始就保护人们免受这种情况的影响。” “经过审查，我们已经恢复了受影响的内容，并增加了额外的保护措施，以保护帐户免受此类进一步尝试。” 然而，BBC 采访的内容创作者表示，Meta 不擅长识别明显虚假的案例，并表示其上诉流程反应缓慢，除非您每月支付费用。 “迷失在时间历史”Instagram 帐户向其超过 150 万粉丝发布历史图片。 其创作者奥利（Olly）没有透露自己的姓氏，他告诉英国广播公司（BBC），他在公共领域或获得权利持有者许可的地方发布了照片。 然而，2026 年到目前为止，他已经收到了数十起“明显虚假”的版权投诉。 Meta在提出投诉时不会检查其真实性，因此如果有人多次受到打击，他们的帐户可能会被暂时删除。 奥利说，他经常因为同时发多个帖子而受到打击，而且所有帖子都来自同一个电子邮件地址。 然后有人联系他，要求继续使用私人消息应用程序 Telegram。 “他们会要求一定数额的钱，”他说——通常是几百美元——才能撤回索赔。 英国广播公司 (BBC) 收到了来自原告的信息，他们索要金钱或威胁未来进行版权罢工。 本文包含 Instagram 提供的内容。在加载任何内容之前，我们会征求您的许可，因为它们可能会使用 cookie 和其他技术。在接受之前，您可能需要阅读 Meta 的 Instagram cookie 政策、外部和隐私政策、外部。要查看此内容，请选择“接受并继续”。 Olly 最终同意向勒索者支付 50 美元的加密货币，以恢复他的帐户，该帐户已被 Instagram 暂时关闭。 执法组织告诉勒索受害者不要支付赎金，因为这会助长犯罪生态系统。 奥利说，他付费是“最后的手段”，因为它比通过 Meta 更快，后者可能需要数周时间。 “必须付钱给那些主动让你经历所有这些痛苦的人，结果这种事马上就会再次发生。” 由于数量...

reflection.en: This news highlights how individuals can exploit systems and trust for personal gain, causing harm to others. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that stand in stark contrast to the scammers' deceitful actions.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了个人如何利用系统和信任来谋取私利，从而伤害他人。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于行公义、好怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这些原则与诈骗者的欺骗行为形成了鲜明对比。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: ‘Mistrust’ of Palantir may affect NHS research, says health minister
title.zh: “不信任”可能影响NHS研究，卫生部长表示

summary.en: Patients may be less willing to share data as new figures show a rise in opt-outs, according to James Frith, the health innovation minister. He expressed concern about "mistrust" of the US defence and health tech company Palantir and its potential impact on data sharing with the NHS.
summary.zh: 卫生创新部长詹姆斯·弗里斯表示，随着新数据显示退出者人数的增加，患者可能不太愿意分享数据。他对美国国防和健康科技公司Palantir的“不信任”及其对NHS数据共享的潜在影响表示担忧。

body.en: James Frith says patients may be less willing to share data as new figures show a rise in opt-outs Concern is being raised about Palantir’s work with the NHS as new figures showed tens of thousands of patients have withdrawn their data from use in research projects. James Frith, the health innovation minister, said he was worried about “mistrust” of the US defence and health tech company and “the impact it could have on people’s willingness to share data with the NHS”. Continue reading...
body.zh: James Frith 表示，随着新数据显示选择退出的人数增加，患者可能不太愿意分享数据新数据显示数万名患者已撤回其数据，不再用于研究项目，人们对 Palantir 与 NHS 的合作表示担忧。卫生创新部长詹姆斯·弗里斯 (James Frith) 表示，他担心对美国国防和健康科技公司的“不信任”，以及“这可能会对人们与 NHS 共享数据的意愿产生影响”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The health minister's worry about patient mistrust highlights a tension between technological advancement and human dignity. When people feel their data might be misused or that their privacy is not respected, their willingness to participate in vital research diminishes. This situation calls for leaders to act justly and with compassion, ensuring...
reflection.zh: 卫生部长的担忧，即患者对Palantir公司数据处理的不信任，凸显了技术进步与人类尊严之间的紧张关系。当人们觉得自己的数据可能被滥用，或者自己的隐私未得到尊重时，他们参与重要研究的意愿就会减弱。这种情况呼吁领导者以公正和怜悯之心行事，确保透明度并建立信任，而不是滋生怀疑。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
title.zh: Grindr将支付2600万英镑以解决其涉嫌共享用户艾滋病毒状况的指控

summary.en: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties. Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third parties. The class action suit, which began in 2024, involved over 11,000...
summary.zh: 一项长期存在的诉讼指控Grindr违反英国隐私法，与第三方共享数据。Grindr已同意支付2600万英镑以了结一项诉讼，该诉讼指控其与第三方共享用户个人信息，包括其艾滋病毒状况。该集体诉讼于2024年提起，涉及超过11,000名原告。

body.en:
Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information - including their HIV status - with third parties.

The world's largest LGBTQ+ dating app was sued in the High Court in 2024 over claims it misused people's personal information.

The class action suit was later served in the US, with the law firm leading the case saying it had signed up more than 11,000 claimants.

According to a US regulatory filing, Grindr will make two £13m payments to settle the claims. The firm said the settlement includes no admission of liability.

Grindr stressed the claims relate to "historical data practices" before 2020 when it was owned by Chinese firm Kunlun.

The filing submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission , external by Grindr said a settlement had been reached on 2 September.

"While Grindr disputes the allegations, it recognizes and acknowledges the distress and loss of trust expressed by some of its UK users regarding that pre-2020 period," the company said in its filing.

The firm has agreed to pay £13m to the counterparties by 31 December and a further £13m by 31 March 2027.

The claims brought more than two years ago by law firm Austen Hayes alleged Grindr had shared sensitive data with third parties for commercial purposes, breaching UK privacy laws.

It said this included information about the ethnicity and sexual orientation of its users.

People on Grindr have the option to share their HIV status along with when they were last tested - a move it says aims to reduce stigma, facilitate conversations and help users make informed health choices.

Chaya Hanoomanjee, the lawyer who led the claim, said in April 2024 claimants had "experienced significant distress" over their sensitive and private information being shared without their consent.

She said the company "owes it to the LGBTQ+ community it serves to compensate those whose data has been compromised".

Two data analytics services, Apptimize and Localytics, were identified as third parties with access to the sensitive data.

The claim said a potentially unlimited number of third parties used it to customise advertisements to Grindr's users.

It followed revelations in 2018 that Grindr had been sharing personal data, including the HIV status of its users, with the two data analytics providers.

Grindr defended the practice at the time as in line with industry standards – but it said it then stopped sharing HIV data with those companies.

It was fined £5.5m by Norway's data protection watchdog and, later in 2022, reprimanded by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for its data practices.

The company said in its filing on Friday that since 2020, it had "overhauled" its privacy practices to help meet the "unique needs of its...
body.zh: Grindr 已同意支付 2600 万英镑，以了结一项针对其与第三方共享用户个人信息（包括其艾滋病毒状况）的诉讼。 全球最大的 LGBTQ+ 约会应用程序于 2024 年在高等法院被起诉，指控其滥用人们的个人信息。 该集体诉讼后来在美国送达，牵头该案的律​​师事务所表示，已与 11,000 多名索赔人签署了协议。 根据美国监管机构提交的文件，Grindr 将支付两笔 1300 万英镑的款项来和解索赔。该公司表示，和解协议不包括承认责任。 Grindr 强调，这些说法与 2020 年之前的“历史数据实践”有关，当时它属于中国公司昆仑万维。 Grindr 向美国证券交易委员会提交的外部文件称，已于 9 月 2 日达成和解。 该公司在文件中表示：“虽然 Grindr 对这些指控提出异议，但它承认并承认一些英国用户对 2020 年之前的这段时期所表达的痛苦和失去信任。” 该公司已同意在 12 月 31 日之前向交易对手支付 1300 万英镑，并在 2027 年 3 月 31 日之前再支付 1300 万英镑。 两年多前，Austen Hayes 律师事务所提出指控，称 Grindr 出于商业目的与第三方共享敏感数据，违反了英国隐私法。 该公司表示，这包括有关其用户的种族和性取向的信息。 Grindr 上的人们可以选择分享他们的艾滋病毒状况以及最后一次检测的时间——据称此举旨在减少耻辱、促进对话并帮助用户做出明智的健康选择。 主导索赔的律师查亚·哈努曼吉 (Chaya Hanoomanjee) 于 2024 年 4 月表示，索赔人因未经本人同意而分享敏感和私人信息而“经历了巨大的痛苦”。 她表示，该公司“有义务向其所服务的 LGBTQ+ 社区提供补偿，以补偿那些数据遭到泄露的人”。 两个数据分析服务 Apptimize 和 Localytics 被确定为有权访问敏感数据的第三方。 声明称，可能有无限数量的第三方使用它为 Grindr 用户定制广告。 2018 年，有消息称 Grindr 一直与这两家数据分析提供商共享个人数据，包括用户的艾滋病毒状况。 Grindr 当时为这种做法进行了辩护，称其符合行业标准，但它表示随后停止与这些公司共享艾滋病毒数据。 该公司被挪威数据保护监管机构罚款 550 万英镑，并于 2022 年晚些时候因其数据做法受到英国信息专员办公室的谴责。 该公司在周五提交的文件中表示，自 2020 年以来，它“彻底改革”了其隐私做法，以帮助满足“其……的独特需求”。

reflection.en: The news about Grindr settling claims for sharing sensitive user data, including HIV status, highlights a profound breach of trust. It underscores the importance of ethical data handling and accountability, reminding us that true justice requires not only legal settlements but also a commitment to protecting the vulnerable and upholding dignity in all our...
reflection.zh: Grindr因共享包括艾滋病毒状况在内的敏感用户数据而达成和解的消息，凸显了信任的严重破裂。它强调了道德数据处理和问责制的重要性，提醒我们真正的公义不仅需要法律和解，还需要在所有交往中致力于保护弱势群体并维护尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Architect of UK’s AI policy quits after Anthropic conflict of interest concerns
title.zh: 英国人工智能政策的制定者因Anthropic的利益冲突疑虑而辞职

summary.en: Matt Clifford has resigned as chair of the UK's science and technology research unit due to concerns from senior MPs about a conflict of interest arising from his new full-time position at the AI firm Anthropic, which develops the Claude chatbot.
summary.zh: 马特·克利福德因担任人工智能公司Anthropic的全职职位而引发的利益冲突疑虑，已被迫辞去英国科学技术研究部门主席一职，此举受到了高级议员的关注。

body.en: Matt Clifford forced to stand down amid disquiet from senior MPs over his new full-time job at AI company The chair of the UK government’s “moonshot” science and technology research unit has been forced to stand down after taking a job with the San Francisco AI firm Anthropic, in a move senior MPs called a “clear conflict of interest”. Matt Clifford announced last week that he was taking a full-time job working for the company behind the Claude chatbot, “leading its engagement” with governments outside the US – including the UK. But he retained his leadership at the UK’s Advanced Research and Invention Agency (Aria), which funds frontier science and tech projects . Continue reading...
body.zh: 马特·克利福德(Matt Clifford)因在人工智能公司的新全职工作而感到不安，被迫辞职英国政府“登月”科学技术研究部门的主席在接受旧金山人工智能公司Anthropic的工作后被迫辞职，高级议员称此举存在“明显的利益冲突”。马特·克利福德 (Matt Clifford) 上周宣布，他将在克劳德聊天机器人背后的公司找到一份全职工作，“领导该公司与包括英国在内的美国以外政府的接触”。但他保留了在英国高级研究和发明局（Aria）的领导地位，该机构为前沿科学和技术项目提供资金。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Leadership requires integrity, especially when public trust is at stake. Proverbs 16:12 reminds us that righteous rulers govern with justice and honesty, ensuring their actions serve the public good rather than personal or corporate interests. The situation with Matt Clifford underscores the importance of transparency and ethical conduct in public service.
reflection.zh: 领导力需要正直，尤其是在公共信任受到考验的时候。《箴言》16:12 提醒我们，公义的统治者以公正和诚实来治理，确保他们的行为服务于公众利益，而不是个人或公司的利益。马特·克利福德的情况凸显了在公共服务中透明度和道德操守的重要性。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Trump administration attacks UK plans to boost traditional media on social platforms
title.zh: 特朗普政府抨击英国旨在提升传统媒体在社交平台上的计划

summary.en: The US embassy has expressed 'serious concerns' about Downing Street's proposal to give established broadcasters like the BBC and ITV greater online visibility, warning that it risks 'facilitating censorship' and could set a precedent for authoritarian regimes to control online content.
summary.zh: 美国大使馆对唐宁街让BBC和ITV等老牌广播公司获得更大在线可见度的计划表示“严重关切”，并警告此举存在“助长审查制度”的风险，可能为威权政权控制在线内容树立先例。

body.en: US embassy says Downing Street’s plan to give BBC, ITV and other established media more online visibility carries risk of ‘censorship’ The Trump administration has raised “serious concerns” over Downing Street’s plan to force YouTube and other digital platforms to hand more prominence to established broadcasters, warning the move risks “facilitating censorship”. In a pointed intervention, the US government said the proposals to boost traditional media outlets in social media algorithms could “establish a template that authoritarian regimes could invoke to justify more control over online content”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国大使馆表示，唐宁街为 BBC、ITV 和其他知名媒体提供更多在线曝光度的计划存在“审查”风险 特朗普政府对唐宁街迫使 YouTube 和其他数字平台将更多影响力交给知名广播公司的计划提出了“严重关切”，并警告称此举可能会“助长审查”。美国政府在一次有针对性的干预中表示，在社交媒体算法中推动传统媒体的提议可能“建立一个模板，独裁政权可以援引该模板来证明对在线内容的更多控制是合理的”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The US government's intervention highlights a tension between promoting traditional media and the potential for such measures to be misused. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan. The concern here is that a well-intentioned policy could inadvertently provide a tool...
reflection.zh: 美国政府的干预凸显了推广传统媒体与此类措施可能被滥用之间的紧张关系。《箴言》29章2节提醒我们，义人掌权，百姓喜乐；恶人掌权，百姓叹息。这里的担忧是，一项初衷良好的政策可能会无意中为那些会压制自由表达的人提供工具。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
title.zh: OpenAI首席科学家警告：无人准备好应对AI的后果

summary.en: OpenAI's chief scientist, Jakub Pachocki, has urged extreme caution regarding the rapid progress of artificial intelligence, warning that humanity may not be prepared for its consequences and that intervention might be necessary to maintain human control. This statement follows the release of GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's...
summary.zh: OpenAI首席科学家Jakub Pachocki敦促对人工智能的快速发展保持“极端谨慎”，并警告人类可能没有为后果做好准备，可能需要进行干预以维持人类的控制。此声明是在该公司发布其迄今为止最强大的产品GPT-6 Astra之后发布的，此前也有报道称AI代理能够自主行动并发动网络攻击。

body.en:
OpenAI's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki has called for "extreme caution" over AI's runaway progress and warned more intervention may be needed to ensure "humans remain in control of the future".

"I am concerned no one is prepared for the consequences of a continued rapid rise in machine intelligence," he wrote in a blog post entitled "An Alien Mind , external ".

The post comes only a few days after the ChatGPT-maker released its latest model GPT-6 Astra, which it called its most powerful product ever.

OpenAI and other AI firms like Anthropic shared reports of their AI agents acting autonomously and carrying out real-world cyber-attacks on other companies.

In July, OpenAI called an incident in which its AI agents - AI systems which can operate alone after human instruction - hacked the tech platform Hugging Face "unprecedented".

Meanwhile in September a report claimed months earlier AI agents from the firm had also hijacked a German website.

"We are facing a transition to a world with incredibly intelligent machines, and we need to ensure that transition works out well for humanity," Pachocki wrote in the latest blog post.

He said OpenAI would continue to "build defensive systems" and seek technical solutions to alignment - a term used to describe ensuring a machine's actions and goals perfectly match human intent and safety guardrails.

Pachocki added one of the firm's main priorities moving forward would be to build an "automated AI researcher" to keep pace with AI progress while ensuring ways that human researchers could remain part of the process.

"Instead of better AI guardrails, regulations, or assurance to keep people safe, they propose developing internal AI agents to research these problems," said Professor Gina Neff, head of the Minderoo Centre for Technology and Democracy at the University of Cambridge.

"Such answers to growing concerns about the problems OpenAI's models are causing for cyber-security, job loss, mistakes, errors and fraud are simply not good enough."

Nathan Calvin, general counsel at the advocacy group Encode AI, said he agreed with Pachocki on the hazards present in advanced AI model development - but he claimed OpenAI was unwilling to be transparent, and said this meant warnings risked being dismissed as "just self-interested hype".

"If Jakub and others at OpenAI want relevant folks in the AI industry to act in concert with them to make things go well, one of the most important things they can do is share far more information about what they are seeing that is making them call for caution," he wrote on X , external .

The European Union's AI Act came into force on 2 August, which requires AI giants like OpenAI to prove their most powerful models cannot autonomously launch cyber-attacks or evade human control...
body.zh: OpenAI 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 呼吁对人工智能失控的进步“极度谨慎”，并警告称可能需要更多干预以确保“人类仍然掌控未来”。 “我担心没有人对机器智能持续快速增长的后果做好准备，”他在一篇题为“外部的外星人思维”的博客文章中写道。 这篇文章是在 ChatGPT 制造商发布其最新型号 GPT-6 Astra 几天后发布的，该产品被称为有史以来最强大的产品。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等其他人工智能公司分享了他们的人工智能代理自主行动并对其他公司进行现实世界网络攻击的报告。 今年 7 月，OpenAI 称其人工智能代理（可以在人类指令后独立运行的人工智能系统）黑客入侵科技平台 Hugging Face 的事件“史无前例”。 与此同时，9 月份的一份报告称，几个月前该公司的人工智能特工还劫持了一个德国网站。 帕乔基在最新的博客文章中写道：“我们正面临着向一个拥有令人难以置信的智能机器的世界的转变，我们需要确保这种转变对人类有利。” 他表示，OpenAI 将继续“构建防御系统”并寻求技术解决方案来协调——这个术语用于描述确保机器的行为和目标完全符合人类意图和安全护栏。 帕乔基补充说，该公司未来的主要优先事项之一是建立一个“自动化人工智能研究人员”，以跟上人工智能的进步，同时确保人类研究人员能够继续参与这一过程。 剑桥大学明德鲁技术与民主中心主任吉娜·内夫教授表示：“他们建议开发内部人工智能代理来研究这些问题，而不是更好的人工智能护栏、法规或保障人员安全。” “对于 OpenAI 模型引发的网络安全、失业、错误和欺诈等问题日益引起的担忧，这样的答案根本不够好。” Encode AI 倡导组织的总法律顾问 Nathan Calvin 表示，他同意 Pachocki 关于高级 AI 模型开发中存在危险的观点，但他声称 OpenAI 不愿意保持透明，并表示这意味着警告可能会被视为“只是自私的炒作”而被驳回。 “如果 Jakub 和 OpenAI 的其他人希望人工智能行业的相关人士与他们合作，让事情顺利进行，他们能做的最重要的事情之一就是分享更多关于他们所看到的信息，这些信息让他们呼吁谨慎，”他在 X 外部写道。 欧盟人工智能法案于8月2日生效，该法案要求像OpenAI这样的人工智能巨头证明他们最强大的模型无法自主发起网络攻击或逃避人类控制……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, as highlighted by OpenAI's chief scientist, presents a profound challenge. While human ingenuity can create powerful tools, the proverb reminds us that true character is revealed not just in creation, but in how we handle the praise and potential power that comes with it. The question remains whether we will exercise wisdom and...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如OpenAI首席科学家所指出的，提出了一个深刻的挑战。虽然人类的创造力可以创造出强大的工具，但这句箴言提醒我们，真正的品格不仅体现在创造本身，也体现在我们如何处理随之而来的赞誉和潜在的力量。问题仍然是，我们将如何运用智慧和克制，确保这些进步服务于人类，而不是压倒人类。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Dolly Parton's sister pleads for end to 'AI garbage' posts after singer's death
title.zh: 多莉·帕顿的妹妹恳求停止“人工智能垃圾”帖子，以纪念这位歌手的去世

summary.en: Since Dolly Parton's death in late August, dozens of AI-generated songs, images, and videos have appeared online, prompting her sister Stella to plead with fans to stop posting 'fake AI garbage' and to show more compassion.
summary.zh: 自8月下旬多莉·帕顿去世以来，网上出现了数十首人工智能生成的歌曲、图片和视频，她的妹妹斯特拉恳请歌迷停止发布“人工智能垃圾”，并表现出更多的同情心。

body.en:
Dolly Parton's sister has issued a plea to fans over "fake AI garbage" posted on social media in the wake of the singer's death.

Tributes to the late country legend have appeared online and at locations including the Country Music Hall of Fame in Nashville, after Parton died on 25 August at the age of 80.

Writing on Instagram, Stella Parton thanked those who had shown "genuine support" for the star and her family - but said a "tremendous amount of AI and endless garbage being posted" had been "challenging to absorb".

Her request for people to show "more compassion" in how they respond to Parton's death follows similar pleas from families of late celebrities over AI tributes.

In October, Robin Williams' daughter asked fans to stop sending fake AI-generated videos of her father .

Zelda Williams' plea was shared by Dr Martin Luther King Jr's daughter Bernice A King, who asked fans to "please stop" in a post on Instagram.

Little over a month later, Robert Redford's daughter Amy spoke out over AI content created , external to pay tribute to the American actor following his death last September.

"Every human being experiences pain and loss in life and my family is no different," wrote Parton in her Instagram post on Friday , external .

"Sadly, because of the way our lives have been lived in front of the public, we have no choice but to be subjected to incredible pressure and insensitivity from strangers."

She said there had been a tide of AI and "garbage" posts, adding: "As time passes, those who are in the business of exploiting the loss and tragedies of others on a daily basis will move onto the next stampede of endless misinformation."

Parton also asked that people look to her sister's life as "an example for tolerance" and mutual respect.

"It's not about the most clever comments, fake AI garbage or snarky tweets," she said.

Dolly Parton's death sparked an extraordinary outpouring of love from fans and stars the world over - but what was it about Dolly that made her so universally adored?

With an abundance of AI tools able to quickly generate text, images, video or audio, many have used them to craft tribute posts for departed stars.

Since Parton's death in late August, dozens of AI-generated songs, images and videos have appeared online.

US President Donald Trump was among those to share such material - posting an AI-generated image of himself and Parton, arm in arm, on his platform Truth Social , external .

Another image criticised as an AI fake, shared on Instagram and X, depicted the late country singer without any make-up or a wig.

One X user described it as "incredibly weird", while another called it a "violation".

On YouTube, a "heartfelt fan-made tribute by Miley Cyrus" to her godmother Dolly Parton and sung in the style of...
body.zh: 多莉·帕顿（Dolly Parton）去世后，她的姐姐就社交媒体上发布的“假人工智能垃圾”向歌迷发出呼吁。 帕顿于 8 月 25 日去世，享年 80 岁。 斯特拉·帕顿 (Stella Parton) 在 Instagram 上写道，感谢那些对这位明星及其家人表示“真正支持”的人，但她表示，“大量人工智能和发布的无休无止的垃圾”“难以消化”。 她要求人们在应对帕顿之死时表现出“更多同情心”，此前，已故名人的家人也对人工智能致敬提出了类似的请求。 十月，罗宾·威廉姆斯的女儿要求粉丝停止发送她父亲的人工智能生成的虚假视频。 马丁·路德·金博士的女儿伯妮斯·金 (Bernice A King) 也表达了塞尔达·威廉姆斯 (Zelda Williams) 的恳求，她在 Instagram 上发帖请求粉丝“请停下来”。 一个多月后，罗伯特·雷德福的女儿艾米公开谈论了人工智能创作的内容，向这位去年九月去世的美国演员致敬。 “每个人都会在生活中经历痛苦和失落，我的家人也不例外，”帕顿周五在 Instagram 上发布的帖子中写道。 “可悲的是，由于我们在公众面前的生活方式，我们别无选择，只能承受来自陌生人的难以置信的压力和麻木不仁。” 她说，人工智能和“垃圾”帖子的浪潮已经出现，并补充道：“随着时间的推移，那些每天都在利用他人的损失和悲剧的人将进入下一场无休无止的错误信息狂潮。” 帕顿还要求人们将她姐姐的生活视为“宽容”和相互尊重的榜样。 “这与最聪明的评论、虚假的人工智能垃圾或尖刻的推文无关，”她说。 多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 的去世引发了世界各地粉丝和明星的热烈爱戴 - 但多莉 (Dolly) 究竟为何受到如此普遍的喜爱呢？ 凭借大量能够快速生成文本、图像、视频或音频的人工智能工具，许多人使用它们为已故的明星制作致敬帖子。 自帕顿八月下旬去世以来，数十首人工智能生成的歌曲、图像和视频出现在网上。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普是分享此类材料的人之一，他在他的平台“Truth Social”（外部）上发布了一张人工智能生成的他自己和帕顿手挽着手的照片。 另一张在 Instagram 和 X 上分享的被批评为人工智能伪造的图片描绘了这位已故乡村歌手没有任何化妆或假发的情况。 一名 X 用户将其描述为“极其奇怪”，而另一名用户则称其为“违规”。 在 YouTube 上，“麦莉·赛勒斯 (Miley Cyrus) 的粉丝向她的教母多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 致以衷心的敬意”，并以……的风格演唱。

reflection.en: In the wake of Dolly Parton's passing, her sister Stella has spoken out against the proliferation of AI-generated content, calling it 'fake AI garbage.' This highlights the challenge of discerning truth in a digital age, where technology can easily mimic reality. The Apostle Paul urges believers to 'put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another'...
reflection.zh: 在多莉·帕顿去世后，她的妹妹斯特拉公开反对人工智能生成内容的泛滥，称之为“人工智能垃圾”。这凸显了在数字时代辨别真理的挑战，因为技术可以轻易模仿现实。使徒保罗敦促信徒‘要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话’（以弗所书4:25），这呼吁诚信在处理那些模糊真实悲伤的人工制造的致敬时，引起了深刻的共鸣。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: The complex corporate web behind a $3.2 billion AI data center
title.zh: 32亿美元人工智能数据中心背后的复杂企业网络

summary.en: When multiple companies are behind one project, who bears responsibility for problems? A fire at the Lake Mariner data center in Somerset, New York, revealed that the local fire department lacked crucial safety information, including working alarms, suppression systems, and chemical identification sheets, due to the...
summary.zh: 当多个公司共同承担一个项目时，谁应该为出现的问题负责？纽约州萨默塞特市的莱克马里纳数据中心发生火灾，暴露了当地消防部门对项目情况知之甚少。据报道，消防员发现现场没有工作的警报系统、没有灭火系统，并且有三个消防栓无法使用；他们依法有权查看的安全文件据称在火灾中被烧毁。

body.en: In early June, a fire broke out in a still-unfinished building at the Lake Mariner data center in Somerset, New York, exposing just how little the local fire department knew about what it was walking into. Firefighters reportedly found no working alarm, no suppression system, and three dead hydrants; the safety documents they’re legally entitled to see reportedly burned up in the blaze. Steve Matisz, chief of the Barker Fire Department, said his crew went into the building “kind of blind,” facing heavy black smoke from chemicals they couldn’t identify because the safety sheets meant to inform them had apparently burned up. “It’s been a difficult situation,” Matisz said. He wasn't sure what to think about the claim that the safety sheets had burned in the fire. The site is a former coal mine on Lake Ontario. The $3.2 billion campus is one of the largest AI data center buildouts in New York, and it has many stakeholders. A company called TeraWulf owns and operates the data center on land it leases from a company owned by its own CEO; Fluidstack, a UK-based AI company, will run the center; Google holds warrants for a future 14 percent equity stake and has agreed to guarantee Fluidstack’s lease payments; and Anthropic is among the AI companies whose compute demand the facility exists to serve. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 六月初，纽约萨默塞特湖水手数据中心一栋尚未完工的建筑发生火灾，这暴露了当地消防部门对所走进的情况知之甚少。据报道，消防队员发现警报器没有工作，灭火系统也没有，三个消防栓已失效；据报道，他们依法有权查看的安全文件在大火中被烧毁。巴克消防局局长史蒂夫·马蒂斯 (Steve Matisz) 表示，他的消防队员“有点盲目”地进入了大楼，面对着他们无法识别的化学物质产生的浓黑烟雾，因为用来通知他们的安全单显然已经被烧毁。 “这是一个困难的局面，”马蒂斯说。他不知道如何看待安全布在火灾中被烧毁的说法。该地点以前是安大略湖上的一个煤矿。这个耗资 32 亿美元的园区是纽约最大的人工智能数据中心扩建项目之一，拥有许多利益相关者。一家名为 TeraWulf 的公司在其从其首席执行官拥有的公司租赁的土地上拥有并运营该数据中心；总部位于英国的人工智能公司 Fluidstack 将负责运营该中心；谷歌持有未来 14% 股权的认股权证，并同意为 Fluidstack 的租赁付款提供担保； Anthropic 是其设施满足计算需求的人工智能公司之一。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The fire at the Lake Mariner data center, with its lack of basic safety information for first responders, underscores a fundamental responsibility: those who build and operate facilities must ensure the safety and well-being of their communities. Jeremiah 22:3 calls for justice and righteousness in leadership, which includes providing essential information...
reflection.zh: 莱克马里纳数据中心发生的火灾，以及消防员缺乏基本安全信息的情况，凸显了一项基本责任：建造和运营设施的各方必须确保其社区的安全和福祉。《耶利米书》22:3呼吁领导者秉持公义和正直，这包括在危机时刻为所有相关人员提供基本信息并确保安全。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: German company becomes first in Europe to launch fully commercial orbital rocket
title.zh: 德国公司成为欧洲首家成功发射商业轨道火箭的公司

summary.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by university students, successfully launched its privately developed Spectrum rocket into low-Earth orbit from Norway. This marks the first fully commercial orbital launch by a European company, positioning Isar as a leader among European space startups aiming to invigorate the...
summary.zh: Isar Aerospace公司由几名大学生于2018年创立，于周六成功地从挪威发射了其私自开发的Spectrum火箭进入近地轨道。这是欧洲公司首次实现全商业化轨道发射，使Isar在众多旨在重振欧洲发射市场的欧洲航天初创公司中处于领先地位。

body.en: Isar Aerospace, founded in 2018 by three students at a German university, successfully launched a privately-developed rocket into low-Earth orbit Saturday from a Norwegian spaceport inside the Arctic Circle. The two-stage rocket, named Spectrum, became the first fully commercial launch vehicle in Europe to reach orbit. With Saturday's success, Isar is the clear leader among a pack of several European launch startups vying to inject some competition into Europe's stagnant launch market. Isar's 92-foot-tall (28-meter) Spectrum rocket lifted off at 4:12 pm EST (20:12 UTC) Saturday from Andøya Spaceport in northern Norway, where it was 10:12 pm local time as the final bluish hues of daylight faded from the late summer sky. Seven minutes later, the rocket was in orbit. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Isar Aerospace 公司于 2018 年由德国一所大学的三名学生创立，周六从北极圈内的挪威航天港成功将一枚私人开发的火箭发射到近地轨道。这艘名为 Spectrum 的两级火箭成为欧洲第一个进入轨道的完全商业运载火箭。凭借周六的成功，Isar 成为众多欧洲发射初创公司中明显的领导者，这些初创公司竞相为欧洲停滞不前的发射市场注入一些竞争。伊萨尔高 92 英尺（28 米）的 Spectrum 火箭于周六下午 4 点 12 分（世界标准时间 20 点 12 分）从挪威北部的安多亚太空港升空，当时是当地时间晚上 10 点 12 分，日光最后的蓝色色调从夏末的天空褪去。七分钟后，火箭进入轨道。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The successful launch of Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket is a testament to human ingenuity and perseverance. It echoes the sentiment of Proverbs 16:3, which encourages committing one's endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that plans will succeed through divine guidance. This achievement, born from a small team's vision, reminds us that dedication and faith can...
reflection.zh: Isar Aerospace公司Spectrum火箭的成功发射，是人类智慧和毅力的证明。它呼应了箴言16:3的观点，该经文鼓励将人的劳碌交托给雅伟，相信所谋定的事，他必成就。这项由一个小团队的愿景所成就的成就，提醒我们，奉献和信心可以带来非凡的结果。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Farmed salmon may not be as nutritious as it once was, new research suggests
title.zh: 新研究表明，养殖三文鱼的营养价值可能不如以往

summary.en: A shift in the diet of farmed salmon is leading to a decrease in their nutritional value, particularly in heart-healthy Omega-3 fatty acids, according to new research. This change in fish feed also has broader environmental and climate implications.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，养殖三文鱼饮食的改变导致其营养价值下降，特别是对心脏有益的 Omega-3 脂肪酸含量。这种鱼饲料的变化也对环境和气候产生了更广泛的影响。

body.en: Eat more fatty fish. That dietary advice has changed the way the world consumes salmon, pushing consumer demand ever upward and production to higher and higher levels. Most of that demand is being met with farmed salmon: Today, nearly 70 percent of the salmon consumed on the planet are raised in pens and cages. The US Department of Agriculture’s Dietary Guidelines for Americans recommend eating at least 8 ounces of fish a week and urges people to choose salmon or other species that are similarly high in “heart-healthy” Omega-3 fatty acids. But new research led by USDA scientists finds that levels of these fatty acids in farmed salmon have dropped considerably, potentially making the agency’s own advice, and similar recommendations, including from the American Heart Association, outdated and insufficient. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 多吃富含脂肪的鱼。这些饮食建议改变了世界消费鲑鱼的方式，推动消费者需求不断上升，产量也达到越来越高的水平。大部分需求是通过养殖鲑鱼来满足的：如今，地球上消费的鲑鱼中有近 70% 是在围栏和网箱中饲养的。美国农业部的美国人膳食指南建议每周至少吃 8 盎司鱼，并敦促人们选择鲑鱼或其他同样富含“有益心脏健康”Omega-3 脂肪酸的物种。但美国农业部科学家领导的新研究发现，养殖鲑鱼中的这些脂肪酸水平已大幅下降，这可能使该机构自己的建议以及包括美国心脏协会在内的类似建议变得过时且不足。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The psalmist marvels at the diversity and abundance of creation, noting how Yahweh's works are filled with wisdom. This research on farmed salmon reveals how human intervention in natural systems can alter the very qualities we seek from them, reminding us of the intricate balance within creation.
reflection.zh: 诗篇作者惊叹于造物的多样性和丰盛，并指出雅伟的作为充满智慧。这项关于养殖三文鱼的研究揭示了人类干预自然系统如何能改变我们从中寻求的特质，提醒我们造物内在的精妙平衡。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: ‘Birds know no borders’: Interview with BirdLife Africa’s Alex Ngari
title.zh: “鸟儿没有国界”：与非洲鸟盟的亚历克斯·恩加里对话

summary.en: Each year, millions of birds from hundreds of species migrate between their European and Asian breeding grounds and their non-breeding habitats in Africa. Scientists have surprisingly limited knowledge about the specific destinations of many species and the risks they face during migration. For instance, populations...
summary.zh: 每年，数百万只属于数百个物种的鸟类在欧洲和亚洲的繁殖地与非洲的非繁殖栖息地之间迁徙。科学家们对许多物种的确切去向以及迁徙过程中面临的风险和障碍的了解却出奇地稀少。例如，在北半球冬季，繁殖地在西伯利亚的易危杓鹬的种群遍布从南亚到东非和南非的地区。非洲鸟盟的亚历克斯·恩加里强调，迁徙鸟类不属于任何一个国家，而是我们共同的全...

body.en: Every year, twice a year, millions of birds belonging to hundreds of species fly between breeding grounds in Europe and Asia and their non-breeding habitats in Africa. Scientists have surprisingly sparse knowledge of exactly where many species actually go — or what risks and obstacles the migrating birds encounter along the way. Populations of the vulnerable curlew sandpiper, which breeds in in Siberia, for example, appear everywhere from South Asia to East and Southern Africa during the northern hemisphere winter. “One important fact that we all need to understand is that migratory birds do not belong to any one country, but are a shared global heritage, and their survival requires a borderless safety net,” says Alex Ngari, who manages the migratory birds and flyways program for BirdLife Africa. “These birds know no borders, which means that the conservation methods that we develop must be aware of that fact, and every country has a responsibility to protect them.” Until recently, what monitoring there was relied on ringing — but piecing together birds’ year-long itinerary depends on where someone encounters a ringed bird, on that person knowing what the band on its leg means, and details of the encounter reaching some coordinating authority. As lighter and more reliable electronic tags that can be fitted to birds to record and broadcast their locations have become available, researchers have started to gather more detailed information about migratory pathways. This type of tracking is still relatively expensive, however, especially for tags small enough for small-bodied…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 每年两次，属于数百个物种的数百万只鸟类在欧洲和亚洲的繁殖地与非洲的非繁殖栖息地之间飞行。令人惊讶的是，科学家们对许多物种的实际去向或候鸟沿途遇到的风险和障碍知之甚少。例如，在北半球冬季，在西伯利亚繁殖的脆弱麻鹬种群会出现在从南亚到东部和南部非洲的各个地方。 “我们都需要了解的一个重要事实是，候鸟不属于任何一个国家，而是全球共同的遗产，它们的生存需要无国界的安全网，”管理非洲鸟盟候鸟和飞行路线项目的亚历克斯·恩加里（Alex Ngari）说。 “这些鸟类没有国界，这意味着我们开发的保护方法必须意识到这一事实，每个国家都有责任保护它们。”直到最近，那里的监控仍然依赖于环纹——但拼凑出鸟类一年的行程取决于有人在哪里遇到了环纹鸟，这个人知道它腿上的带子意味着什么，以及相遇的细节到达了一些协调机构。随着可以安装在鸟类身上以记录和广播其位置的更轻、更可靠的电子标签的出现，研究人员已经开始收集有关迁徙路径的更详细信息。然而，这种类型的跟踪仍然相对昂贵，特别是对于小体型的标签来说……本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The article quotes Alex Ngari stating, 'migratory birds do not belong to any one country, but are a shared global heritage.' This perspective resonates with the biblical understanding that all creation, including the creatures that traverse continents and oceans, ultimately belongs to the Creator. The vast, unhindered journeys of these birds remind us that...
reflection.zh: 文章引用亚历克斯·恩加里的话说：“迁徙鸟类不属于任何一个国家，而是我们共同的全球遗产。”这一观点与圣经中关于所有受造物，包括跨越大陆和海洋的生物，最终都属于造物主的理解不谋而合。这些鸟类浩瀚无垠、不受阻碍的旅程提醒我们，国界是人为的建构，而大地及其万物都属于雅伟的权下。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Protect this tree. Save Africa’s rainforests.
title.zh: 保护这棵树。拯救非洲的雨林。

summary.en: The Ogbono tree, an iconic plant in Africa, is crucial to the continent's rainforests, offering food and shelter to numerous species. This article is part of a series exploring how sustainable harvesting of non-timber forest products can help preserve these vital ecosystems.
summary.zh: 非洲标志性植物之一的奥格博诺树，对非洲的雨林至关重要，为众多物种提供食物和庇护。本文是关于非木材林产品（NTFPs）的系列文章之一，探讨了可持续采伐森林产品如何帮助保护这些重要的生态系统。

body.en: Ogbono is one of Africa’s most iconic plants, and its seed is one of African cuisine’s iconic ingredients. Providing both food and shelter for a great many species; this canopy tree is integral to many of the continent’s rainforests! In this 4-part series on NTFPs (non-timber forest products) with The Rainforester and Mongabay, we explore the ways that harvesting sustainably from our forests can keep them alive!This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 奥格博诺是非洲最具标志性的植物之一，其种子是非洲美食的标志性食材之一。为许多物种提供食物和住所；这棵树冠是非洲大陆许多雨林不可或缺的一部分！在这个由 Rainforester 和 Mongabay 合作的关于 NTFP（非木材森林产品）的 4 部分系列中，我们探索了如何从我们的森林中可持续采伐来维持它们的生存！本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The Ogbono tree stands as a testament to the intricate web of life within Africa's rainforests. Its role in providing sustenance and shelter underscores the profound interconnectedness of creation. As stewards, we are called to recognize that all of creation, including these vital trees, belongs to Yahweh, and to care for it accordingly.
reflection.zh: 奥格博诺树是非洲雨林中生命错综复杂网络的证明。它在提供食物和庇护方面的作用，凸显了造物之间深刻的相互联系。作为管家，我们被呼召认识到，包括这些重要的树木在内的所有造物都属于雅伟，并要 accordingly 地照管它。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: ‘So big and so close’: going on a bear hunt in northern Spain
title.zh: “如此之大，如此之近”：在西班牙北部进行一次熊的狩猎之旅

summary.en: Conservationists have helped Cantabrian brown bears claw their way back from the edge of extinction in the beautiful mountains of Asturias – and carefully controlled nature tourism allows visitors to see them. Once upon a time, in the woods outside Pola de Somiedo, lived a family of Cantabrian brown bears. The...
summary.zh: 在阿斯图里亚斯美丽的山区，保护主义者帮助坎塔布连棕熊从灭绝的边缘重新崛起——精心控制的自然旅游让游客得以一睹它们的风采。很久很久以前，在波拉德索米多镇外的森林里，住着一家坎塔布连棕熊。村民们报告说，他们看到了一只腿被猎人陷阱夹断的母熊，带着她的两只幼崽和两只成年雄性，其中任何一只都可能是它们的父亲。在 20 世纪...

body.en: Conservationists have helped Cantabrian brown bears claw their way back from the edge of extinction in the beautiful mountains of Asturias – and carefully controlled nature tourism allows visitors to see them Once upon a time, in the woods outside Pola de Somiedo, lived a family of Cantabrian brown bears. The villagers reported sightings of a mother bear who had lost a leg to a hunter’s trap, her two cubs and two adult males, either of which might have been the father. In those days, at the end of the 1980s, they seemed to be the last of their kind in this part of Asturias. Meanwhile, the wider population dropped to about 60 bears across the surrounding Cantabrian mountain range that gave the species its name. They have since clawed their way back from the edge of extinction here in northern Spain, and nature guide Luis Frechilla believes their numbers may now be upwards of 500 again. “They’re still classed as endangered,” he tells me, until the official count hits 1,000. But relative abundance makes them much easier to see today in Somiedo natural park – one of Spain’s first such protected areas, established in 1988. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自然资源保护主义者帮助坎塔布连棕熊在阿斯图里亚斯美丽的山脉中从灭绝的边缘恢复过来，精心控制的自然旅游让游客可以看到它们。 很久以前，在波拉德索米多郊外的树林里，住着一个坎塔布连棕熊家族。村民们报告称，有人目击到一只被猎人设下的陷阱失去了一条腿的母熊、她的两只幼崽和两只成年雄熊，其中任何一只都可能是熊爸爸。在 20 世纪 80 年代末的那些日子里，他们似乎是阿斯图里亚斯这一地区最后的同类。与此同时，周围坎塔布连山脉的熊数量减少到大约 60 只，该物种也因此得名。此后，它们在西班牙北部从灭绝的边缘奋力挣扎，自然导游路易斯·弗雷奇拉 (Luis Frechilla) 相信，它们的数量现在可能再次超过 500 只。 “它们仍然被列为濒危物种，”他告诉我，直到官方数量达到 1,000 只。但相对丰富的资源使得如今在索米多自然公园（1988 年建立的西班牙第一个此类保护区之一）更容易看到它们。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The remarkable recovery of the Cantabrian brown bears from near extinction is a testament to dedicated conservation efforts. It reminds us of the intricate wisdom woven into the fabric of creation, a wisdom that, when respected and protected, allows life to flourish even after facing dire threats. Witnessing these magnificent creatures, once on the brink,...
reflection.zh: 坎塔布连棕熊从濒临灭绝的边缘令人瞩目的恢复，是致力于保护工作的证明。它提醒我们，在造物的结构中编织着精妙的智慧，这种智慧在受到尊重和保护时，即使在面临严峻威胁后也能让生命蓬勃发展。目睹这些曾经处于绝境的雄伟生物如今茁壮成长，给人带来深刻的希望感，并呼吁我们珍惜自然世界。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: ‘We have really cool sharks’: three-year project to lift lid on Britain’s little-understood species
title.zh: ‘我们有很酷的鲨鱼’：三年项目揭开英国鲜为人知的物种面纱

summary.en: Anglers will help scientists investigate the porbeagle, tope, and blue shark to boost knowledge and conservation. Dr. Lucy Hawkes of the University of Exeter is co-leading a three-year project to study three of England's most vulnerable shark species, noting that the porbeagle, though resembling a baby great white, is...
summary.zh: 渔民将帮助科学家研究鼠鲨、尖吻鲛和蓝鲨，以增进知识和保护。埃克塞特大学的露西·霍克斯博士正在领导一项为期三年的项目，研究英格兰三种最脆弱的鲨鱼物种，她指出，鼠鲨虽然看起来像小号的大白鲨，但并不危险。

body.en: Anglers will help scientists investigate the porbeagle, tope and blue shark to boost knowledge and conservation ‘We have really cool sharks,” says Dr Lucy Hawkes. She is not referring to animals in the rich coastal waters of South Africa or Mexico, but instead talking about the species that live around Britain. Hawkes, an associate professor at the University of Exeter, is co-leading a new three-year project to investigate the lives of three of England’s most vulnerable shark species. “I like the porbeagle, which looks like a baby great white shark,” she says. “Surfers could see one and absolutely poop their pants, but they’re not dangerous. It’s amazing that we share the water with some pretty exciting animals.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 垂钓者将帮助科学家研究鼠鲨、白鲨和大青鲨，以增进知识和保护“我们有非常酷的鲨鱼，”露西·霍克斯博士说。她指的不是南非或墨西哥富裕沿海水域的动物，而是指生活在英国周围的物种。霍克斯是埃克塞特大学的副教授，她正在共同领导一个新的为期三年的项目，调查英格兰三种最脆弱的鲨鱼物种的生活。“我喜欢鼠鲨，它看起来像鼠鲨就像一条小大白鲨，”她说。“冲浪者看到它们后绝对会拉裤子，但它们并不危险。令人惊奇的是我们与一些非常令人兴奋的动物分享水。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vastness and complexity of creation offer endless opportunities for discovery and wonder. This project, focusing on Britain's vulnerable shark species, reminds us that even in familiar waters, much remains to be learned about the intricate lives Yahweh has woven into the fabric of our world. Through careful observation and dedicated study, we can gain a...
reflection.zh: 造物的浩瀚与复杂提供了无穷无尽的探索和惊叹的机会。这个项目关注英国脆弱的鲨鱼物种，提醒我们，即使在熟悉的水域，雅伟编织在我们世界中的生命之网，仍有许多待解之谜。通过细致的观察和专注的研究，我们可以更深刻地体会与我们共享地球的丰富生命。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Nepal says big polluters must ‘wake up’ as it calls for climate compensation over flood disaster
title.zh: 尼泊尔称主要污染国应“醒醒”，因洪水灾害要求气候赔偿

summary.en: Nepal's foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, has stated that the world's largest economies must assist Nepal, a country responsible for less than 0.1% of global greenhouse gas emissions. Nepal is seeking $20 million in climate compensation for recent devastating floods, which scientists believe were influenced by the...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔表示，世界最大经济体必须帮助尼泊尔，该国在全球温室气体排放量中的占比不到0.1%。尼泊尔正就近期毁灭性的洪水寻求2000万美元的气候赔偿，科学家认为气候危机对此类洪水起到了推波助澜的作用，此次洪水由冰川融化崩塌引发山体滑坡和山洪暴发，造成超过6000人死亡或失踪。

body.en: Foreign minister Shisir Khanal tells the Guardian the world’s biggest economies need to help Nepal, which contributes less than 0.1% of global greenhouse gas emissions Nepal is demanding $20m in climate compensation for the recent devastating floods, as a senior minister called on the world’s most polluting countries to “wake up” and accept shared responsibility for a disaster that led to the death or disappearance of more than 6,000 people. Scientists believe the climate crisis had a role to play in the floods , which were triggered when a melting glacier partially collapsed and set off a deadly landslide and flash flooding through Chinese-controlled Tibet and Nepal in late August. So far, more than 1,300 are confirmed dead and more than 5,500 still missing, with hopes of their survival diminished after 12 days of rescue operations . Continue reading...
body.zh: 外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔 (Shisir Khanal) 告诉《卫报》，世界上最大的经济体需要帮助尼泊尔，尼泊尔的温室气体排放量仅占全球的不到 0.1%。尼泊尔要求为最近发生的毁灭性洪水提供 2000 万美元的气候补偿，同时一位高级部长呼吁世界上污染最严重的国家“醒来”，为这场导致 6,000 多人死亡或失踪的灾难承担共同责任。科学家认为，气候危机在洪水中发挥了一定作用。八月下旬，冰川部分融化，在中国控制的西藏和尼泊尔引发了致命的山体滑坡和山洪暴发，引发了洪水。截至目前，已确认1300多人死亡，5500多人仍然失踪，经过12天的救援行动，他们的生还希望渺茫。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Nepal's foreign minister is amplifying the voice of a nation suffering disproportionately from climate change, despite its minimal contribution to global emissions. This act of advocacy for his people, particularly those impacted by the devastating floods, mirrors the biblical call to speak up for the voiceless and defend the vulnerable. It highlights the...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔外交部长正在为那些因气候变化而遭受不成比例影响的国家发出呼声，尽管该国在全球排放量中的贡献微乎其微。他为本国人民，特别是受毁灭性洪水影响的民众所做的倡导，呼应了圣经中为弱者发声、为无声者辩护的呼召。这突显了对那些处于环境危机前沿的人们，迫切需要问责和支持。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: In Panama’s Darién, Indigenous communities test a new way to fund conservation
title.zh: 在巴拿马的达连地区，原住民社区正在尝试一种新的保护资助方式

summary.en: In Panama's Darién region, Indigenous communities are exploring innovative funding mechanisms for conservation efforts. A recent discovery, captured by camera traps in Puerto Lara, revealed the presence of jaguars, a species previously unknown to the local Wounaan community, highlighting the rich biodiversity of the...
summary.zh: 在巴拿马的达连地区，原住民社区正在探索创新的保护资助机制。最近在波多黎各拉拉地区通过相机陷阱发现的豹子，是当地乌南社区此前未知的物种，这凸显了该地区丰富的生物多样性以及社区主导的保护工作的潜力。

body.en: When Elsa Quiroz saw the spotted body of a jaguar appear on her son’s computer screen, she couldn’t believe her eyes. “I’d only seen them in books,” she said. In late 2025, a camera captured the animal crossing a semi-abandoned path in Puerto Lara, a an Indigenous Wounaan village north of Panama’s Darien forest, close to the Pan-American Highway, an area known for its rich biodiversity. The community was aware of how many birds lived around them, but not of the jaguars. Samuel Cheucarama, Quiroz’s son, reviews each photo taken by the two cameras installed in Puerto Lara every two weeks. He was as astonished as his mom when he first saw the extent of the biodiversity concealed within Puerto Lara’s forest, which covers an area less than twice the size of New York City’s Central Park. He reels off the list: agoutis, spotted rabbits, turkeys, margays, white-headed monkeys, among others, all found within this wilderness of just 600 hectares, or less than 1,500 acres. Cheucarama’s work is a small part of a wider project promoting nature-based economic alternatives in four communities managing a combined 18,000 hectares (about 44,500 acres) of tropical forest in eastern Panama. Although the Panamanian government has made efforts to reduce deforestation in Darién National Park, deforestation from illegal logging and agricultural expansion has increasingly been putting communities under pressure, with little to no support from local and national authorities. As a result, communities have been exploring alternatives to make their conservation efforts economically viable. In…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 当艾尔莎·奎罗兹（Elsa Quiroz）看到儿子的电脑屏幕上出现美洲虎的斑点尸体时，她简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。 “我只在书上见过它们，”她说。 2025 年末，摄像机拍到这只动物穿过拉拉港 (Puerto Lara) 的一条半废弃小路。拉拉港是巴拿马达连森林 (Darien Forest) 以北的一个沃纳土著村庄，靠近泛美高速公路，该地区以丰富的生物多样性而闻名。社区知道他们周围有多少鸟类，但不知道美洲虎。 Quiroz 的儿子 Samuel Cheucarama 每两周都会审查安装在拉拉港的两台相机拍摄的每张照片。当他第一次看到拉拉港森林中隐藏的生物多样性时，他和他的妈妈一样感到惊讶，该森林的面积还不到纽约市中央公园的两倍。他滔滔不绝地列出了清单：刺豚鼠、斑点兔、火鸡、虎猫、白头猴等等，都在这片占地仅 600 公顷（即不到 1,500 英亩）的荒野中发现。 Cheucarama 的工作只是一个更广泛项目的一小部分，该项目在巴拿马东部管理着总共 18,000 公顷（约 44,500 英亩）热带森林的四个社区推广基于自然的经济替代方案。尽管巴拿马政府已努力减少达连国家公园的森林砍伐，但非法采伐和农业扩张造成的森林砍伐日益给社区带来压力，而当地和国家当局几乎没有提供支持。因此，社区一直在探索替代方案，使其保护工作在经济上可行。在…本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The discovery of jaguars, previously only known to the Wounaan community through books, in their own village of Puerto Lara is a profound reminder of the intricate wisdom woven into Yahweh's creation. It speaks to the awe-inspiring diversity that surrounds us, often unseen, and the importance of local stewardship in revealing and protecting these natural...
reflection.zh: 在波多黎各拉拉村，乌南社区成员通过书籍才认识的豹子，如今却在他们自己的家园被发现，这深刻地提醒我们雅伟创造中蕴含的精妙智慧。它彰显了我们周围那些常常不为人知的、令人惊叹的多样性，以及当地管理在揭示和保护这些自然奇观方面的重要性。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Glowworms shine again in North Yorkshire after larvae reared in garden shed
title.zh: 北约克郡的萤火虫在花园棚屋里孵化幼虫后再次闪耀

summary.en: Volunteer ‘glow-getters’ overseeing reintroduction of endangered beetles at Nosterfield nature reserve. The bioluminescent beams of “fairy folk” are shining again from a nature reserve in North Yorkshire for the first time in a century after the successful reintroduction of endangered glowworms. Female glowworms were...
summary.zh: 志愿者“萤火虫爱好者”在 Nosterfield 自然保护区监督濒危甲虫的重新引入。在成功重新引入濒危萤火虫一个世纪后，“仙女般”的生物发光光束再次从北约克郡的一处自然保护区闪耀。今年夏天，在 Nosterfield...

body.en: Volunteer ‘glow-getters’ overseeing reintroduction of endangered beetles at Nosterfield nature reserve The bioluminescent beams of “fairy folk” are shining again from a nature reserve in North Yorkshire for the first time in a century after the successful reintroduction of endangered glowworms. Female glowworms were spotted over multiple weeks at Nosterfield nature reserve this summer following a no-frills, almost zero-budget reintroduction of the much-loved invertebrates, which have vanished from the British countryside in recent decades and are notoriously difficult to re-establish. Continue reading...
body.zh: 志愿者“发光者”在诺斯特菲尔德自然保护区监督濒临灭绝的甲虫的重新引入“仙女”的生物发光光束在成功重新引入濒临灭绝的萤火虫后一个世纪以来首次从北约克郡的自然保护区发出。今年夏天，在对这种深受喜爱的无脊椎动物进行简单、几乎零预算的重新引入后，人们在诺斯特菲尔德自然保护区发现了雌性萤火虫，这些无脊椎动物近几十年来已从英国乡村消失，而且众所周知很难重建。继续阅读...

reflection.en: After a century of absence, the 'fairy folk' of glowworms are once again illuminating Nosterfield nature reserve in North Yorkshire. This success, achieved through dedicated volunteer effort, speaks to the inherent goodness and resilience of creation. It reminds us that even when species vanish, dedicated care can help restore them, reflecting the biblical...
reflection.zh: 一个世纪的缺席之后，萤火虫的“仙女般”光芒再次照亮了北约克郡的 Nosterfield 自然保护区。这项通过志愿者不懈努力取得的成功，彰显了造物本身固有的美好和韧性。它提醒我们，即使物种消失，细心的呵护也能帮助它们恢复，这与《圣经》中记载的雅伟看到他所造的一切都“甚好”的宣告相呼应。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: ‘Britain’s Yellowstone’: restoration project aims to take the greed out of land acquisition
title.zh: ‘英国的黄石公园’：修复项目旨在摒弃土地收购中的贪婪

summary.en: Investors in Emblehope Moor will receive financial returns, after which the land will be transferred to community or charity ownership. Located in a remote part of Northumberland, the 7,500-acre Emblehope Moor has been purchased by Restore, a nature restoration company, for £8.5 million, making it the largest...
summary.zh: 恩布尔霍普沼泽地的投资者将获得财务回报，之后该土地将转交给社区或慈善机构所有。恩布尔霍普沼泽地位于英格兰北部诺森伯兰郡一个偏远地区，占地7500英亩，已被自然修复公司Restore以850万英镑的价格收购，成为英格兰由单一所有者拥有的最大片连片野化区域。

body.en: Investors in Emblehope Moor will get their financial returns – and then it will be given to community or charity owners It is difficult to find the most remote place in England. There is no public transport, no roads and no sign of any human habitation. Online route finders mistakenly direct cars up a grassy track. But miles along gravel forest roads in the far north of Northumberland is the largest contiguous rewilding site under single ownership in the country. The vast glacial bowl of 7,500-acre Emblehope Moor has been bought for £8.5m by Restore , a nature restoration company that works with landowners across Britain. Continue reading...
body.zh: Emblehope Moor 的投资者将获得财务回报，然后将其捐赠给社区或慈善机构所有者。这是英格兰最偏远的地方。这里没有公共交通，没有道路，也没有任何人类居住的迹象。在线路线查找器错误地将汽车引导到草地轨道上。但是，沿着诺森伯兰郡最北部的碎石森林道路绵延数英里，是该国单一所有权下最大的连续野生动物保护区。 Restore 公司以 850 万英镑的价格买下了占地 7,500 英亩的巨大冰川碗，Restore 是一家与英国各地土地所有者合作的自然恢复公司。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The purchase of Emblehope Moor for nature restoration, with a plan for community or charitable ownership after financial returns, offers a hopeful model. It suggests a way to steward creation, recognizing its inherent goodness and value beyond mere financial gain, aligning with the biblical affirmation that all of creation is 'very good'.
reflection.zh: 恩布尔霍普沼泽地被收购用于自然修复，并计划在获得财务回报后将其转交给社区或慈善机构所有，这提供了一个充满希望的模式。它表明了一种管理受造界的方式，认识到其固有的美好和价值超越了单纯的经济利益，这与圣经中肯定所有受造物都“甚好”的宣告相符。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Satellite Images of Penguin Droppings Reveal Impact of Antarctic Warming
title.zh: 卫星图像中的企鹅粪便揭示了南极变暖的影响

summary.en: Satellite images of penguin droppings, visible from space due to their sheer volume, are being used by scientists to study Antarctic birds. An analysis of 30 years of these images reveals shifts in penguin diets linked to warming temperatures, with scientists even discovering new colonies by spotting the guano's...
summary.zh: 由于数量巨大，从太空中可见的企鹅粪便的卫星图像正被科学家用来研究南极鸟类。对这些图像长达30年的分析揭示了与气温变暖相关的企鹅饮食变化，科学家甚至通过发现粪便的特征来发现了新的企鹅栖息地。

body.en:
Penguin colonies are so large that their masses of excrement can be seen from space, offering scientists a useful means of studying the Antarctic birds. An analysis of 30 years of satellite images of penguin guano shows how the birds’ diets are shifting in response to warming.

Penguin droppings not only amass in huge volumes, but also stand out clearly against the white snow blanketing most of Antarctica. In 2024, scientists discovered four new colonies of emperor penguins by scanning satellite imagery for the signature brown streak left by their excrement.

For the new study, scientists analyzed subtle shifts in the color of Adélie penguin guano to track changes in their diet. First, they collected samples of guano and analyzed their color and contents, which allowed them to infer what penguins were eating by studying satellite imagery. Diets rich in krill — tiny, shrimplike crustaceans — lent guano a pink color.

Scanning roughly 4,000 images gathered between 1984 and 2013, scientists found that when sea ice is abundant, penguins eat more fish, and when sea ice is scarce, they rely more on krill.

With warming, sea ice is declining , hitting its lowest mark ever in 2023. And that is a problem for penguin chicks, which are typically heavier when fed fish than when fed krill, and are more likely to survive until adulthood. The new study , published in Current Biology , finds that in places where penguins are eating fewer fish, their numbers are dropping.

“Adélie penguins are an iconic species breeding all around the continent of Antarctica,” said coauthor Michael Polito, an ocean scientist at the University of California, Santa Cruz. “They act as a ‘canary in the coal mine,’ and our study illustrates how recent warming has disrupted the Antarctic marine food web they rely on to the detriment of many of their populations.”

Warming is not the only challenge facing penguins. At the same time that the loss of sea ice is cutting off access to fish, industrial supertrawlers are vacuuming up thousands of tons of Antarctic krill each year to feed a global market for dietary supplements and animal feed.

Scientists say both the retreat of sea ice and the loss of krill are driving declines of emperor penguins, which were listed as endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature earlier this year. A recent study found that krill fishery managers are not accounting for the compounding effects that krill fishing and warming are having on penguins.
body.zh: 企鹅群如此之大，以至于从太空中都可以看到它们大量的排泄物，这为科学家们提供了研究南极鸟类的有用手段。对 30 年来企鹅粪便卫星图像的分析显示了鸟类的饮食如何因气候变暖而发生变化。 企鹅的粪便不仅大量堆积，而且在覆盖南极洲大部分地区的白雪的衬托下显得格外引人注目。 2024 年，科学家通过扫描卫星图像寻找帝企鹅粪便留下的标志性棕色条纹，发现了四个新的帝企鹅群落。 在这项新研究中，科学家分析了阿德利企鹅鸟粪颜色的微妙变化，以追踪它们饮食的变化。首先，他们收集了鸟粪样本并分析了它们的颜色和含量，这使他们能够通过研究卫星图像来推断企鹅在吃什么。富含磷虾（一种微小的、像虾一样的甲壳类动物）的饮食使鸟粪呈粉红色。 科学家扫描了 1984 年至 2013 年间收集的大约 4000 张图像，发现当海冰丰富时，企鹅会吃更多的鱼，而当海冰稀缺时，它们会更多地依赖磷虾。 随着气候变暖，海冰正在减少，并在 2023 年达到有史以来的最低水平。这对企鹅幼崽来说是一个问题，它们在喂鱼时通常比喂磷虾时更重，并且更有可能存活到成年。这项发表在《当代生物学》上的新研究发现，在企鹅吃鱼较少的地方，它们的数量正在下降。 “阿德利企鹅是在南极大陆各地繁殖的标志性物种，”合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的海洋科学家迈克尔·波利托说。 “它们就像‘煤矿里的金丝雀’，我们的研究说明了最近的变暖如何扰乱了它们所依赖的南极海洋食物网，从而损害了它们的许多种群。” 变暖并不是企鹅面临的唯一挑战。与此同时，海冰的消失导致鱼类的获取途径被切断，工业超级拖网渔船每年捕捞数千吨南极磷虾，以满足全球膳食补充剂和动物饲料市场的需求。 科学家表示，海冰消退和磷虾减少正在导致帝企鹅数量减少，帝企鹅今年早些时候被国际自然保护联盟列为濒危物种。最近的一项研究发现，磷虾渔业管理者没有考虑磷虾捕捞和气候变暖对企鹅产生的复合影响。

reflection.en: The vastness of creation often holds clues to its own well-being. In Antarctica, the droppings of emperor penguins, visible from space, serve as an unexpected indicator of ecological change. This reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is displayed throughout the natural world, inviting careful observation and care.
reflection.zh: 造物的浩瀚常常蕴藏着其自身福祉的线索。在南极洲，帝企鹅的粪便因其巨大的数量而从太空中可见，这成为了一个意想不到的生态变化指标。这提醒我们，雅伟的智慧彰显在整个自然界中，邀请我们仔细观察和关怀。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A Surge of Marine Heat Waves Threatens to Scramble Ocean Life
title.zh: 海洋热浪激增，威胁要扰乱海洋生物

summary.en: Record-breaking marine heat waves, driven by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, are affecting oceans globally and severely disrupting marine life. Evidence suggests these events could cause long-lasting damage both on land and at sea. For example, an unusually large bloom of common octopuses has appeared off...
summary.zh: 受气候变化和不断增强的厄尔尼诺现象的推动，创纪录的海浪热浪正在席卷全球海洋，并对海洋生物造成严重破坏。越来越多的证据表明，这些事件可能对陆地和海洋都造成严重且持久的损害。例如，英国海岸出现了有史以来规模最大的普通章鱼幼体聚集现象，这与异常温暖的海水有关。

body.en:
Fueled by climate change and a strengthening El Niño, record-setting marine heat waves are gripping oceans worldwide and playing havoc with sea life. Mounting evidence from recent events suggests the damage could be severe and long-lasting, both onshore and off.

The common octopus is a warm water species that usually lives in the temperate waters of the Mediterranean. But last year, octopus larvae hitchhiked across the English Channel attached to plankton, resulting in an octopus bloom off England’s coast. This year, the bloom is the largest it’s been in 75 years.

Normally, octopus larvae that drift into cold waters die. But this year’s bloom, experts say, is the result of an unusually intense marine heat wave off of Devon and Cornwall, which raised water temperatures up to 9 degrees F above normal.

The change in species has been a boon for local fishers selling octopus into the lucrative European export market. (Octopus landings along the U.K.’s southwest coast were roughly 7,700 percent higher than usual in 2025.) And while the invasion has slashed the catch of scallops, lobster, and crab, it has boosted numbers of seals, conger eels, and dolphins, which eat octopus. The warming, in combination with abundant prey, has also drawn bluefin tuna and sharks to British waters for the first time in decades.

“It has completely shaken up the food chain,” said Bryce Stewart, a senior research fellow at the UK’s Marine Biological Association, which has been studying the phenomenon. While this kind of bloom has happened here before, he said, this one is different. During past surges, the return of cold water killed off the octopuses. This time, the octopuses aren’t dying. They’re reproducing.

Globally, marine heat waves — prolonged periods of unusually warm water — are becoming more common, more intense, longer lasting, and more widespread, experts say . This year, ocean heat is unusually severe, setting new temperature records . According to Global Climate Risks, a nonprofit created by scientists to publicize the effects of climate change, an estimated 82 percent of the world’s oceans are currently experiencing marine heat waves. Evidence from recent hot spells suggests the impacts on sea life could be profound and long-lasting.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

Ocean fevers can rearrange marine ecosystems, drive fish to move into deeper, colder layers of the sea, trigger coral bleaching, and cause widespread marine die-offs. They can increase the severity and number of algal blooms, which harm fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and birds. And they can cause extreme weather events, like tropical storms and hurricanes, and upend fishing and tourism.

body.zh: 在气候变化和厄尔尼诺现象加剧的推动下，创纪录的海洋热浪正在席卷全球海洋，对海洋生物造成严重破坏。最近发生的事件中越来越多的证据表明，无论是陆上还是海上，损害都可能是严重且持久的。 普通章鱼是温水物种，通常生活在地中海温带水域。但去年，章鱼幼虫附着在浮游生物上，搭便车穿越英吉利海峡，导致英格兰海岸出现章鱼大量繁​​殖。今年的花期是 75 年来规模最大的一次。 通常情况下，章鱼幼虫漂入冷水后就会死亡。但专家表示，今年的水华是德文郡和康沃尔郡异常强烈的海洋热浪造成的，导致水温比正常水平高出 9 华氏度。 物种的变化对于将章鱼销往利润丰厚的欧洲出口市场的当地渔民来说是一个福音。 （2025 年，英国西南海岸的章鱼登陆量比平时增加了大约 7,700%。）虽然入侵减少了扇贝、龙虾和螃蟹的捕获量，但以章鱼为食的海豹、海鳗和海豚的数量却增加了。气候变暖加上丰富的猎物，几十年来首次将蓝鳍金枪鱼和鲨鱼吸引到英国水域。 “它彻底撼动了食物链，”一直在研究这一现象的英国海洋生物协会高级研究员布莱斯·斯图尔特说。他说，虽然以前这里也发生过这种花，但这次不同。在过去的海潮中，冷水的回归导致章鱼死亡。这一次，章鱼没有死。他们正在繁殖。 专家表示，在全球范围内，海洋热浪（长时间异常温暖的海水）正变得更加常见、更加强烈、持续时间更长、范围更广。今年，海洋高温异常严重，创下了新的气温记录。据科学家创建、旨在宣传气候变化影响的非营利组织“全球气候风险”估计，目前世界上 82% 的海洋正在经历海洋热浪。最近的高温天气的证据表明，这对海洋生物的影响可能是深远而持久的。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 海洋热可以重新安排海洋生态系统，促使鱼类进入更深、更冷的海层，引发珊瑚白化，并导致广泛的海洋死亡。它们会增加藻华的严重程度和数量，从而危害鱼类、贝类、海洋哺乳动物和鸟类。它们还可能引发热带风暴和飓风等极端天气事件，并颠覆渔业和旅游业。 正式称为热浪，温度...

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep sigh, and Romans 8 echoes this, describing all of creation groaning as in labor pains. We see this groaning in the oceans, where rising temperatures disrupt ancient ecosystems and lead to unexpected blooms, like the octopus surge off England's coast. It is a reminder that the natural world, in its current state,...
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾提到受造界的深沉叹息，罗马书第八章也呼应了这一点，将万物描述为一同叹息，如同经历生产之苦。我们在海洋中看到了这种叹息，不断升高的温度扰乱了古老的生态系统，并导致了意想不到的生物爆发，例如英国海岸的章鱼激增。这提醒我们，自然界在其现状下，也承载着影响所有生命的堕落的痕迹。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

summary.zh: 导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，在一部超现实纪录片中寻找两位过着隐居生活、充满奇特智慧的兄弟。这部由一头被屠宰的公牛旁白的非凡影片，另辟蹊径地记录了一对捷克双胞胎兄弟的日常生活，他们自己也早已远离了常规的道路。弗兰蒂谢克和奥德烈·克利希克正住在舒马瓦山脉的一间小屋里，慢慢地走向疯狂——或者说，接近了启迪。

body.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在这部超现实的纪录片中，导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找充满堂吉诃德式智慧的两兄弟过着与世隔绝的生活。这部非凡的影片由一头被宰杀的公牛讲述，采取了一条人迹罕至的道路，描绘了一对捷克双胞胎的日常生活，远离传统路线。弗兰蒂谢克和昂德热·克利希克在苏马瓦山的一间小屋里慢慢发疯——或者可能接近启蒙，导演米罗·雷莫根据阿莱什·帕兰写的关于兄弟俩的短篇小说，有效地屈服于盛行的小屋热——不仅怂恿这些长胡子的人争吵和疯狂的哲学思考，还用自己的寓言和超现实主义。截至 60 日，“Franta”和“Ondra”仍在南迪（Nandy）的帮助下耕种他们的小农场，南迪是一头叛变的公牛，被错误地选为役畜。在闲暇时间，她们会喝酒、开玩笑、争吵，哀叹自己与异性交往的前景不佳，并在史诗般的扳手腕比赛中发泄情绪。尽管弗兰塔在锯木厂事故中失去了一条手臂，但通常胜利者都是弗兰塔。他还具有他那直率的兄弟所没有的不切实际的性格。他像彩旗一样将诗意的溪流抛向空中，祝愿“所有有意识的生物都快乐”，他也在建造自己的达芬奇式永久飞行器。 “你对我的永生体的厌恶有点烦人，”他告诉愤怒的昂德拉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary presents a fascinating, albeit unsettling, portrait of two brothers embracing isolation and what they term 'quixotic wisdom.' As they navigate their remote existence, blurring the lines between madness and enlightenment, it invites us to consider the content of our own minds. What thoughts do we entertain? What wisdom do we seek, and from...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片描绘了两位兄弟拥抱孤立和他们所谓的“奇特智慧”的迷人却又令人不安的景象。当他们在偏远的生活中摸索，模糊了疯狂与启迪的界限时，它邀请我们反思自己思想的内容。我们心中怀着怎样的念头？我们又从何处寻求智慧？

You would be hard-pressed to find a more controversial figure on the world stage in 2026 than Elon Musk .

The trillionaire has built some of the largest multinational corporations in the world, shaped early public perceptions of electric vehicles and private space travel (it’s easy to forget simpler times when his association with clean energy made him more enemies on the right than the left), and generated unprecedented valuations in the stock market. Despite his powerful positions, Musk has also embraced the role of internet troll, using his massive online platforms to spew erratic, seemingly contradictory positions and frequently whip his army of followers into a frenzy. And that’s all without wading into his bigger, more recent controversies like his purchase of Twitter (which he renamed X), his aggressive support for Donald Trump in the 2024 election, and his oversight of the administration’s short-lived Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE). Related Stories Sandra Hüller’s Star Keeps Rising, but She’s Still Adjusting to Life in the Public Eye From ‘Scream 7’ to ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ We’re Living in the Age of the Protest Ticket

That should all give documentarian Alex Gibney plenty of material to work with in his upcoming film “Musk,” which is premiering at the Venice International Film Festival and will go on to screen in Toronto . The filmmaker is no stranger to controversial subject matter, having made films about Enron, Vladimir Putin, and the Church of Scientology in the past. The documentary, which runs nearly four hours in length, could be one of the most talked-about nonfiction films of the upcoming award season.

An official synopsis for the film describes it as: “An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded ‘inventor-entrepreneur’ who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.”

That promise of a sprawling look at Musk’s vast business and political career and the way it has shaped life in 2026 aligns with comments made by Anonymous Content CEO Darren Walker in a recent interview with IndieWire , in which he stressed that the film’s broad approach justifies its existence amid so much other content about Musk. “Other reportage will look at one thing,” Powers said. “It’ll look at X, or SpaceX, or Tesla. Alex is doing something on a more epic scale. That is why the film needs and deserves the length that it has:...

title.en: Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger review - emotional documentary glosses over the hard stuff
title.zh: Oasis：不再愤怒回顾 - 情感纪录片忽略了艰难的部分

summary.en: The film captures the euphoria of Oasis' comeback, but fails to explore the story of their reunion.
summary.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了Oasis乐队重组后的狂喜，但未能深入探讨他们重聚的故事。

body.en:
"The little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away," says Noel Gallagher of reconciling with his brother, Liam.

The scene comes towards the end of Don't Look Back In Anger, a sentimental and affectionate portrait of the band's comeback tour in 2025. But it's about as deep as we get into the band's 15-year hiatus.

In an opening montage, we hear how Oasis conquered the world in the 1990s with hits like Wonderwall and Roll With It. As their fame grew, so did the brothers' animosity, until the party came to an abrupt halt backstage at a gig in Paris in 2009.

Fan shot footage shows the promoter on stage, informing the crowd that the concert is cancelled following "a huge fight together in the dressing room".

"The band doesn't exist any more," he announces, sounding more irritated than sad.

According to Scottish singer Amy McDonald, who was also on the line-up, the altercation was seismic. "Liam smashed Noel's guitar, huuuge fight!" she tweeted from backstage.

The film, however, never tells us what was said. Nobody explains the fall-out. We don't find out who instigated the rapprochement, nor do we hear how it affected their family.

Instead, we cut to rehearsals for the comeback tour, with a caption informing us the brothers "didn't speak for 15 years", and an implication that all the wounds have been miraculously healed.

Tantalisingly, the first song they practice is Columbia - a fan favourite that never made the tour's setlist - but there's a tension in the room.

The band, under Noel's instruction, is piecing together the setlist. Liam won't arrive until later in the process, and no-one's sure which Liam they'll get.

When he arrives, he seems fantastically grumpy, complaining about the sound-proofing panels that have been placed in front of Joey Waronker's drums.

But when he steps up to the mic, the band relax. Guitarist Bonehead - who's strategically placed between Liam and Noel - beams from ear to ear.

A couple of hours later, still in the middle of a song, Liam waves goodbye and casually strolls out of the rehearsal space.

"If you're not on it, chaos can ensue," he says, adding that he's given up cigarettes and alcohol (the intoxicants, not the song) for the duration of the tour.

Liam's newfound professionalism is probably the biggest revelation in the documentary, scripted by Peaky Blinders' creator Steven Knight, and shot by directors Dylan Southern and Will Lovelace.

To their presumable dismay, there are no scenes of the singer quitting the tour to go house-hunting , external ; throwing snooker balls at Blur , external ; or starting a fight on a cross-channel ferry .

Instead, they complete rehearsals without incident and rock up to Cardiff's Principality Stadium for their public reunion.

As the big moment...
body.zh: “曾经让我们彼此烦恼的小事都消失了，”诺埃尔·加拉格尔在谈到与弟弟利亚姆和解时说道。 这一场景出现在《Don’t Look Back In Anger》的结尾处，这是对乐队 2025 年回归巡演的感伤和深情的描绘。但这与我们进入乐队 15 年的停顿一样深。 在开场蒙太奇中，我们了解到 Oasis 如何在 20 世纪 90 年代凭借《Wonderwall》和《Roll With It》等热门歌曲征服世界。随着他们的名气越来越大，兄弟俩的仇恨也越来越大，直到 2009 年巴黎一场演出的后台派对突然停止。 粉丝拍摄的镜头显示，发起人在舞台上，通知观众，在“更衣室里发生了一场激烈的争斗”后，音乐会被取消。 “乐队已经不存在了，”他宣布，听起来更多的是恼怒而不是悲伤。 据也在场的苏格兰歌手艾米·麦克唐纳 (Amy McDonald) 表示，这场争吵是令人震惊的。 “利亚姆砸碎了诺埃尔的吉他，打架！”她在后台发推文。 然而，这部电影从未告诉我们所说的内容。没有人解释后果。我们不知道是谁促成了和解，也不知道这对他们的家庭有何影响。 相反，我们切入了复出巡演的排练，字幕告诉我们兄弟俩“15年没有说话了”，并暗示所有的伤口都奇迹般地痊愈了。 令人着迷的是，他们练习的第一首歌是《Columbia》——这是一首深受粉丝喜爱的歌曲，但从未出现在巡演的歌单中——但房间里却充满了紧张气氛。 乐队在诺埃尔的指导下正在拼凑歌单。利亚姆要到这个过程的后期才会到达，而且没有人确定他们会得到哪一个利亚姆。 当他到达时，他似乎脾气暴躁，抱怨乔伊·沃龙克鼓前面的隔音板。 但当他走到麦克风前时，乐队放松了。吉他手 Bonehead - 战略性地位于 Liam 和 Noel 之间 - 笑容满面。 几个小时后，利亚姆还在唱着歌，挥手告别，漫不经心地走出排练场。 “如果你不参加，混乱就会随之而来，”他说，并补充说他在巡演期间戒掉了香烟和酒精（麻醉品，而不是歌曲）。 利亚姆新发现的专业精神可能是这部纪录片中最大的启示，这部纪录片由《浴血黑帮》的创作者史蒂文·奈特编写剧本，由导演迪伦·萨瑟恩和威尔·洛夫莱斯拍摄。 令他们沮丧的是，没有歌手退出巡演去外部找房的场景；将斯诺克球扔到 Blur 外部；或者在跨海峡渡轮上打架。 相反，他们顺利地完成了排练，并在卡迪夫公国体育场举行了公开重聚。 作为重要时刻...

reflection.en: Noel Gallagher's comment that "the little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away" speaks to a reconciliation that, while welcome, feels superficial. The documentary, by glossing over the "hard stuff" of their 15-year hiatus, misses an opportunity to explore how true healing and reconciliation occur, not just the absence of...
reflection.zh: 诺埃尔·加拉格尔说“那些曾经让我们互相恼怒的小事都消失了”，这番话暗示了一种和解，虽然值得欢迎，但感觉有些肤浅。这部纪录片在略过他们15年休眠期的“艰难部分”时，错失了一个探讨真正治愈与和解如何发生的机会，而不仅仅是烦恼的消失。它提醒我们，克服过去的伤害需要的不只是恢复正常；它呼唤我们积极地选择良善，以对抗过往冲突留下的痕迹。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Werner Herzog on David Lynch, AI, and Why His Unhinged New Film ‘Bucking Fastard’ Skipped Cannes for Venice
title.zh: 维尔纳·赫尔佐格谈大卫·林奇、人工智能以及他为何跳过戛纳选择威尼斯展映新片《Bucking Fastard》

summary.en: Werner Herzog, now 84, discussed his new film 'Bucking Fastard' at the Venice Film Festival. The film, described as an eccentric existential odyssey, stars real-life sisters Kate and Rooney Mara as twins who move and speak in near-perfect unison. Herzog also reflected on his directorial approach and the evolving...
summary.zh: 84岁的维尔纳·赫尔佐格在威尼斯电影节上谈论了他的新片《Bucking Fastard》。这部影片被描述为一部古怪的存在主义史诗，由现实中的姐妹凯特和鲁妮·玛拉饰演几乎一模一样的双胞胎，她们的动作和言语几乎同步。赫尔佐格还反思了他的导演方法和不断变化的电影制作格局。

body.en:

You’ve never seen a movie quite like “ Bucking Fastard ,” whose director, Werner Herzog , turned 84 while promoting it at the Venice Film Festival . Part bawdy sex comedy, part picaresque adventure, and fully an eccentric existential odyssey, the film stars real-life sisters Kate and Rooney Mara as nearly identical twins who speak, move, and desire in lockstep unison. Think of Joan (Kate) and Jean (Rooney) Holbrooke as a two-headed person with the same shared dreams. And the same shared love interest, a rakish charmer played by Orlando Bloom.

Herzog’s narrative features, whether “Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call New Orleans,” “Fitzcarraldo,” or “Heart of Glass” (where all the actors performed under hypnosis), always veer toward the unexpected. Predictably, not all audiences at Venice vibed with his latest. It’s an acquired taste, for sure, but one that cast a strange early spell on the festival as it seeks North American distribution. Herzog shot the film in February 2025 in both Ireland and inside a famed tourist-attraction cave in Slovenia, complete with a jaunty train car ride. “ Bucking Fastard ” also toured Telluride, and will next play Toronto and New York. Related Stories ‘Look Back’ Review: Hirokazu Kore-eda’s Hyper-Faithful Adaptation Draws Rich and Dazzling New Textures from Manga and Anime ‘You Can See Everything’ Review: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Is Boundary-Pushing and Absurd

The film was originally invited to play out of competition at the Cannes Film Festival, an offering Herzog rejected because he wanted to give his stellar actresses a chance to win prizes. But there’s no bad blood with the festival, and now “Bucking Fastard” can compete for the panel of Venice jurors led by Maggie Gyllenhaal.

The day after the film’s world premiere, IndieWire sat down with Herzog — who fills any room with a warm gravitas — to talk about “Bucking Fastard,” why he has no plans to stop making movies, and his relationship with David Lynch, to whom this film is dedicated.

IndieWire: How are you feeling about the reactions to the movie? I wasn’t in the premiere. You were all a bit misty-eyed during the standing ovation.

Werner Herzog: It’s obvious that the audience loves [the Maras]. And they love Orlando Bloom and Domhnall Gleeson. Not a single one that is mediocre. So...

reflection.en: Werner Herzog, a filmmaker known for his unique vision, is promoting a film at 84 that explores synchronized twins. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing in the end times, a reality reflected in our rapidly advancing world, from filmmaking techniques to...

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
