title.en: Boatbuilders review – a gentle study of craftsmen’s quiet expertise
title.zh: 造船匠评论——对工匠静默专业知识的温和研究

summary.en: A light-touch documentary follows a team of Maine craftsmen constructing a high-spec sailboat for a seemingly pleasant super-rich client. The Brooklin Boat Yard, known for building yachts for the wealthy, is creating a 56ft cruising sailboat for millionaire Graham Green, complete with modern amenities. While Green...
summary.zh: 一部轻描淡写的纪录片跟随缅因州的一队工匠，为一位看似友善的超级富豪客户建造一艘高规格的帆船。布鲁克林造船厂以建造富人游艇而闻名，正在为百万富翁格雷厄姆·格林（Graham...

body.en: Venice film festival: Luke Lorentzen’s light-touch documentary follows a team of Maine craftsmen constructing a high-spec sailboat for a super-rich guy who seems kind of nice The Brooklin Boat Yard stands in a quiet harbour on the coast of Maine and makes high-spec yachts for rich men and women to sail. Its latest client is Graham Green, a millionaire financier who has commissioned the team to build him a 56ft cruising sailboat, the Kiandra, complete with maple worktops and a Sonos sound system. Green plans to sail the boat around the world, while its creators will stay in Brooklin, raise their kids and make boats. These men know their place. “We’re just the fucking help,” one confides. Boatbuilders is directed with the lightest of touches by 33-year-old Luke Lorentzen, who has already proved himself a past master in unhurried, observational documentaries about work. Midnight Family , his 2019 debut, spotlighted the travails of a private ambulance business in Mexico City, while 2023’s A Still Small Voice trailed a chaplain at Mount Sinai hospital in New York. Neither, though, immersed themselves in their subject to quite the level of Boatbuilders, which covers the process from lumber cutting to launch and from one summer through to the following spring. The leaves turn to gold, then the snow starts to fly, but down at the boatyard the job continues on schedule. The craftsmen plane and glue and discuss their lives. Boatbuilders screened at the Venice film festival Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：卢克·洛伦岑 (Luke Lorentzen) 这部轻快的纪录片讲述了缅因州工匠团队为一位看似不错的超级富豪建造一艘高规格帆船的故事。布鲁克林造船厂坐落在缅因州海岸一个安静的港口，为富有的男人和女人建造高规格的游艇供他们航行。它的最新客户是百万富翁金融家 Graham Green，他委托该团队为他建造一艘 56 英尺长的巡航帆船 Kiandra，配有枫木台面和 Sonos 音响系统。格林计划驾驶这艘船环游世界，而其创造者将留在布鲁克林，抚养孩子并制造船只。这些人知道自己的位置。 “我们只是他妈的帮助者，”一位人吐露道。 《造船者》由 33 岁的卢克·洛伦岑 (Luke Lorentzen) 轻松执导，他已经证明自己是拍摄有关工作的悠闲、观察性纪录片的大师。他 2019 年的处女作《午夜家庭》(Midnight Family) 聚焦了墨西哥城一家私人救护车业务的艰辛，而 2023 年的《寂静的声音》(A Still Small Voice) 则讲述了纽约西奈山医院的一名牧师的故事。不过，两人都没有达到造船师的水平，涵盖了从木材切割到下水，从一个夏天到第二年春天的整个过程。树叶变成了金色，然后雪花开始飞扬，但造船厂的工作仍在按计划进行。工匠们一边刨一边粘，一边讨论着自己的生活。 《造船者》在威尼斯电影节上放映继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary offers a glimpse into the quiet dedication of skilled artisans. Their meticulous work on the sailboat, from hull to rigging, is a testament to their expertise and commitment. It reminds us that whether building a vessel for global voyages or simply performing our daily tasks, doing all work heartily, as unto Yahweh, imbues even the most...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片让我们得以一窥技艺精湛的工匠们默默奉献的精神。他们一丝不苟地建造帆船，从船体到索具，都体现了他们的专业知识和投入。这提醒我们，无论是建造一艘用于环球航行的船只，还是仅仅完成日常工作，都要全心全意地去做，如同为主而做，这能赋予即使是最平凡的劳动以深刻的意义和尊严。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ‘You Can See Everything’ Review: Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim’s Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Is Boundary-Pushing and Absurd
title.zh: 《你无所不能》评论：内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆的伊丽莎白·霍姆斯纪录片，突破界限且荒谬

summary.en: Telluride: Everything we thought we knew about the beleaguered Theranos founder and convicted fraudster may or may not be true, according to A24's made-in-secret new documentary.
summary.zh: 特柳赖德：根据A24秘密制作的新纪录片，关于那位身败名裂的Theranos创始人、被定罪的诈骗犯，我们所知道的一切可能为真，也可能为假。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Elizabeth Holmes ’ name has devolved into being synonymous with scam artist. For the first time since her public takedown over her supposedly revolutionary blood-testing startup Theranos, she attempts to reclaim the narrative by welcoming directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim into her home. Just 34 days before her 11-year prison sentence, a small film crew begins documenting Holmes and her family’s day-to-day life starting in 2023. Almost immediately, it’s evident that “ You Can See Everything ” pushes the boundaries of documentary filmmaking, and somehow, even after 174 minutes, it leaves us hungry and curious for more. Related Stories ‘Look Back’ Review: Hirokazu Kore-eda’s Hyper-Faithful Adaptation Draws Rich and Dazzling New Textures from Manga and Anime Werner Herzog on David Lynch, AI, and Why His Unhinged New Film ‘Bucking Fastard’ Skipped Cannes for Venice

What we see is more opaque than the title suggests. Fielder and Oppenheim admit they didn’t exactly know what they were embarking on when they first conceived the idea at a magic show. This lack of a plan lets the narrative drive and develop itself, and it ultimately benefits the documentary. Fielder makes it clear that he’s done extensive research, but rather than a premeditated, prescribed thesis, “ You Can See Everything ” exhibits the power of repetitive reflection.

While Holmes is the original focus, her husband, Billy Evans, becomes an increasingly overbearing presence. Their unsettling dynamic surfaces early on. One morning, while Holmes slowly whisks eggs, Evans snatches the whisk away from her to do it the “right way.” Fielder immediately questions his actions, and Evans naturally brushes it off as wanting to help her. This direct, unabashed willingness to ask awkward and hard questions amplifies Fielder’s success as a documentarian; his investigative role was not anticipated, yet it is essential to what unfolds. As Holmes and Evans include Fielder more frequently in their conversations, the camera’s framing is forced to center him more and more. The line between director and subject is murky in a way that positions the audience to be as critical as Fielder is. We are collectively trying to decipher the truth while it buries itself in the manipulation of the main characters.

As Holmes’ prison appointment approaches, Fielder takes a pass at piecing together her perspective on her crimes....

reflection.en: Elizabeth Holmes, once hailed as a visionary, is now synonymous with fraud. Her story, as explored in the new documentary, serves as a stark reminder of how the pursuit of wealth and status can lead to profound ethical compromise. The love of money, as scripture warns, can indeed become a destructive force, leading individuals down paths of deceit and...
reflection.zh: 伊丽莎白·霍姆斯曾被誉为富有远见的人，如今却成了欺诈的代名词。她的故事，正如新纪录片所探讨的，警示我们对财富和地位的追求可能导致严重的道德妥协。正如经文所警告的，对金钱的贪爱确实会成为一种毁灭性的力量，将个人引向欺骗的道路，并最终走向毁灭。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.zh: A24 揭晓特柳赖德秘密放映：是关于伊丽莎白·霍姆斯的内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆纪录片

summary.en: "You Can See Everything" will be released in theaters in October. The film is a documentary by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim about Elizabeth Holmes.
summary.zh: 《你无所不能》将于今年十月上映。该片是内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆执导的关于伊丽莎白·霍姆斯（Elizabeth Holmes）的纪录片。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

The speculation about the Telluride Film Festival Sunday TBA (AKA a genuinely secret screening) started before the festival began and reached a fever pitch by Sunday evening. In the days leading up its reveal, Anne has been asked countless times by countless friends and colleagues: “Do you know what it is?”

Many suspected a documentary backed by A24. And that’s true: It’s Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim ’s “ You Can See Everything ” about convicted Theranos fraudster Elizabeth Holmes .

In the days leading up to the premiere, IndieWire checked in with A24 about the possibility of the long-rumored Nathan Fielder documentary being the much-hyped feature, and they confirmed it, asking for us to hold off on revealing the news until the screening began. The running time was rumored to be long, and it is: the film clocks in at over two hours. Related Stories ‘Look Back’ Review: Hirokazu Kore-eda’s Hyper-Faithful Adaptation Draws Rich and Dazzling New Textures from Manga and Anime Werner Herzog on David Lynch, AI, and Why His Unhinged New Film ‘Bucking Fastard’ Skipped Cannes for Venice

Per an official logline, “Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes ‘You Can See Everything.’”

In preparing for the Sunday night screening, there were security concerns. A24 took away the cell phones from every attendee at the Herzog Theatre. No phones were in the theater as the documentary was revealed to a packed house.

Holmes is the founder of Theranos, a blood-testing startup which was exposed after reporting showed that its ambitious technology did not work as had long been claimed. Holmes was convicted of defrauding investors and was sentenced to over a decade in prison. She’s currently serving her sentence at federal prison in Bryan, Texas.

Her story was previously dramatized in the Hulu series “The Dropout,” starring Amanda Seyfried as Holmes . The actress has been rumored to appear in Fielder’s film in character. Holmes’ story also previously got the documentary treatment in 2019 with “The Inventor” by Alex Gibney.

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 关于特柳赖德电影节周日TBA（又名真正的秘密放映）的猜测在电影节开始之前就开始了，并在周日晚上达到了狂热的程度。在其揭晓前的几天里，无数朋友和同事无数次问安妮：“你知道这是什么吗？” 许多人怀疑这是一部由 A24 支持的纪录片。这是真的：这是内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 和兰斯·奥本海姆 (Lance Oppenheim) 的《你可以看到一切》(You Can See Everything)，讲述的是被定罪的希拉洛斯欺诈者伊丽莎白·霍姆斯 (Elizabeth Holmes)。 在首映前几天，IndieWire 向 A24 询问了传闻已久的内森·菲尔德 (Nathan Fielder) 纪录片是否会成为大肆宣传的专题片的可能性，他们证实了这一点，并要求我们在放映开始之前再透露这一消息。传闻片长很长，事实也确实如此：影片时长超过两个小时。相关故事杰西·艾森伯格的《首次亮相》为朱丽安·摩尔带来了奥斯卡奖——他是这样做到的《未知的女人》评论：梅·埃尔·图克希的偏执时期惊悚片描绘了被指控与纳粹分子同床共枕的女性的堕落 根据官方的梗概，“臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯在被送进监狱前 34 天，邀请了一个持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。一开始是一个神秘重罪犯的亲密肖像，后来变成了一段令人费解的三年深渊之旅。突破界限的导演内森·菲尔德和兰斯·奥本海姆带来了《你可以看到一切》。” 在准备周日晚上的放映时，存在安全问题。 A24 拿走了赫尔佐格剧院每位与会者的手机。当纪录片上映时，影院里没有电话，座无虚席。 Holmes 是 Theranos 的创始人，Theranos 是一家血液检测初创公司，有报道显示其雄心勃勃的技术并没有像人们长期以来声称的那样有效，该公司被曝光。霍姆斯被判诈骗投资者罪，被判处十多年监禁。她目前正在德克萨斯州布莱恩联邦监狱服刑。 她的故事之前曾在 Hulu 连续剧《辍学者》中被改编，由阿曼达·塞弗里德 (Amanda Seyfried) 饰演福尔摩斯。有传言称这位女演员将在菲尔德的电影中出演角色。福尔摩斯的故事此前还曾在 2019 年由亚历克斯·吉布尼 (Alex Gibney) 执导的《发明家》拍摄成纪录片。 加拿大作家/导演/演员菲尔德是...

reflection.en: The rapid dissemination of information and the unveiling of a secret film screening at the Telluride Film Festival exemplify the accelerating pace of knowledge and communication in our age. Daniel 12:4 speaks of knowledge increasing and many running to and fro, a fitting description for how quickly news and cultural events now travel and are revealed.
reflection.zh: 信息传播的迅速以及特柳赖德电影节秘密放映的揭晓，都体现了我们这个时代知识和传播的加速。但以理书12:4说“必有多人来往奔走，知识就必增长”，这恰当地描述了新闻和文化事件如今传播和揭示的速度。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Primetime review – Robert Pattinson’s preening TV host hunts paedophiles but real drama proves harder to target
title.zh: 黄金时段评论——罗伯特·帕丁森扮演的虚荣电视主持人追捕恋童癖者，但真正的戏剧却难以捉摸

summary.en: Venice film festival: Lance Oppenheim’s drama about controversial US reality show To Catch a Predator is unsure what it wants to say about media or morality. Lance Oppenheim is the acclaimed documentary-maker who has made his feature debut with a strangely overwrought and heavy-footed drama-thriller, which for all its...
summary.zh: 威尼斯电影节：兰斯·奥本海姆的关于备受争议的美国真人秀节目《捕食者追踪》的剧情片，不确定它想表达关于媒体或道德的什么。兰斯·奥本海姆是一位备受赞誉的纪录片制作人，他首次执导的剧情惊悚片，虽然有着精心设计的霓虹灯黑色危险氛围，却对媒体、道德或任何其他事物都感到迷茫。

body.en: Venice film festival: Lance Oppenheim’s drama about controversial US reality show To Catch a Predator is unsure what it wants to say about media or morality Lance Oppenheim is the acclaimed documentary-maker who has made his feature debut with a strangely overwrought and heavy-footed drama-thriller, which for all its elaborate neon-lit atmosphere of noir danger isn’t at all sure what it wants to say about media or morality, or anything else. The subject is the controversial top-rated US TV reality show To Catch a Predator which ran from 2004 to 2008; that title was evidently taken from the Hitchcock movie To Catch a Thief, which in turn was inspired by the phrase “Set a thief to catch a thief”. In search of prey, the show’s researchers baited paedophiles in online chatrooms posing as children, lured them to “sting houses” where actors played underage teens on the front porch to get the abusers inside, where they can be clearly filmed expressing criminal intentions. But before anything could happen, sonorous host Chris Hansen appeared from nowhere and confronted these cringing abusers – which made for fantastic television. After this the cops made an arrest, and they and the state prosecutor did the heavy lifting of overseeing due process and presumably debating the merits of entrapment in court, although this obvious issue is not raised in the movie. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：兰斯·奥本海姆 (Lance Oppenheim) 执导的剧情片讲述颇受争议的美国真人秀节目《捕食者》，但它不确定自己想对媒体或道德说些什么。主题是 2004 年至 2008 年播出的备受争议的美国收视率最高电视真人秀节目《抓住铁血战士》；这个标题显然取自希区柯克的电影《抓贼》，而这部电影的灵感又来自于“设置贼抓贼”这句话。为了寻找猎物，该剧的研究人员在网络聊天室中冒充儿童引诱恋童癖者，引诱他们到“诱捕屋”，演员在前廊扮演未成年青少年，将施虐者带入室内，在那里可以清楚地拍摄到他们表达犯罪意图的过程。但在一切发生之前，响亮的主持人克里斯·汉森突然出现，与这些畏缩的施虐者对峙——这使得电视节目变得精彩。此后，警察进行了逮捕，他们和州检察官承担了监督正当程序的繁重工作，并可能在法庭上讨论了被困的好处，尽管电影中没有提出这个明显的问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary grapples with the complex morality of media sensationalism, particularly in its portrayal of a show hunting predators. The film itself seems unsure of its message, reflecting a broader human tendency to pursue ambitious projects without clear moral direction, much like the Tower of Babel narrative where grand human endeavors led to...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了媒体耸人听闻主义复杂的道德问题，尤其是在描绘一个追踪捕食者的节目时。影片本身似乎对其信息感到不确定，这反映了人类在没有明确道德方向的情况下追求宏伟计划的普遍倾向，就像巴别塔的故事一样，人类宏大的努力最终导致了混乱。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」
